scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Hello!
Now ^4d4dffthe palace is hosting a banquet for the returning heroes from Vacuum^000000.
Please tell me ^4d4dffwhere the heroes who have participated in the expedition are^000000 if you know any.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text: I wonder where they are. They are so scattered that it is difficult to locate each one of them. Hahaha!

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Oh, wait. You are...
{0}, right?
Let's see.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
I am right. You look exactly the same as the montage from the guild. Hahahaha!
My eyes are doing what they are supposed to do now, I guess.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
It is difficult to find the freelance adventurers who don't belong to the military.
It was very difficult to find you since you are not bound to anywhere.
May I help you?

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Help? Sure thing!
You know that there is a banquet taking place in celebration of subjugating Morocc.
An invitation has been issued for you. But it was just impossible to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
I am sure that all the Royal Messengers of the city must be looking for with the portrait of you.
Hey, since we don't have enough time, please take this invitation for you.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text: You must attend the banquet. Do you understand? ^4d4dffYou've been invited as a special guest^000000.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
The people in the palace will fill you up with the details.
I am just a messenger after all.
Although the banquet will be held for quite a while, don't take too much time to get there.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Make sure to bring the invitation with you. Don't forget!
Why don't you go right now? ^4d4dffI can teleport you there now if you want^000000.
I'll go on my own.
I'll go right away.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
You can visit the Prontera Palace.
You may show the invitation to the guard at the gate or
A servant in charge of the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Since I have delivered the invitation to you, I shall wait for another one.
I hope you have a good time there, dear hero.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Let me teleport you there right away.
When you arrive, there will be a servant for reception. You can show the invitation then.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Why are you still here?
What can I do for you?
Send me to the Banquet Hall.
I have lost the invitation.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
What a shame! What happened?
Well, since the message that you'll be there has already been sent there,
You may not really need the invitation anyways.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
When you go to the palace, the servant in charge will recognize you.
Don't worry, and you may go to the palace now.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Eh? What is that you have in your pocket? It looks like an invitation to me.
I may have a tiny set of eyes, but I wouldn't miss it.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text: Since you have found your invitation, let's get going! Hahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
Let me teleport you there right away.
When you arrive, there will be a servant for reception. You can show the invitation then.

scripts.speaker: Royal Messenger
scripts.text:
I have heard that you have attended the banquet safely.
I need to find the others and send them to the banquet as well.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Here comes the hero!
The Banquet Hall is inside the palace. You may follow the passage to get there.
Let me send a message for the Chamberlain to find you.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain Bell
scripts.text:
You must be Sir {0}... Am I right?
You are here at last.
I've been waiting for you.
I am glad that the invitation have found you in time.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
I am Chamberlain Bell Twilight. I will be at your service during your stay at the palace.
You can call me Belle.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
{0} since you have been invited as a special guest here, a separate guest room is prepared for you.
You may go upstairs and walk ^4d4dffstraight to the left corridor^000000.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Let me go ahead and mall all the preparations.
Come with me, please.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain Bell
scripts.text:
The special guestroom is prepared this way.
It is the ^4d4dfffirst room^000000 you'll see in there.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain Bell
scripts.text:
Let me tell you the story in detail after moving into the room.
Come this way.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain Bell
scripts.text:
Let me tell you about the detailed schedule inside.
Let's go inside.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain Bell
scripts.text:
I'll be waiting for you here in this room at all times.
You may find me when you need a help.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
This is the guest room for the officially invited guest.
Since this place forbids the access of outsiders, please leave.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You must have come a long way here. Thank you.
Since you are a special guest, you have been assigned with a room in the royal villa.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: I'll tell you about the schedule at all times. You can ask me anytime.
What do you mean by the special guest?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: The banquet hosted by the palace is to celebrate the return of the expedition and cherish their hard work...

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
However, more importantly, it is to fulfill the Royal Assembly.
The candidates for the throne have been evaluated before.
And heir to the throne will be determined.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: There is a secret ritual passed down in the palace, which is held before the official coronation. The heir will be named the king upon passing the ritual.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: Unless the heavens fall, the ritual will be finished safely, and Rune-Midgarts will meet the new king.
What's it got to do with me?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
I have told you just before.
There is a ritual to be held after the final decision.
You have been invited as an observer to the ritual.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
It is the secret ritual of the palace to designate the king for the eternal glory of the seven royal families.
So that our new king is acknowledged by all the people of this land.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
However, since special evaluation is allowed by the Royal Assembly,
It has been decided to select a personnel recommended by each guild

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: Or a hero who made a great contribution in the expedition as the observer of this ritual.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: Consequently, you have been assigned. I have heard that you were recommended unanimously.
When will the ritual take place?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
As far as I know, it is supposed to be in the final stage.
Since the late king passed away all of a sudden, the palace has been in a state of disorder.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Fortunately, Rune-Midgarts is supported by the seven royal families.
It is the time to welcome our new king.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Since you are invited as the observer,
You need to visit each facility and exchange greetings before attending the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: This royal villa happens to be the place where the people from each family stays when they come to the capital. All other rooms except this one are occupied by other families.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
They must have heard the news of your arrival by now.
How about ^4d4dffvisiting the Heine family near here^000000?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
In the west villa, I mean, where we are now,
There are the residences for Heine, Nerius and Walther.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: In the east across the corridor, there are residences for Wigner, Richard, Geoborg and Roegenburg.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: You need to exchange greetings with the members of each families so make sure to visit them all.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
The news of your arrival must have reached each family by now.
They must be waiting. Pay a visit and exchange greetings.

scripts.speaker: Belle
Belle
scripts.text: They are the most blue-blooded people, not used to be kept waiting.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
In order to keep a smooth relationship with them, you may to there quickly.
Then, good bye.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Oh, you are back.
The assembly seems to take some time.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: Since you have some time to spare, why don't you go enjoy the banquet in the Banquet Hall.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
The ^4d4dffladies of the Nerius family have just asked to see you in the Banquet Hall^000000 .
{0}, you must have made a good impression.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: And this is some sort of reward which has been sent to you as a token of gratitude...

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You can collect them and exchange with useful items.
You may get more in return for your help around the palace.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
There must be someone ^4d4dffnear the Crusader's Office who would exchange^000000 them.
If you have some time, pay a visit.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Oh, how was the banquet?
The banquet is supposed to last long since it is held to welcome all the returning heroes from Ash-Vacuum...

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
By the way, the Court Mage has visited just before.
The Court Magician will be back soon after visiting other families.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
There... Is the magician.
The Court Mage will give you the details.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You are back.
There has been a message for you.
It says 'There will be an important meeting. Please wait until then.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You will be notified as soon as everything is settled.
Please enjoy the banquet until then.'

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
This is about it.
Apart from it, well, I am not supposed to be curious about this kind of things...

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: However, ^4d4dffI saw the court doctors and priests moving fast to the Heine family^000000.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: They seemed to be in a hurry. Do you know what has happened?
This is a difficult question for me to answer...

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
I am sorry that I asked.
Well, there is one more news.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: The lady of the ^4d4dffNerius^000000 family has invited you to have a cup of tea with her.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: She asked me to let her know as soon as you come. Shall I send her a message now?
I'll visit her now.
I'll visit her later.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Let me know when you are ready.
I'll send her the message then.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Let me send the message now.
Good bye.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: Would you accept the invitation from the Nerius family now?
I'll visit her now.
I'll visit her later.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Let me know when you are ready.
I'll send her the message then.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Let me send the message now.
Good bye.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
The Nerius family stays in the second room from this room.
The room next to the room of the Heine family.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: I have sent the message that you would visit them soon. You may go there anytime.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
There has been a request from the Heine family to meet you.
They asked you to visit the Heine family as soon as you come back.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Oh, you are back!
Let me call the Mage.
What is that about?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Court Mage Nillem opened the door and left right away.
Saying, 'Where are you?' {0} The magician must be looking for you.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain
scripts.text: I am at your service.
Call Nillem
What is the next thing on the schedule?
Please prepare some refreshments.
Call Convenience Service

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Shall I call the Court Mage for you?
Wait a second.
I have just sent a message. The magician will arrive here soon.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: There is no special invitation for today.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Here are some chamomile tea and ginger cookies. They will help you take a rest and get recovered from fatigue.
Do you like it?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You seemed hungry, so I have prepared some afternoon tea, scones and clotted cream.
Do you like it?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Here are some chocolate and cinnamon-flavored rooibos tea for refreshment.
Do you like it?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Here is some strong mint tea mixed with milk and chocolate chips. A great after-meal treat.
Do you like it?

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Here is some cold milk with citron jelly and cream. It is a sweet and sour drink.
Do you like it?
^4d4dff All HP and SP are recovered!

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
Which service should I call for you?
All calls are available, but additional charge may apply to each service.
Kafra
Giant Beast Manager
No need.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You want the Kafra Service.
Let me make a call right away.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text:
You need a Giant Beast Manager.
Let me make a call right away.

scripts.speaker: Belle
scripts.text: I see.
I am managing the Dragons and Griffons for the Rune Knights and Royal Guards.

scripts.speaker: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.text: Thank you for calling me. Shall I bring a {0} for you?
Use
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.text: I see. Then, good bye.

scripts.speaker: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.text: You need to learn how to ride a {0} first.

scripts.speaker: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.text: You are already using a {0}.

scripts.speaker: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.text:
You are already riding something else.
You need to take off the ride to ride a {0}.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
Hello. This is Kafra Service.
What can I do for you?
Use Cargo Service
Use Cart Service
Quit

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
I am sorry, dear customer.
You need to raise the novice skill level to 6 or higher to use the cargo service.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
You don't have enough money.
The Cargo Service costs 50 Zeny.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
Let me open the warehouse for you.
Thank you for using Kafra Service.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
I am sorry,
The Cart Service is available for Merchant classes only.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text: You are already equipped with a cart.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text: You can use the cart after learning the 'Push Cart' skill.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
The Cart Service costs 800 Zeny.
Would you use it?
Use
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text:
You don't have enough money, dear customer.
The Cart Service costs 800 Zeny.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Employee
scripts.text: Thank you for using Kafra Service as always.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Oh, it's you, darling! I've been waiting for you!
Darling...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Oh, I am sorry that I was overly excited.
Exploring through the fissure of dimensions to uncover the secret of the palace...!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: No mage would say no to that! No wonder I am excited!
By the way, why did you choose me?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Well, because a royalty is picky and useless...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
See, the current head of the family and the heir are not supposed to do anything dangerous.
So are the heirs to the throne.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Did you see Peter in bed?
......No harm should be done to him, you know.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Not this, not that... After removing all those things, there aren't many left for the aristocrats other than paper work and socializing.
What can they do?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Moreover, it doesn't suit me to take care of them. Hahahahahaha!
And, why are you working as a Court Mage.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
For the stability and high income-
The palace has paid the tuition during my study in Eclage as well! How generous!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Ahem. Anyways, it has all been prepared.
Since the distortion appeared in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, I installed the gate there.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
From now on, you can ^4d4dffcome to the Past Memories of the Royal Family right away^000000, or...
Right. Let me give you the ^4d4dffmillion Nillem call ticket^000000.
My treat!
The... Million Nillem call ticket?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Yes. You can call me anytime via this Chamberlain here if you wan to see me!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I'll be here immediately like a flash of lightning-
Well, then, shall we get going?
Let's go now!
I need to make some preparations.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Then, let me know when you are ready.
If I don't show up, come to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 right away.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: You know how to get there.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Then, close your eyes...
One!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Haha, then, let's go to the Past Memories of the Royal Family!
Move to the Past Memories of the Royal Family
I don't need it!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I like how you refuse so flatly
May I hang out here for a while since I am already here?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Then, close your eyes...
One!
I hear voices from somewhere.
I happen to eavesdrop on a fishy conversation.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I get to see you again. {0}.
Chamberlain must have been a great messenger.
I saw you coming this way right away.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I was surprised when you were introduced as a special guest. You seem to be more extraordinary than I have thought.
You were introduced as...

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
But it is true.
This banquet is for the heroes like you.
You should be proud.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
That's right!
No one will stop you from hanging out with us. Please visit us often.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Since there are only us around here, we can loosen up a little...

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Hahaha.... I'll make sure the words don't get out.
Did you hear, Crux?
My sister wants to hang out quietly.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
I mean, my ladies?
What do you mean by...?

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text: You know that I am on your side, my lady, right?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Oh, don't make me laugh.
I know you have come here to spy on us this time.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
No! No, please!
...Oh? Isn't that Lord Heine?

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Oh, you are right? Nyhill! This way!

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
You don't have to scream like that, Skia.
{0} is here too.
Indeed, you won't be mistaken when you hang out with the people of the Nerius family.
Good decision.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Skia and Lord of the Heine family.
Since when did you call each other by the first name?

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Hum, we exchanged greetings earlier in the corridor.
The Heine residence is next to that of the Nerius family.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
It was refreshing, and I am grateful to you.
And...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: {0}, I visited your room to give you my apology, but you had already left for the Banquet Hall.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
Earlier...
I was rude to you out of impulse.
Please forgive me.

scripts.speaker: Drunk Woman
scripts.text:
Haha... Hahaha... Poor Lord Nyhill, what a pity.
He has not been selected as the heir to the throne...

scripts.speaker: Drunk Woman
scripts.text:
Oh, well! Who are these?
Aren't they the Nerius sisters who are from that famous family led by a woman?
Lord, are you even going to ditch your own household for the Nerius family?

scripts.speaker: Violeta
scripts.text:
I am not telling a lie. Am I?
You are not welcome in your own family anyway. Why don't you flirt with a lady here to change your life?
Hahahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Violeta
scripts.text:
Oh, my! My lord, I didn't know you could get angry.
That's right. You better get angry and show your emotions...

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
...I don't know which family you are from, but you need to strop.
If you keep insulting my lady, I won't let it pass.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Hold it, Crux.
You shouldn't regard me on the same level as the coarse thing who doesn't even know what she is talking about.
I don't tend to bear a grudge against the Heine family for this.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Isn't it right? Violeta Collette Heine?
I understand your feelings for the lord, but your behavior will just bring disgrace to your family.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
You do what you please if you want to damage his reputation.
However, you should keep us, the Nerius family, out of the mess.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
That is true.
Violeta. I will let it slide this time. You should get back now.
Or, I'll have to punish you in the name of the family.

scripts.speaker: Violeta
scripts.text:
Well, I'll get back.
Since things have turned out this way, you better go to join the Nerius family, then! He!

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: How does the story go that way?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I am sorry, I apologize for her bad manners.
.....

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
You keep saying sorry.
But you didn't do anything wrong, Nyhill.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Well, Skia. You don't understand.
Whether willing or not, as the head of the family, every fault of the family becomes his burden.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
She is right. I bear the name of Heine, and I am in the position to take care of every matter which comes with the family.
Whether willing or not...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: Skia, it is the same for you. You sometimes have to become a shadow yourself.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: However, I didn't know you have been treated like that by the members of your own family.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I must have interrupted the joy of the banquet. I should get going.
I hope we get to share more stories sometime.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Not at all. Let us give you the official invitation next time.
Please don't turn down then.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
How can I turn down the invitation from the next head of the Nerius family?
Now... then.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
...Hum...
Umm...
Skia, can I take a look at the drink you got?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
And, Crux.
Go dig out the Chamberlain who has given us the drink.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
No one can fool my eyes like this.
{0}, you take a look too.
Doesn't something seem strange to you?
Well, you do seem to talk a little casually now...

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I am not used to talk in the formal form.
I tried to be courteous to you since you are a special guest. But I'd rather bite my own tongue than keep talking that way.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Oh, shaking. He is shaking!
Crux, did you see? Nyhill's steps shook.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
The champagne is supposed to be as light as fruit juice.
He must have not been drunk on that.
I think there must be something wrong.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
{0}.
Don't you think something funny is about to happen now?
Oh, how suspicious.
Since it seems suspicious, let's get back now.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Eh? Are you going off like that?
What if he is sick? What if he passes out on the way?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
If you are curious, you may follow him.
I am well taken care of by Crux.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Well, hero?
Would you follow him first?
If I follow him like this, everyone will find me strange.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
I'll be after you quietly.
Spica never jokes about something like that.
There must be something.
I guess I have no choice.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Iwine.
How are you enjoying the banquet?
I am a little nervous since it's my first time to attend a banquet like this...

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Not that I have never been to a banquet...
How can I explain?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
You don't have to explain.
It is just a family matter.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Right.
Please excuse my babbling.
I am sorry.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Bad things seem to keep happening.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
You are here to enjoy the banquet, right?
Have you visit all other families?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
It is almost impossible to meet them usually. What a great chance you have to be able to visit them officially.
They are even waiting for you...

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
What a successful debut to the society!
Do not miss the chance when you have it.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: You never know what would happen!

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: Hum? You are still here. I thought you went after the lord from the Heine family.
Didn't you go back to your room?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I was just giving my sister a push in the back.
I was curious how Skia would react.
...Aren't you following him?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I have a hunch that something big is about to happen.
You better go after the lord to make sure he is OK.
I have advised you as so, remember.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I don't like how things have been going these days.
...I guess I am about to stop holding it down.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
Don't mind me.
I am just a bodyguard.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
I get to see you again.
The lady has been waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
I am thinking about the order given by the lady.
I need to be apart from her to look into it...

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text: Frankly, it makes me feel uneasy leaving her alone.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I am not a child, you know.
Or do I remind you of your daughter running along the river bank?

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
Daughter?
Hahaha. That is funny.
But you don't look your age to be honest.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text: You can be attacked by the kids again.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
He! Who can top you?
You shouldn't worry about me.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
I guess we won't be able to return to the head house anytime soon.
Well, this actually could be a good thing.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
...Who's there?
{0}...?
What are you doing here?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
...Am I drunk?
My head hurts.
...I feel dizzy...

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Why are you here?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
...Oh... I felt tipsy and asked a chamberlain to guide me to somewhere I can take a rest.
......Umm...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
He told me it was light champagne...
.....
Has anything happened to you?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I don't remember.
I believe there was a guest here...
By the way, what brought you here?

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Well, it is almost the time, so...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I see. I guess all the preparation must have been made by now.
I will be damned if I waste more time here.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I should get back now.
Phew... Fortunately, my head is clearing up.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: Well, then. Please excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Whoa! He is fast.
Well, hero. Shall we get back too?
I'll see you again soon though.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
The Court Mage must have arrived by now.
You should go back to your room.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
Do you want to take a look at the material?
It is still here since I haven't taken it away.
The document is the royal record about the Room of Consciousness.
There are several blank pages in-between.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
Read the text written above.
Yes, it's here.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
^4d4dffOnly the ones who know the truth can read this.^000000
See?

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
Considering the time which has passed, there must be no one who knows this truth left now.
In other words, this part will remain a mystery forever.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
That's why Archduke Stoltze gave up and left.
Since you have seen this, let me put this back in place.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
Oh, you are here.
Archduke Grantz has been waiting for you for a while.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
My family has been managing the Past Memories of the Royal Family for generations.
No wonder since it is the exclusive scriptorium for the royal family.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text:
It has not been long since I took over this position so I am not really that used to this.
I never expected to be visited by these many archdukes...

^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Phew, did you see? We are the last ones entering.
Others must have entered already.
Enter now.
Do not enter.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Hum? I don't know what is going on. We don't seem to be able to enter now.
It is a secret area which is made to open upon showing magical power.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Let's wait until it stabilizes.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Has anything happened in there?
What on earth...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: It is nothing that I should know and nowhere I should be part of. But still, I am curious about it.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
The movement of magical flow seems peculiar.
...I wonder if it is my imagination that the gate looks unstable.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Oh, this is troublesome.
There seems to be a problem with the gate now.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Use of magic is restricted in this area. All I can do is to activate the gate here...
Where you are going with this...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Oh, I mean...
You should get out here on foot.
Well, since things have turned out this way.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
^4d4dffHere is the material what the archduke has seen earlier.^000000
{0}, why don't you take a look too?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Well, not that I am curious about it.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Just out of curiosity.... No, I mean ardor for study. Haha...
...Yes? Let's take a look... Make sure to share what is in there with me-

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Aren't you curious?
Since you are out here with the archduke, the librarian would show it to you with no doubt, you know.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: I'll try to find a way to reactivate the gate.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Aren't you curious?
Since you are out here with the archduke, the librarian would show it to you with no doubt, you know.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: I'll try to find a way to reactivate the gate.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
...Oh well. ^4d4dffOnly open to the ones who know the truth^000000...
Argh, what a waste.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Well, it is no use to stick around here.
I could cut the air with a knife earlier. Let's get out now.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I took a look at the gate.
Has there been a big explosion of magic inside before?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I sense some sort of magical distortion, which is similar to...
The ^4d4dffCrack of Dimension^000000!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Can we make a gate of dimension here?
That would be fun too.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Right.
Since the gate has become useless...
Let's walk out of here.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Do you see the crusader there?
He manages the entrance.
He will guide you.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Although there are direct gates installed in the palace for convenience,
There are passages you can walk directly in.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
This is one of the rare chances to use the secret passage.
Hahahaha...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Haha, shall I get ready?
Come here! ^4d4dffDimension Warper MkII^000000!!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Well, let's go, dear customer.
I wonder what we are going to see this time!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
We haven't solved all the secrets yet!
Well, we have to go back!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Let's finish it off this time!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
What are you doing?
Go grill the librarian to dig out the truth!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
What did we go through all the trouble for?
Look, there is Archduke Grantz.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
^4d4dffThe Heine family will get the approval to enter the 'Past Memories of the Royal Family'^000000, right?
We will see each other more often from now on then.
Haha, this must be what others call the destiny-¡?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
What are you doing?
Let's go see ^4d4dffDuke Friedrich to check if the approval has been issued!^000000

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Today, we are going on a secret journey together again!
Hahaha. You'd better get excited!
I'll let you travel in the first class!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Well, let's go, dear customer.
What would be waiting for us today?
I guess this would end up a failure again, though.
Hahaha-
^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Ritual of Blessing].^000000
You can move to where the ritual of blessing is held.
Enter.
Do not enter.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Hum... This gate is only activated temporarily so that it doesn't last long.
^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Ritual of Blessing].^000000

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Oh, well, the movement of magic seems uneasy.
Hum, shall we try again later?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
The gate to the place where the ritual is held is not activated officially.
Wait a minute.

^4d4dffThis is an event proceeding through memorial.
Only the party leader can enter.^000000

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
Would you go out through the passage?
There is another overwatcher where I am about to send you.

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text: Don't be surprised and you may go out with his help.
Go out now.
Go out later.

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
I will send you anytime when you need it.
Just don't waste too much time here.

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text: Let's me guide you right away,

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: Did you find out anything?
Tell him what you have seen.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
...........Did such thing happen?
There has been a record of the disaster in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I didn't know that the Imir Heart in the Room of Consciousness was stolen by the Valkyrie!
Why wasn't such a thing recorded?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Can you read the document now then?
If what you have seen is true, the seal would be broken.

When you touch the blank page of the book Kronecker has given you,
The text shows up with a glow.

^4d4dff......
Due to the battle of the Valkyrie, the Imir Heart sealed in the Room of Consciousness disappeared.

I was terrified that the symbol of legitimacy held by the royal family had been gone.
I am afraid that we wouldn't be able to see the light of Terra Gloria in the coronation.

The problem would occur from the next coronation.
The people of the kingdom will be disheartened and worried about their future if the blessing of the earth is not given to the crowning of the king.

I consulted Varmunt the Great Sage about this.
He told me he could help and installed something in the Room of Consciousness.

I was surprised to see what was installed there reacting with Terra Gloria.
It delivered enough magical power to Terra Gloria's Star of Blessing,
And Terra Gloria could give the blessing of the earth as usual.

Everything was all right.
Even if it was by the fake Imir Heart.

Terra Gloria, our beautiful crown.
In the blessed crown, there remained a piece of Imir Heart which has been guarding Prontera for generations.

It is enough.
It would be enough for our descendants.

Therefore, I wish no one else ever read this record,
And seal it with a condition which cannot be met.

If one of our descendants happen to read this record,
Make sure to guard Terra Gloria.
It is the last piece of Imir Heart left to us.^000000
That's it...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Am I going to be killed now?
I think I have just found out all the secrets of the royal family.
Aren't you going to execute me?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
..............Hum...
If you want, I will fulfill your wish.
But not now.

scripts.speaker: Librarian
scripts.text: Then... How about me?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: If you say another word, I'll hang you with my own hands.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I am surprised.
It means that we can bring a ^4d4dfffake Imir Heart^000000 or
The real piece of Imir Heart to replace what has been destroyed.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
The real problem is Terra Gloria...
It has been one of a kind to begin with.
Since it was made by crafting a small piece fallen from the heart...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Should we negotiate with the cooperation in Schwarzwald?
Wait a minute.
.....
What should I do now?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I am sorry to keep you waiting while I collect my thoughts.
Thank you for your work.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
May I ask you a favor?
Would you keep on visiting that place with Nillem?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: Although we are going to discuss about it in the official meeting, I don't think the result would be different.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Please guard Imir Heart there or bring it to us!
We don't keep our hope too high, but it would worth the try, wouldn't it?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Please.
I'll get the approval for you to visit the Past Memories of the Royal Family everyday.
Please get the task from Frietz... I mean Friedrich.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It is a shame, but you are the only hope left for us.
We are counting on you.
^4d4dffFrom now on, you can get daily quests related to the past Room of Consciousness from Friedrich Stoltze.^000000

scripts.speaker: Kronecker G. Heine
scripts.text:
Then, I'll entrust the matter regarding this place to you and Nillem.
For the sake of the royal family's legitimacy...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker G. Heine
scripts.text: Please carry out this mission in secret.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
We have been waiting for you because...
We wonder ^4d4dffif you have ever told anyone about the ritual^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text: Only few people know about the Past Memories of the Royal Family and the Ritual of Blessing...

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
You need to make it more clear.
Just say it.
Am I a suspect here?

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
Ah, it is....
That you are the only outsider who know about it, and there has been no precedent...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I don't believe so.
The hero doesn't even know the existence of the Past Memories of the Royal Family and where it is.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
We only have told to observe the ritual after the Royal Assembly is completed.
Never mentioned about where it would be held or how.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I understand how upset you all are due to this sudden incident.
But, please don't suspect an innocent person.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: That must be...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
How troublesome.
Have you seen this document before?

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
What is it?
We are in the middle of something important.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
No matter is more important than this!
It has already happened. We need to prepare for the future.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: However, ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 is gone...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It disappeared when we were taking care of fallen Peter.
I guess those intruders must have taken it during the explosion.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
And about the Star of Blessing... They said...
It was ^4d4dfffake^000000.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: It must refer to the piece of Imir Heart.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: I am sorry to interrupt but I have something to tell you.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: ...It is important. I was about to tell you about the cause of all these.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
The cause of the incident?
You mean you know who have told the secret?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
The one who told about the ritual...
Was me.
...So...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: Please punish me for my fault.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
What are you talking about? Nyhill!
Why did you...!

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I believe it was me.
I have this piece of memory talking to someone while I was drunk.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I believe it is how the story got out.
I am deeply ashamed.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
Oh my... Was it the lord of the Heine family...
Although us, the Walther family did not attend the Royal Assembly, we won't sit back and watch this matter!

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Ha, I have heard what people say about you. You really don't seem to be able to do anything right.
Why did you do such a thing?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Did you want to be a king so badly?
Peter is a member of your own family!

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
........Phew...
It is not that...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Speak for yourself.
I need to know how useless you are.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I have nothing to say about it.
However...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I am a Heine, one of the seven royal families of Rune-Midgarts.
I didn't do such a thing on purpose.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Are you sure that you didn't do it to avenge for losing your position as a candidate for the throne?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I have told you that it isn't true!
..........
Wait, may I interrupt?

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
Please, do so. I am sorry about my bad manners earlier.
...Do you know anything about this, dear guest?
Tell them about the thing happened in the Banquet Hall.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
...Did such thing happen?
A person who looks like a scientist and drug...

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
If it is true, Lord Heine must have not done such a thing on purpose.
Someone must have taken advantage on him according to a plot...

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Do you have a proof?
You didn't just come up with the story to help him out, right?
Lady Nerius will testify...

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
...Hum... The ladies of the Nerius family have seen it too?
We need to call for a meeting.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text: Hey, Grantz. What are you going to do?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Even if it was true, he still has acted so carelessly.
I cannot let it slide.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It is difficult for me to say, but it could have been deemed as a treason.
What a shame. I have nothing to say about it.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: This has brought disgrace to the name of Heine.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Nyhill, you sentence you to disciplinary confinement for a while.
You shouldn't contact with anyone other than the ones you must see.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
And about disappeared ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000
And destroyed Star of Blessing, we need to come up with a solution.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text:
It will be a long discussion.
Let me convene a meeting right away.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text: I'll see you later then.

scripts.speaker: Ian Walther
scripts.text: Let me fill you in with the details after proceeding with a discussion with my family.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Wait, it is not ready yet.
Do not touch that.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Let me connect the gap in the dimension by force.
The gap might be invisible, but it still is a crack.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
It will be connected to the time when a big event has taken place.
Are you ready?
I am ready!
I am not ready!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Phew, don't be such a drag.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Then, sweet dreams!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Oh, we did it.
I don't know when, but it is the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: However, I have to give it a twist to get to the place we want to go.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Can I?
Hahaha, of course I can!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
It is the first time for me to do this.
But let me twist the dimension like this.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Connect the spaces by force!
Well, let's see what has happened here.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Are you ready?
Talk to me when you are ready-

^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Then let's go and take a look what has happened in the Room of Consciousness.
Since I am connecting the twisted time and space once more by force,
I may have to use my full power to maintain this!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Please, come back alive and well-
Connect now.
Do not go.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Oh... It doesn't work well.
Wait, phew... Let me collect my strength again...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: ... I'll make it work, wait a minute.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
You are here now!
This place has been chaotic since you were gone.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Do you see the exit over there?
Haha, that gate leads to Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: And...
Then?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Prontera is being destroyed by the undead army-!
Right now! It is just a hot mess out there!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I mean, why don't we go to watch the unknown past of Prontera,
Since we are already here?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: I have been digging around a little, and I guess we can come here anytime when we want...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Well, this could be one of the parallel worlds, but we have nothing to lose anyway.
Why don't we go take a look?
If you insist.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I knew you would! I have been right about you!
What are you waiting for! Let's go out there!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Aren't we heading out?
Let's go!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
Right.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
I guess so.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
You mean, the ones who know the truth?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
Don't call me that!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
Hahaha, I like this place now.
My darling, what do you want me to do now?
Connect to the Room of Consciousness
Return

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text: As you wish!

scripts.speaker: Nillem
scripts.text:
