Oh... It was just impossible for me to quit...
When I was about to leave after reporting to the Head Chef, I was caught by Mark' brother.

scripts.speaker: Tamarin
scripts.text: I guess it would make my life much easier if I just give up.
A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
Place the dish carefully on the surface.

scripts.speaker: Tamarin
scripts.text:
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...

- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -

Place the dish carefully on the surface.
A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Hello.
You must be the hero whom everyone talks about.
I am honored to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Are you invited to the banquet?
This place is not the Banquet Hall.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
You must be {0} whom everyone talks about.
Thank you for visiting us.
I am Spica of the Nerius family.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
I am Skia.
Nice to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: And he is my bodyguard.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
My name is Crux Findel.
I am learning swordsmanship in the Nerius family.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Our mother, the current head of the family, is supposed to be here.
However, since many heroes like you,{0}, are said to attend this banquet,

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: Our mother let us come here to meet and learn from them.
Where is the candidate for the throne?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Oh, you must be invited as the observer to the ritual...
I see.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Erich is in the royal library.
I guess he could be looking for blueprints of some sort which interest him.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Nerius is not interested in the throne.
Erich didn't have to participate in the Royal Assembly.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: Since he is just a candidate merely for effect, he must be doing what he wants to do now.
Why aren't you interested in the throne?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
It is one of the characteristics of the Nerius.
The family is led by women for generations. Therefore, we turn out more queens than kings.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: If Erich hasn't come forth, one of us, Skia and I would have been elected as a candidate for the queen.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Our mother didn't like it.
That's why Erich became a candidate for the throne. Poor cousin...

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Well, I guess that's enough information about our family.
Have you exchanged greetings with all other families?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Since freedom doesn't come often for us, I tend to enjoy it as much as possible.
So...

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Why don't you enjoy it with us?
I believe the lord of the Heine family would make a good friend too.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Skia, my beloved twin.
You need to learn to speak more elegantly.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Anyways, what I want to say is that
the Nerius family is always open to you,{0}, so please visit us
anytime you want.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: {0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: {0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: We must get prepared for the Banquet now. We need some time to dress up.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: I'll send you a formal invitation to make up for this.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I have heard the story briefly from Skia.
Lord Nyhill must have a constitutional weakness for alcohol.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: You are not hiding anything, right?
I saw someone suspicious.
No.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
You are lying.
I have to let the elders know about this anyway.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: I wonder if the old folks would hear me out though.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Skia told me something similar to that.
Crux didn't find out much.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: I guess some shady characters must have mixed in with the bunch of temporary employees hired for the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text: ...Anyways, I guess we have to warn the elders about this.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Sorry about all the trouble.
How unlucky of you to be involved in this mess.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Well, I am not doing well either.
The royal family is focusing on finding out who is pulling the strings.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
...All they can do is to sort out the puppets infiltrated into the palace.
But it is better than doing nothing.
Now... then.
Where is Skia?

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
She went to hang out with Lord Nyhill!
I don't know what she sees in the pretty boy with no substance.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Could it be...
Could it be that?
Is she enchanted by his looks?
Crux, you answer me!

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
Wha... What? Well...
It sounds plausible...
By the way, Lord Nyhill is under probation so he is not supposed to leave his room.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Well, I stand corrected. She went to visit Nyhill in his room.
...Isn't it the same thing?
Crux, cheer up...

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text:
Oh, are you leaving now?
It sure is wise of you to leave before the lady's head explodes.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text: See you later.

scripts.speaker: Crux
scripts.text: Don't mind me.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: We'd better move now since the situation doesn't look good.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
You are rather slow-footed.
It has been a while since I got the message that you came back.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
I invited you for no special reason.
Since they keep calling for meetings to discuss what has happened during the ritual.

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
There comes lord of the Heine family.
You seem to move around rather freely considering that you are under confinement.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
...?
{0}, I have something to tell you.
And about the confinement, it is OK as long as I stay in the western wing of the royal villa...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
By the way, Skia? What are you doing?
.......

scripts.speaker: Spica
scripts.text:
Skia?
She is not here now.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
Oh, this must be it.
The shadow duty.
What is going on?

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
...How could you tell at a glance?
I am busted.
Am I a bad actress?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
Even if you are twins, you don't look exactly the same.
I just noticed certain differences.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Really? I am flattered though.
I am glad that you have been looking at me, not Spica.
Why are you in that outfit?

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Hum... It is to protect Spica who will be the head of the Nerius family.
Sometimes, I stand forward instead of Spica.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
While my sister learned what the head of the family must know from our mother,
I learned to hide and fight.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
That is why people call me the shadow princess.
It is my first time attending an official event in the light.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
Anyways, I am filling in for Spica who has left to run some errands now.
I need to show how she is attending the royal banquet with grace.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: Thanks to Lady Spica, I get to move around as much as I can now...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
When will she come back?
The meeting of the representatives has been over...
What brought you here?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: I have come to deliver you the message that there is a mission for you.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: To be exact, I volunteered since I heard that you were visiting the Nerius family.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
It must be about the incident during the ritual, right?
What does the hero have to do with the royal family's business?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
Well, you can ask Spica later.
She was there in the meeting, you know.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
This conversation is getting too long.
Please go meet my grandfather and father first.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: They must be waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: Hum... I see. I shall ask Spica to fill me in with the details when she comes back.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: Then, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text: {0}, please come to see me again later!

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
I have to wait for Spica's return and change clothes.
I cannot leave now.

scripts.speaker: Skia
scripts.text:
What would happen when I get out like this and encounter Spica on the way?
We will be in trouble.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
What are you doing here, you punk?
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
How did you get in here.
Only the people with permission are allowed to be here.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
Are you the hero invited to the banquet? The Royal Assembly to be exact.
Nice to meet you. I am ^0000cdIan Walther^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: Although ^0000cdthe Walther family doesn't participate in the Royal Assembly^000000, we are attending the banquet as one of the seven royal families.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: This is the ^0000cdheir of the Walther family, Isenhonor^000000. He is my nephew.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: He will be the head of the family as he attains adulthood this year. As of now, I am in charge of the family business.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: How do you do? I am ^0000cdIsenhonor Walther^000000.
Why aren't you participating in the Royal Assembly when there is the heir?

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: I wonder of you know this, ^0000cdthe candidate from our family was involved in an unfortunate incident^000000 in the ^0000cdprevious Royal Assembly^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: ^0000cdIsenarm^000000 who was the candidate for the throne acted violently all of a sudden. ^0000cdHe ended up being killed by the heir of the Geoborg family^000000.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: After discussion, our family decided not to take part in the ^0000cdRoyal Assembly^000000 this time.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: Well then. I hope you enjoy the banquet. The banquet is held for you after all.
Yes. Thank you for sparing me some time.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
Are you enjoying the banquet?
I hope you enjoy the banquet since it is held for you.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: Long time no see, Ian.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: Why are you here? I thought we agreed ^0000cdnot to see each other ever again after the previous Royal Assembly^000000.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: I remember that, but the heir of your family has been busy these days.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text:
He has been digging around so much that the story has reached me.
No one seems to pay much attention, but you never know.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: I told Isenhonor to ^0000cdstop investigating about his brother's death^000000.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: He should. It would get us both in trouble if the fact that ^0000cdwe were going to kill the imperial candidate of the Geoborg family^000000 leaks out.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
No one knows about it, you know.
The ^0000cdplan was ruined ^000000as Isenarm was killed while acting violently.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: I am sorry about your heir.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
I don't care who becomes the heir as long as he leads the family well.
I don't understand why Isenarm who has behaved so well acted that way though...

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
He must have sensed something to act like than when he was about to be elected as the king... There is no way to find out now...
Geoborg has been silent as well ever since, I hear.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: Yes, the word has it.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
Since Isenarm was killed by Geoborg, ^0000cdthe Walther family has been excluded from the Royal Assembly^000000 this time.
He was a great boy. It is a shame since he was the perfect candidate for the throne.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text:
The important thing is that as long as we both keep silent, the truth will remain unknown forever.
Then, I guess we will never see each other again.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text:
Make sure to warn your heir not to dig around the incident, no more.
If it gets out, my family can deny it.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: However, you Ian will be in trouble as the same member of the family since there is no witness or proof left now.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text: Are you threatening me?

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text:
Shh... You'd better keep your voice down. Your heir may hear you.
I mean, we should be careful.

scripts.speaker: Man from the Richard
scripts.text: Well, I cannot be absent for so long anyway. Let me head back now.

scripts.speaker: Ian
scripts.text:
Argh... How dare...!
I shouldn't have worked with him in the first place. I lost my poor nephew for nothing.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor Walther
scripts.text:
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor Walther
scripts.text: How about cutting down some?

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: You must be an adventurer. Thank you for visiting this gloomy place.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: The representative of our family is over there. I hope you have a good time then.
Hello?

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: What are you doing here? The Banquet Hall is over there.
I was sorry that I didn't get the time to talk to you then.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: What story? You mean the story of my brother being killed for his violent behavior? You seemed to hear it so eagerly. I hope you don't believe that bullshit.
Oh, well...

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I cannot believe that my brother has acted violently. Even if he did, there must have been a ^0000cdreason.^000000

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: My brother, he must have done it for something. No one knows the truth, but people seem to believe the gossip.
If you want to clear the name of your brother, you can investigate on your own.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I am trying. But ^0000cdthe elders of my family don't want me to dig out the dishonorable incident^000000.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Also, it is impossible to meet ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000.
Wouldn't he meet you?

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: No. any access to him is blocked.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: The ^0000cdGuardian Knight^000000 and ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000 are the only people who know what has happened that day. However it is impossible to meet them. I don't know where to begin...
A Guardian Knight? Did your brother have a Guardian Knight?

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Yes. Each member of the Walther family has a Guardian Knight. Our family is in overseas trade so that we often travel by ship.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: As you know, the sailors are not a gentle bunch and we tend to carry money with us so that we are often threatened. We all have to bring Guardian Knights with us.
Where is your Guardian Knight then, Isenhonor?

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I am sick of Guardian Knights since my brother's Guardian Knight abandoned my brother and ran away. I don't want to call them Guardian Knights.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: What should I call a Guardian Knight who betrays the master and runs away?
I think it would be a good idea to start from your Guardian Knight. Since they worked together as Guardian Knight, he must know something.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text:
Well, when I asked, he told me he knew nothing. If he did, he must have told me before I even asked.
They were pretty close and often exercised together.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text:
Oh, well, since they were so close, he could have tried to defend his friend.
Why didn't I think of that...
Let me talk to him now. If I hear anything, it would be a good thing. Even if I don't get to hear anything it would still count as a try.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Why would you go through such trouble?
Well, I have a hunch. As an adventurer, my instinct says that there must be something going on.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Do all the adventurers count on their hunch like that? This could be dangerous. It is no matter to approach with a hunch.
That is why it is called an adventure. Adventurers where the adventures are.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I don't understand.
You may call it a needless meddling out of curiosity. However, I cannot neglect anyone in distress.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I appreciate your help though. I am desperate enough to accept your favor. However, I don't think you wouldn't hear much from the Guardian Knight though.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: If you want to meet him anyway, go to ^0000cdour manor in the south of Alberta^000000. He must be there.
Well then.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Adventurer, how did your meeting with the Guardian Knight in Alberta go? Not that I expect too much...

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: However, still, I have hoped to hear good news from you...

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Adventurer, you are back. How did it go?

Yes, I have something for you...
Oh? Where did it go?
I must have left it back. Let me go bring it for you.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: You are back. How did it go?
I told him the story of meeting the Guardian Knight of Isenarm and the conversation with him.
This is the ^0000cdletter^000000.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Well, this indeed is the seal of our family, and it is my brother's handwriting.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: As you said, my brother's Guardian Knight must have not betrayed my brother.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: My brother indeed must have done such a thing for a reason.
I guess this is all I can do you now.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I understand. I should take on from here. Thank you for your help.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Please come back anytime when you need the help of the Walther family.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: You are a valuable guest for us, the Walther family, from now on, dear adventurer. I'll help you anytime you want.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: Based on the piece of information you have brought me, I am collecting other information too. It is not enough year, but I believe that I can unveil the truth someday.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I called Simon from Alberta. I need to gather all the help I can get now.

scripts.speaker: Isenhonor
scripts.text: I will see you again when the truth is revealed.
Well, I am looking for the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor. Where can I find him?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I am his Guardian Knight. What's the matter? Has anything happened to him?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I shouldn't have stayed behind. Is he all right?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Kidnapping? Injury? Robbery? Fall? What is it? Oh, I should go there now...!
Calm down. Isenhonor is all right. Nothing happened. I am here to ask you something.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Phew, I guess it wasn't my lord who called me. I am still glad that I is OK.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: What are you going to ask me? Well, who are you by the way?

scripts.speaker: I told him the conversation with Isenhonor in the palace briefly.
Simon
scripts.text: Oh, sorry about that. I am ^0000cdSimon Walther Marshall^000000.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I don't know the whereabouts of ^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000 who used to be the Guardian Knight of Isenarm, unfortunately.
You both have Walther in your names. Is there a special reason for it?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Every knight belongs to the Walther who is assigned to a member of the Walther family is given the name, Walther.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: The name gives a sense of belonging. Also it gives us the pride to have been recognized as excellent knights.
Right. By the way, did you say that you know nothing about Kain Walther Walker?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text:
No, I don't.
However...
However...?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I heard a ^0000cdstrange gossip^000000 from some of the knights there when I escorted Isenhonor to the palace.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: They heard ^0000cda pickpocket locked in the basement of the palace^000000 babbling about how he had seen a person from the Walther family in a foreign country.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: However, no family member left the country due to the royal banquet. It was strange to hear that. I think that person could be ^0000cdKain^000000.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I wanted to investigate myself considering the importance of the matter. But Isenhonor ordered me to go back to Alberta so I had to come back here.
The pickpocket in the underground prison?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Yes. I don't know his real name, but he is called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 in the underworld.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Minor offenders like pickpockets are usually locked in this other place. But that guy was caught pickpocketing in Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Due to diplomatic issues, we have taken his custody and locked him in the underground prison.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: That guy seems to have a lot of information from all over the continent. Even when his words about seen the person of the Walther family wasn't true, I felt that I could get useful information from him.
Whether the information he has is true or not, I would rather go visit him. Thank you for the information.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Please say hello to my master when you get back to the palace. Tell him that I will be guarding this place well.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: And, let him know that he can call me anytime. I would gladly go there to guard him.
Yes, I'll let him know for sure.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Have a safe trip then!

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: How did your visit to the prison go?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: You can go see the convict called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 locked in the ^0000cdUnderground prison of the palace^000000.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Didn't you hear anything else from Isenhonor? Please extend my greetings to him when you go to Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: Dear adventurer! At last, Master Isenhonor called me! I am happy that I can guard my lord nearby.
Glad to hear that. Then what are you doing here now?

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I am waiting for the ship to Izlude. I will rush to the ship when it comes here.

scripts.speaker: Simon
scripts.text: I have a lot of questions for you, but I guess I'd better hear the story from my master. Then dear adventurer, have a safe trip!

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
What if anything happens to my master while I am gone...
Shall I leave for Prontera now?

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
No, he will be mad at me.
He will call me someday. Let's wait here.

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text: Just a little more.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: What a fine day. However, the house feels to empty and lonely.
Hello? Is this the manor of the Walther family?

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: Yes, it is. What brought you here. Since everyone has left for Prontera, you cannot meet the master now.
Isenhonor has sent me here to meet the Guardian Knight.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: Oh, really? He has been waiting for Isenhonor's call so much! I am happy for him.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: Simon, the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor is near the ^0000cddock^000000 where the ship leaving for ^0000cdIzlude^000000 is anchored.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: He is waiting there to go to Prontera as soon as possible when Isenhonor calls him.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: Go to where the ship to Izlude is anchored.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: Mahatra Mornen, the butler of the Alkish family, I cannot take his arrogance anymore.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: They only own a manor. And they call themselves as the best family in Alberta? What do they think of the Walther family!

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: They cannot even make eye contact when they meet us.

scripts.speaker: Butler for the Walthers
scripts.text: Our master is just too gentle to leave them alone. How classless.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
Argh! Not again! I am terrified!
But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I would marry anyone who brings them to me.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Argh! Not again! I am terrified! But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
Bigfoot?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Oh no! I won't eat that! I don't want to have another bite of that pigs feed! I may not be a gourmet, but my tongue hasn't been decomposed or anything!

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Bring me something I can eat! I know that I am locked in the prison, but I deserve to eat something edible!
There must have been a misunderstanding. I am not the warden here. I came here to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: You are now? I am relieved to hear that. The food here just sucks.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Who are you by the way? You look like an adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Well, it is not important. You are here to ask me something, right? You know nothing in this world is free.
...What do you want?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Get me out of here.
It would be beyond my ability.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Don't be such a perfectionist. You must be of a high rank to come down here, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Well, I understand. I knew it was a difficult favor to ask anyway.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I didn't think you would let me out. I just got it out loud.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: However, you turned it down so firmly. You could at least pretend to consider or think about it.
What do you really want then?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Money of course. The price depends on the information you want.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I don't offer a monthly installment plan. I only take cash. I only accept currencies older than 2 years. I'll spend it meaningfully when I get out here in the future.
I don't have much money, but I know where to spend it. I guess I should turn down the deal. Goodbye then.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Hey! Don't take the joke too seriously. Don't your friends call you stubborn?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I knew it. You give up too easily. You are still young, you know.
Please get to the point.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Well, you remind me of something...

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Yes! Bring me fried spicy dumplings and green salad! That's right! Bring me that.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I cannot eat the horrible food here much so I keep thinking about the food out there.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: What I crave the most is that. Would you do this for me at least? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
I can do that. Wait for me.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: You don't have to tell me to wait. I cannot go anywhere.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
Wait, you stop there for a moment.
I don't smell the greasy dumplings and fresh salad at all.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Did you bring the food? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I won't talk before you bring them to me! Check again and bring them!

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I smell it! This smell! Take out what you have brought.
Here you are.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Oh, my love. I'll enjoy every bite of it. Well, ask me the question now.
I heard that you saw a person of the Walther family in a foreign country. Where did you see him? How did you know that he was from the Walther family?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
Oh, you wanted to know that. As you know, it is rare to see seafarer Walthers in other places of Rune-Midgarts, except Alberta and Prontera.
They are good at hiding their identities other than those who are well known.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: However, I saw the distinctive symbol of the family in ^0000cdVeins^000000.
Veins? Who did you see there? And how?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I don't know who he is. I was working as always. You know you have to work to make ends meet.
You mean pickpocketing?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: You don't have to be so specific about it. Don't you want to hear the story? Well, don't worry. I do have a sense of honor. I'll keep my promise to you who has brought me the dumplings.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Anyways, I found a shabby man who seemed so defenseless in the market there. His wallet was fat. So I took it and went off.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I opened the wallet in a secluded corner of the market. He turned out to be quite loaded. And I found an ^0000cdold letter^000000 in there. The one stamped with the ^0000cdseal^000000, you know.
The fact that he had the letter doesn't prove that he was a person from the Walther family.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Hey, I am getting there. After checking what was in the wallet, I was going to call it a day. I had earned enough.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Then, that shabby man appeared.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: I don't have to tell you the rest of the story, right? Whoa... I thought I was fighting three men at the same time. His fist was like...! Phew... When he was punching me, I saw it.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: There was a hidden ^0000cdsword^000000 under his cloak. The ^0000cdhandle was engraved with the symbol^000000. You see, well. Do you believe my story now?
How did you manage to see that when you were beaten up so bad?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Oh, have some faith. Don't you know what I do for living?
You mean pickpocketing?

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Hey, don't be so specific, please!

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Anyways, my profession required a sharp eye to catch whatever is significant at a glance. That's how I thrive in this field.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: When I see a person, I need to identify the position of the wallet, any weapon in possession, the target's wits and how fast the target can run in a moment. This job required such a special quality.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
You don't have to believe me, but you can trust my professional skill.
Well, you must have hidden your money inside the belt and your shoes. Nice work. Those are tough spots to steal from.
OK, I guess I can trust your skill.
Anyways, it sure seems suspicious. Thank you for your information.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Don't you need anything else? I want to have some dessert now.
No. This is enough.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Oh, no! Dessert! My dessert!

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
What is it? Did you change your mind?
Do you want more information? I'd really like to have some Mastela Fruit Wine.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text:
Did you forget where to go?
You should go to ^0000cdVeins^000000.

scripts.speaker: Bigfoot
scripts.text: Bring me some dessert when you come back!

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text:
You seem to carry a heavy burden.
How about cutting down some?

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text:
I want to go back...
There again...

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text:
Who are you? Why are you staring at me? Are you after my wallet too?
It hasn't been long since I sent a person who stole my wallet to the prison.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: I guess no such information is shared among the pickpockets. Get lost if you don't want to be sent to prison.

You are quite quick-tempered, aren't you.
^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: I don't know such name.
The one who betrayed his master.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text:
Who... Who are you? Reveal yourself!
Why are you telling me such a thing?
People say that. I don't buy it though.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Why don't you believe it? Why? Do you know anything about it?
You are the one who knows the truth, Kain Walther Walker.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Tell me. Who are you? Do you know anything about the death of Isenarm?

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Your life depends on your answer. I have enough reason to kill you since you know who I am.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text:
Well, tell me.
Who are you? How did you find me? And what do you know about the death of Isenarm?
I am asked to investigate the death of Isenarm by Isenhonor.
While carrying out the investigation, I got the information that you would be here. I came here to meet you.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Isenhonor? At last, he is in action!

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Oh, please excuse my bad manners. I am sorry. Please forgive my earlier behavior.
That's OK. It wouldn't hurt to be careful, Kain Walther Walker.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text:
I cannot use the name, Walther, anymore.
When a star disappears, its satellite shall lost its name too. Even worse, I am a sinner who haven't been able to my star.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Is Isenhonor investigating the death of Isenarm? I will do my best to help him by his side.
Not yet. Isenhonor wants to know the truth behind his brother's death, but he is not in the position to carry out the investigation due to the circumstances.
That's why I, who is relatively free to move around, am is doing the research for him.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Is that so... Then what can I do to help you? I'll do whatever I can do to reveal the truth.
You can tell me what happened when you were with Isenarm. Why you disappeared before Isenarm's death, why you are here and all.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: In fact I know nothing about his death myself. However, he ^0000cdsent me here with a mission^000000 before incident broke out.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: When I was going to go back after completing the mission, he sent me a lot of money and a ^0000cdletter^000000. It said ^0000cdnot to return to Rune-Midgarts^000000.
And then?

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: I heard the news of his death after few days. I wanted to go back, but I couldn't because of his last order. I couldn't even be there by his side...

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: After a long time, I heard the rumor about the violent behavior which caused Isenarm to be killed.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: And also the story of the Guardian Knight who betrayed his master...

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: When I became a wanted man, I wanted to back and tell the truth. However, the letter said ^0000cdnot to return no matter what^000000. I couldn't let down the last order given by my master.
I guess Isenarm didn't want you to be involved. If anything happened to him, you would have been the one in the biggest trouble.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Ha... Perhaps... I didn't think of that... Here are the ^0000cdletter and sword Isenarm^000000 has give me.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Please give them to Isenhonor. I hope they help him recover his brother's honor.
Keep the sword. The sword is like the life of the knight. I believe Isenarm would want you to have it.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Then, have a safe travel.

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Did you deliver the letter and the words to Isenhonor well?

scripts.speaker: K
scripts.text: Please let him know that I am ready to devote my life if he needs my help.

He is lying in bed, deeply wounded.
It doesn't seem that he is in the state to talk.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
How disrespectful of you to enter without permission.
Get out of here now.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: Please, calm down.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Why don't you enjoy the banquet?
Nyhill went to the Banquet Hall too.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
He didn't make a good first impression, but he is not a bad kid...
He is just...

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: Well, I guess I shouldn't talk more.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
You are here at last.
The archduke has been waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Nillem said he would visit your room after making all preparations. You may wait in your room.
We are counting on you.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
I have heard the story from my father.
I have received the approval for you to access the Past Memories of the Royal Family freely.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Let's talk about the Past Memories of the Royal Family tomorrow
Since you must be tired going through all the trouble today.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Are you going back to that place?
Nillem has told me.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: That it is difficult for him to connect multiple times since he is just a human after all.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
I appreciate your efforts for the royal family.
But don't push yourself too hard.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
You are here, just in time.
Are you going there again today?
Yes.
No.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
I see.
...Oh, do you know what Nyhill is doing?

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
.....Never mind.
He must be staying quietly since he has been sentenced to disciplinary confinement.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: Then, good bye.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Sorry about all the trouble.
I hope it works this time.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: Please save the piece of Ymir Heart from Valkyrie.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
...I know it is almost impossible to change the past.
But there is no other way.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: We need to try everything we can do.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: While you are on a mission down there, we are proceeding with the investigation.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
We are searching for the lead to the intruders.
Let's play our parts well.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Nillem must be waiting for you.
Please do your best as always.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
You are back.
Is it the same this time?
I suppose so.
But, I really don't think all the efforts will go wasted.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Thank you very much.
Someday, when you need the power of our family,
We will be on your side no matter what.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
That is all we can give you for now as the reward.
I am sorry that we cannot offer you more.
I'll make sure there is no inconvenience to you while living in the palace.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: See you tomorrow then.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text:
You must be the returned hero invited to the banquet.
This banquet is for you. Please enjoy.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: Haha... The archduke must be very angry.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: I have participated in the Royal Assembly, but I wonder if it has been the right decision.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: I tried to do this for everyone, but it seems to cause trouble.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: People tells me that I am a strong candidate in this, but I cannot be so sure.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: I keep thinking about what a great responsibility it is, how harder I should try and all...

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: Not that I can step back now. I guess all I can do is to do my best.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: I have never allowed your visit.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I am busy.
Please come back later

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
...It was a shame to cause such a scene
In front of a guest.
I apologize on the behalf of the Heine family.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Let me introduce myself.
I am the current head of the Heine family, Friedrich Stoltze Heine.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: This is the former head of the family, Archduke Grantz, my father.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: My name is Kronecker Grantz Heine.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich Stoltze
scripts.text: This is Peter Heine the candidate to the throne.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text:
Nice to meet you.
It has turned out this way.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: The one who has left the room, making a fool of himself, is my son, Nyhill.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
He is a lineal family member of the Heine family.
But he still acts like a child like that.
Please excuse his bad manners.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Let him do whatever he pleases.
We cannot take care of him anymore.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text:
...Archduke, please don't be too harsh on Nyhill.
In fact, Nyhill was supposed to be the candidate to the throne.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text: I am just a collateral member of the family after all...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Stop it there. There is no need for more words.
Nyhill doesn't have what it takes to be the king.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
He doesn't have any elements to meet the legitimacy of the family. He cannot be chosen as the candidate.
He doesn't even know where he stands but still seems so hungry for power.

scripts.speaker: Peter
scripts.text:
It doesn't seem that way...
He must have been disheartened since his right has been neglected.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
The right of the Heine family is everything which comes with the name of Heine.
Nyhill has everything.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Why doesn't that child realize it?
It is not appropriate to talk about the family matter in front of the guest.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Sorry about that.
Phew... I wonder what we have done to deserve a punk like that in the family.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I have heard that you are the one who would attend the ritual.
Gratefully enough, the next king might be from the Heine family.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: In the Royal Assembly earlier in which the candidates for the throne were tested...

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Isenarm of the Walther family who happened to be the strongest candidate of all threatened other candidates all of a sudden.
Ernst of the Geoborg family had to execute him.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
It seemed that Ernst was going to be named the next king, but he abruptly resigned.
...I guess he obeyed the will of the queen.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Due to the course of events, the Royal Assembly would be held again.
This time, Peter will participate as the representative of the Heine family.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
And that Nyhill is so jealous of him now.
How low can he be?

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Hum... He actually is not a bad kid unlike his earlier words.
He has never acted to bring disgrace to the name of Heine.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
I am not trying to defend him because he is my son.
Nyhill, he is just...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Don't try to speak for him. His incompetence is a sin.
Great magical power runs in the Heine for generations.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: There is a reason that he is called Mijeria.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
Don't be overly curious of our family matter.
Phew... I guess I will see you again later.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
The Royal Assembly will be over soon, and the ritual will be carried out when the final decision is made.
Enjoy the banquet until then and participate in the ritual.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
It wouldn't long before Royal Assembly is over.
We have to prepare for it. Sorry that we cannot spend more time with you.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: Go visit other families if you have not visited them all.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
The Royal Assembly will be over soon.
As we expected, Peter seems to be a strong candidate.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
How are you enjoying the banquet?
As soon as the Royal Assembly is completed, we will move to proceed with the final ritual...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I'll send you a Court Mage.
Enjoy the banquet and go back to your room in time.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
I have been waiting for you.
Although I feel reluctant to reveal somewhat embarrassing part of the royal family to you,

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It was the royal family of Rune-Midgarts who let you observe the ritual anyway.
And you were the one who fought the intruders during the incident...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Without preamble,
Those intruders must have been after the^4d4dff piece of Imir Heart^000000.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: We didn't know what was in the Room of Consciousness was ^4d4dffa fake piece of Imir Heart^000000.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: We searched through the records of ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 for the record of that part.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
We couldn't find any.
The only lead we got was a riddle.
You mean, the ones who know the truth?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
You must have seen it in the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
You are more cunning than I have thought of you.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
What should we do to find out the truth?
We would have to go back in the time to the past.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text: Frietz, how did it go?

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
I found a Court Mage who specialized in that field.
He said that ^4d4dffhe sensed a huge twist of magical force in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, and we could depend on him^000000.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
He will bring the result soon.
He said he would connect the crack of the dimension by force.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
He acts rather imprudently, but he is said to be quite skilled...
And you know him.
Is he Nillem?

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
You seem to know him too.
You're right.
I want you to pair up with Nillem for this mission.
Me? Why?

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
I'd like know that myself.
That Nillem pestered me to let him work with you.
...I tried my best not to slay him.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
The Past Memories of the Royal Family is a special place which can be accessed by the royal families and few other people.
We cannot risk getting more people involved in this to keep the secret.

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text: Sine you have already experienced the crack of dimension...

scripts.speaker: Friedrich
scripts.text:
We didn't have any other choices.
We will reward you handsomely. Please help us out.
If you say so...

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
Them, it's settled.
We will send Nillem to your room as soon as he is ready.
You may pair up with him for the mission.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
And this is what has been given to the ones contributed to the royal family.
You have received it once when you went down there right after you came to the palace. Do you remember?

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It must be useful to people like you.
I hope it helps.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
The magician called Nillem will find you.
You may wait in your room.

scripts.speaker: Kronecker
scripts.text:
It is too early to lose our hope.
I believe you will do just fine.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: How about cutting down some?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
The Roegenburg welcomes adventurers with various experiences, but it is somewhat early for us to work with you.
I hope I will see you later.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
How could you come in here?
Nobody can come into this place if you are not a staff. Please go outside.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Hello, adventurers. I am honored you have visited the ^0000cdRoegenburg^000000. I am ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: We are one of seven royal families that found the kingdom and have work hard for Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, the heir of our family, is supposed to participate in the royal assembly. How about seeing him?

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Hello, I am ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000.
Hello, I'm invited to this banquet. {0} It is nice to see you.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: I am honored to see the hero who defeated Morocc. Please enjoy your time while you are in the Roegenburg.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: If you have time, how about seeing the rest people of the Roegenburg?

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Brother, it will be helpful to listen to the story of the family from ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
Yes, it is a good opportunity, of course.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Did you see the children of the Roegenburg? They look like babies, but now when I see them in the palace, I am pleased that they are almost grown up.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: You met Helmut already. It will be helpful to you if you meet the second son, Wolf.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: He is in charge of all matters of the Roegenburg instead of the first son who is busy for participation in the royal assembly and protection of the border. You will hear lots of interesting stories.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The Roegenburg is proud that we are descents of Wilhelm, the national hero, and contributed to the foundation and development of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Therefore, we hoped that the children could grow into decent adults, but they were raised without their parents' care and now they tend to behave rudely and act as they want.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: If you feel uncomfortable when you talk with them, please understand kindly.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: They are the children who will lead the family, but they are going different from what the Roegenburg aims for.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The first son stays on the front, risking his life everyday and the second is doing business, which is against the family tradition.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The third son would leave the house and hang out on the back street, but we cannot continue to employ some to monitor him all the times.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: But the youngest, Agnes, has grown as good girl and I am happy when I think of her.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Ah, I am sorry to talk too much on our family. I have become talkative as I get old.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Please forgive me grumbling and forget this old man's complaints.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Myer, Myer...
I cannot believe that Myer did that.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: He spread the bad rumor about the family but I think he did it because he is desperate.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I have let the children do as they want but I wanted to avoid a war.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: But I know it is unlikely that Helmut becomes a king and so leave them to do as they like.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
However, I would like to leverage this opportunity to collect the capabilities of the family members to protect the family.
Opportunities are found in times of crisis.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Please bring Helmut. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
Please.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Welcome adventurer. Did you have a safe travel?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I cannot see Helmut. Did he refuse to come?
Yes, he left a message for two of you.

scripts.speaker: Told Maximilian and Wolf about Helmut's will and the successorship
Maximilian
scripts.text:
I knew something when Helmut left, but I didn't expect that he would give up the successorship.
But if that is what Helmut wants, I don't object to it.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: This fact will be announced as soon as the royal assembly and banquet are finished. Wolf, now you should lead our family. I hope this will not be a burden to you.
You have taken a firm attitude that you never showed before.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Once I tried to move the children as I want and failed. Since then I left them to do as they like. But now I know.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I realized that a new age needs children. I will work for the family and country in the way the children wants to do.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I seem to have forced my way to Helmut and people in the family.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: There is something rather than a war to have influence up to every corner in the continent.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: As Myer said, I am looking for other approaches and I will.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, if you don't mind, won't you deliver my will to ^0000cdMyer^000000?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: That I have given up wars and am looking for better solution and that if he can, visit the family and see the people.
I am willing to do so.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Please deliver the story of Helmut to Myer.
He must be somewhere in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, welcome.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you deliver the message to Myer? what did he say?
He said it is good to give up wars. Myer has a lot of trust in you. He said he would help you as much as he can, if you need his help.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I want him to visit us more than to help me.
Ah, he also said he would come after the banquet is finished.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Well I am happy that our relationship will improve.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Once, we were the closest friends, but the relationship became awkward after he left the family.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Anyway, I think we have to make preparation to welcome him seriously.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I am glad that now everything has found its place. I have been worried a lot.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: All theses things are thanks to you. I feel safe now that everyone has their right places and will work hard for the family and country.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Dear adventurer. Thank you very much for helping my family. I have been thinking how I can reward you for your contribution, but cannot find anything that is comparable to the magnitude of thank.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: However at least to express my mind, I have prepare a small present. Please take it.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: If you need a help from the Roegenburg, come to use anytime. The gate of the Roegenburg is always opened to you.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I wanted to thank you always. Thanks to your contribution, my family is returning to safety.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: It seems that my family had no problem, but inside the wall, we didn't have trust in one another and were not mixed.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: But now we are getting along. Thank you very much again.

scripts.speaker: Agnes Roegenburg
scripts.text: Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Hello, nice to meet you.
Did you visit to see my grandfather?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
If so, he is over there. You can find him there.
Then, have a good time.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Did you see my brothers?
If you don't, make sure to see Wolf and have talk with him.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Nowadays, he shares many works with my grandfather and he has a lot to talk with you.
So the time for me to talk with him is quite reduced though.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
The banquet has started but I haven't yet found any body who I go with.
Originally Wolf is supposed to go with me, but it is canceled as he became busy.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
If he had told me earlier he cannot go, I wouldn't have refused all those proposals.
Myer said he would go with me, but I am afraid he may leave as wind anytime.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
I don't want anything big...
When we were young, we played together. They read me books.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
I still like the best the books that my brothers read me.
Those princes and princesses in those books were all my friend.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Recently I read a story on a knight who sacrifices himself for a lady.
In the story, the lady handed a pretty handkerchief to the knight.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Then, I realized that what I had lacked.
It was a pretty handkerchief.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
So I carry lots of pretty handkerchiefs so that I can hand them to my knight anytime.
But there is no one for me to hand my handkerchiefs to...

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Did you see him too?
He came with Myer.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
He is so handsome. I wonder what family he is from.
I am sorry that I left so early that I couldn't talk with him at all. I asked Myer who he is, but he didn't tell me.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer?
Wolf is looking for you. Do you have an appointment with him?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Why don't you visit Wolf?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: He is my brother, but he and other brothers are so childish.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Go out to the street in Prontera and ask 5-year old children, even they know the answer.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: They are overlooking something bigger due to their personal desires. Of course, I also hate them and want to take revenge, but it does not solve the problem.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: If they had thought about how the citizens of the kingdom can live more happily, they would not have acted like that.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Anyway, let's wait and see, as they are trying to think like adults.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: But I feel safe that my grandfather stays with me.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: You seem to have come to see my brothers? but there is no one in the house.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: In a long time, we were together, but they left and I am lonely again. It is nice that they don't fight one another any more.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, welcome back.
Pearls? soft hairs? Have you brought them?
Ah, it is....

Here you are.
Am I too late?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Not yet? OK. We have still time.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: You forget what I asked didn't you? ^0000cdThey are three {0} and 50 strands of {1}^000000.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Please don't be late!

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: No! you have brought all of them. I'm so happy!

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: I'll take pearls to the jeweler, the best jeweler. They are so pretty!

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: I'll send soft hairs too. I wonder what they will turn into.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Ah, I need a handkerchief. There are so many things to do and I'm so busy.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Oh, I would like to thank you for working hard for me. Here you are.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: And Can I ask you to get more? I am afraid that cloth is not sufficient.
I guess so. I will help you to the best of my ability.
Yes, I will.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: You really understand me. I'm so happy.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Thank you very much

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: See you tomorrow. Have a nice day.

A serious thing happened!!!

Or your brother started fight again?

No, it's more serious.
I need your help desperately!

OK, then I will prepare for fight.
Wait a second.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: What ?
What..?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Why do you prepare to fight?
You said a serious thing happened. Then, is there anything serious other than a large war?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
It is not light that.
Fighting is not all about living.
Then what is it?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
I heard from Myer that he is sorry that he cannot come with me to the banquet. He said that he would send a handsome guy as my partner instead him.
and that I should prepare to go with him.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: He said that the substitute is so good-looking that I would like him when I see him. I am sure that a very handsome, as Myer is choosy.

That sounds nice.
By the way, I don't understand the 'serious thing' you said.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: I mean I prepared a dress that I choose thinking that I would go with Myer. And now the partner has changed and I have to prepare considering him.
Yes, you should!!!

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: I expected you would agree as a woman like me.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Do you understand?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: There are so many things I have to consider, such as his hair color, eye color, clothes color and shape. I asked Myer about him, but he didn't tell me.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Once he visits, it will be late. So I have to finish preparation in advance, regardless of how he wears.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: To prepare for different situations, such as hair colors and clothes color, I need ^0000cdlots of dresses^000000. Do you understand what I mean?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Therefore, I told my grandfather that I want to have some more dresses to prepare for all situations, but he said that what I have now is enough. Does it make sense?
That is nonsense!
You are beautiful enough with the clothes you are wearing now.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Yes!!!

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Oh, no. I am not.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: I talked with Wolf too but He said the same thing as grandfather. I should ask somebody to do me a favor unless he doesn't listen to me.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: So I talked with Myer. He told me to talk with you. He also said that if you cannot get a dress, buy the materials and make one. He said that is how they on the street.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: So I hired very skillful person who can make a dress and accessories, but the key is materials. I guess that you are very experienced and can get what I need.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: If I go out to get a dress, I may be the first princess in Rune-Midgarts who dies for a dress. So would you please save me from this situation?

Of course, I'll do my best to help you.
You need cloth, accessories and dyes don't you?
Hmm.. how can I help you?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Yes, you are right!
You understand me very well! I like you very much.

scripts.speaker: Agnes

scripts.speaker: Agnes
