scripts.text:
If you want to listen to the story of my family, see my ^0000cdgrandfather^000000 who is over there.
He will explain better than me.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
Did you see my brother, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000?
He is in charge of all household matters helping our grandfather while I am away here on the front.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: If you want to know about the Roegenburg, it will be a quality time.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: I am glad that I come back home and can see the family members.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: But when I think of the front threatened by the monster, I feel heavy-hearted. Of course, I believe that my men are doing well to protect the territory.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
I want to run back to them as soon as the banquet is finished.
This place is somewhat stuffy to me.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, hello.
I am ^0000cdKalbern^000000 and a chamberlain of Helmut.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: I served Helmut in a harsh front in the border area. Now I am in Prontera, the capital city of Rune-Midgarts and I cannot adapt to this situation

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: I also lose my nerve when I see noble people and royal family in the palace.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: I didn't recognize when I served Helmut on the front but here, he seems a little away as I feel that he is the heir of a royal family.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: He treated solders and working children equally. So everybody liked him and followed him.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: I also thank him for accepting me after my parents were killed by the monster.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: To repay his kindness, I begged him to serve him and I am staying with him...

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: Here, I have nothing to do for Helmut except bring him some beer.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: I wish that the banquet is finished and go back early.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text:
But, I don't mean that I don't want him to become a king.
I am just uncomfortable to be here.

scripts.speaker: Wolf Roegenburg
scripts.text: Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
Thank you for visiting the Roegenburg.
Won't you see my grandfather and patriarch of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: He enjoys talking with adventurers.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, it is a honor to have you in the Roegenburg.
I am the second son of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: To carry on the will of Wilhelm Roegenburg, a national hero, we, at the Roegenburg, are making lots of efforts to protect honor, justice and traditions.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Since the foundation of Rune-Midgarts, lots of people from the Roegenburg have made contribution to the country and this is our pride.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Currently ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, who is an excellent candidate for the throne, is participating in the royal assembly. Did you see him?
Yes. I saw him just before. Who is this?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, it is nice to see you. I am ^0000cdAgnes Roegenburg^000000 and the youngest of the four of the Roegenburg.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Do you have a partner to go with to the banquet? I have no one to go with. No one takes my fancy.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Agnes, don't say that. it is not appropriate. We are telling the adventurer of the story of the Roegenburg...

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Now, will my prince come with me?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Ah, Myer, brother! brother!

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
Thanks for coming at the right time. Dear adventurer,
This is ^0000cdMyer Roegenburg^000000 and he is the third son of the Roegenburg.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I was away for a long time and have just came back. It is right, isn't?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Well, about half. I heard that ^0000cda war manic and a peddler would join hands and participate in the royal assembly^000000.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: So I came back for a short stay. I heard that the relationship between brothers was not close but has suddenly deeper. I cannot be out.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
What your language. ^0000cdEven though you go outside and hang out with low fellows,^000000 you don't have make the place where you live a dirty back street.
You didn't think that I am ignorant of the fellows that you hang out with, did you?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Of course I know that grandfather and you sent people to monitor me. They were so awkward and all other fellow knew it.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text:
My noble brother doesn't like my way of speaking?
If we join hands and ^0000cdHelmut becomes a king^000000,^0000cdthe whole country will ^000000turn into a back street except the palace. Isn't it better to hear it now to reduce the shock you will have later?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Well, you may not hear as you will stay at home and calculate the money you will make from wars.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
You are unbelievably rude. I told you should call me politely.
Until when are you going to act like that?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Stop all of you! We have gathered here for fight. This is a banquet for the adventurer. We shouldn't do this in front of the adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Especially you lack dignity. What would the adventurer think of us?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Yes, you are right. I think I am the unwelcome guest. I'd better leave. Agnes, I'll come back later.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Oh my god, I forgot. I have to make preparations!

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Sorry for this unpleasant situation. I never meant to do so. Apologies if you feel uncomfortable. Myer made rude remarks as he came back in a long time.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I will tell him to make a polite apology to you later. Actually he is different from what you saw. Please understand kindly.
No, it is ok with me.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: By the way, dear adventurer, can you do me a favor if you have time?
Yes, pleas go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I hope you will visit the Wigner and bring a thing from ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Originally, I should do that, but I think I need to talk with Myer seriously. So I would like to do that for me...

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: So, please do it for me. Of course, you may refuse it. But I wonder I can find a reliable person like you.
It is a test to find that I am reliable.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Ah, no it is not. If you feel unpleasant, I am sorry. I just don't have reliable person.
Ok. Go to the Wigner and ask Isaac Wigner for the thing that you requested. Is that right?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Yes. right.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
Walk along the ^0000cdcorridor. The Wigner is in the last room^000000.
Find Isaac and bring the thing I requested.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I am very sorry to cause inconvenience to you.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, how is it going? I see you have nothing. It seem that you haven't brought it yet.
You just go to the ^0000cdWigner and bring a thing from Isaac^000000.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you bring the thing? Oh, you have brought it. Thank you very much.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Oh, the box's lock is protected by ^0000cdpassword^000000.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: The first cell has a number ^0000cd1^000000 and the next four cells are empty and you should enter numbers into them.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Hmm.. This is simple. This perfectly ^0000cdbeautiful box is a hint^000000... The answer is always included in the question.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Looking at the answer, it really seems that the Wigner people love ^0000cdnumers and gold^000000. Will you try to solve it too?
How come you ask me to decipher the password. And isn't it a secret thing?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Because you are reliable person. Just do it for fun.
Then, I think the answer is this:

Hm... It is not the answer.
I think I need some time for contemplation.

1618. It stands for 1.618 which is the golden ratio.
Well it sounds too easy.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: But what is inside is not easy.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: The thing put in the small bottle in the box will change the dynamics of combats and wars, though it is in a testing stage.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
You are a reliable person as I expected.
I was sorry when I asked you to do me a favor. We will reward you generously.
It is OK. there is message from Isaac.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: What is that?
Recently, there is a ^0000cdrumor^000000 circulating in Prontera about the Roegenburg and Helmut Roegenburg.
It was not a good rumor. He asked me to inspect it and check if it is true.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
A rumor about you? I didn't know about it... Rumor.....
I need to check it, but there is no person we count on...

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Excuse me, dear adventurer?
Yes?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Can you do me a favor again? I cannot do it myself, as there could be a problem when I do it myself.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: All staff I can have trust in are doing other jobs and I have no person except you.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: You can get information easily traveling around and what is more important is that I can trust you.
Well, it is not easy but....

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: If you are busy, you may refuse it. I am sorry that I ask you to do me a favor. My brother came back suddenly and it drives me out of my mind and busy.
No, that is a thing I can do. Then see you soon.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I don't know how to thank you. It is the most accurate to hear the rumor from children. I heard that children gather in a ^0000cdlarge open space^000000 in Prontera..

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Then, see you soon.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
What is the rumor about Roegenburg that is circulating in Prontera.
I didn't know there is a rumor about our family circulating

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
I had to start gather information earlier. I couldn't because I was busy due to others.
I didn't expect at all that a rumor will be circulating.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
I cannot wait to know what rumor is circulating about our family.
Then see you soon.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Hi, you look a little tired.
Ah, do I? I had to do some errands to find the rumor.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Oh, I am sorry about that. I should have done that.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Rumor? what rumor? I like such thing very much.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: I really want know about it too.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I am sorry to make you tired. Did you find anything?
Yes, I found the rumor and it was pretty specific. Can I tell about it here?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Yes, it is ok. If the rumor is about our family, everyone has to listen, so that we can gather and develop a solution.

scripts.speaker: I changed the rumor I got from children to a relatively softer version and told them.

scripts.text: These days everybody talks about the rumor. I think it will spread throughout Rune-Midgarts as well as Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: The rumor is....very.... specific and malicious. It must be circulated on purpose by someone who knows the circumstances of my family.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Do yo mean the bad guy is one of us? OMG! this is very serious!

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Yes. ^0000cdMyer^000000? How much are you going to disgrace our family?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Well, as much as needed?

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Myer, did you really do that?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Myer did that?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Myer, is this true? Did you spread the rumor?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: You collected small kids and played a leader. Did you have lots of fun?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Did you see what those little kids did for this time? You believe that only the upper class can exert influence on the common people, don't you? You must be so stupid.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: How far are you going to go?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Well, I asked for help church friends, merchant friends and back street friends. Everyone said they would be willing to help me, when I told them I need help.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: I wonder how you can deal with invisible enemy.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I don't understand why you spread such a rumor and do all these things.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: No, in fact, I think I know very well. It is because of your immature sympathy and you want to spoil my plan!

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Plan? what plan? war plan? the plan to drive innocent people to the battle field? A means that will realize your ambicous plan?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: You are too young to understand why your brothers want to realize our plans.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: ^0000cd14 years ago^000000, we could do nothing though we were the top family. We felt a feeling of helplessness. Have you ever felt that?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: ^0000cdA noble family is not so good as it looks^000000. You are just playing a leader on the back street and spoiling our plan entirely!

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Your plan is to develop the power of the family and unify the continent. Then what? what will you have. Achievement? Revenge?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: As you know, such as thing causes another pain. We were raised without a parent. But we didn't fall because we had a family and we were rich.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: And we had brothers ^0000cdto depend on^000000. Think how we did to comfort one another? There are not many people that are so lucky as we were.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: There are so many people who has no one to depend on, no place to lie their bodies, or no money to buy a piece of bread. People are dying everywhere.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: The world you and Helmut are dreaming is only for ^0000cdthe satisfaction of a few persons^000000.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Yo are too ideal. Small sacrifice is a must to achieve a bing goal.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Sacrifice for the goal? Do you think I don't know the reason you are helping Helmut.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: When Helmut participated in the Royal Assembly, I didn't care about it. Anyway he is naive and doesn't know how to acquire likeability and credibility from others.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: The wish that Helmut could end up as just a wish, but since you started to support Helmut ambiguously, everything has changed.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Helmut and you look like a good brothers, but Wolf, I know that you want to make money from wars and

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: even though Helmut becomes a king, he is just a figurehead and you will exert power ^0000cdover our family and kingdom^000000. won't you?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: What is our family proud of? Name? Fame? they are useless outside the country. And now they are not so high as before.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: But look at the Wigner. Wherever they go whatever they do, people bow their heads in front of their gold.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: To whoever has gold. I want that power. I want ^0000cdreal power^000000 rather powerless fame.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: You want to build a kingdom that you want rule as you want. What if Helmut fails to be a king? What would you do then?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: You will run into a limit as the second son of the Roegenburg, can you give up your ambition?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Anyway life is short. What moves people is heart, not money or power.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Heart? Does it work on ^0000cdthose guys^000000?

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: You didn't know you can approach them in a different way

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: You are better than I expected. You are grown up and I know you will not cry any more in front of me. So stop talking nonsense and play outside.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Watch your mouth. I cannot be nice to you forever.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: If you do nothing, I do nothing. I hope I will live on the back street as happy ^0000cdJonathan^000000.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: But you are developing a murder weapon as new business item with the Wigner.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: How can people trust you when your family does not trust you? I cannot trust you! And I told you to stop treating me as a child!

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Both of you,

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Stop! What the hell are you fighting? Didn't all of us want to live happier than anybody?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: So, everybody pursues happiness in their own ways. Helmut had found it on the front. Wolf on the money. And Myer on the street.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text:
Isn't it enough? Do you need something bigger? Cause? Revenge? War?
Everyone is fighting in this family and losing important thins. Still you want a war?

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: What do we really want? Well, if we can be happy by fighting, it is good!. But it is not. We have fought too long.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: All of you, Helmut, Wolf and Myer.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Everybody calm down. It is not nice to raise our voices.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Agnes is right. Both of you, please stop fighting.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: ...Excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Agnes
scripts.text: Myer! where are you going? Are going to leave the family again?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: What do you think. I totally agree with Agnes. I think we have fought one another too long.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: But we have to keep in mind that revenge brings revenge in return and violence brings violence in return.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Do you know why I have been quiet though I lost my son and daughter-in-law.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Because revenges does not make a difference. Revenge is another type of violence that only gives a temporary satisfaction.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The dead never comes back. Your parents would not want you to take revenge.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I have let you do as you want to do, but this time I hope that you will follow what Agnes said. I want to avoid wars if possible.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
......
Excuse me too.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: Lord Helmut! where are you going?
I don't want to break in, but many people are afraid of wars,
including children. It would be better if a war didn't break out, but nothing is good if unrest and feat last long.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Ah, I am sorry that you saw

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Apologies for making you uncomfortable. I am sorry again but can you do me a favor?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I think we need to inform ^0000cdWigner^000000 of the rumor. Please wait a while.

scripts.speaker: Wolf prepares documents for a while and seal it in an envelope.
Wolf
scripts.text: Please deliver this document. Sorry again. I cannot find time as I have much to do suddenly.
No. I'll come back soon.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Did you deliver the document to Isaac? I should have done it myself, but I got busy suddenly.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I thought about many thins after I heard from Agnes. To do those things, I cannot waste a minute.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Then see you soon.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, thank you very much. Was Wigner offended?
He understood everything. He believes that Wigner will find a new item as soon as possible.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: It is very good that he understands what I want. I think I have to start a new business at least not to disappoint Wigner.
You will not give up the desire to do business huh?

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: It fits me surprisingly. Working is rewarding and enjoyable. Besides, I can show my only ability, not as Roegenburg's ability.
By the way, your brothers must be busy. Myer and even Helmut....

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Helmut has left for the front without saying anything. Myer also has left home. I think they felt something from what Agnes said.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: If you allow, I would like ^0000cdclear up misunderstanding of my family^000000 in the rumor. Do you have time?
Yes, I do.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The rumor is true, except the part that a war will break out.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Let me tell you an old story. The parents of the four children gave a birth to Agnes and left for a neighboring country for resting.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: They were attacked by the monster there.
In the holiday resort? Now the monster appears even in the holiday resort?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: It was a remote but safe place. But for an unknown reason, the monsters attacked in group.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The reason remains unknown, but they guess that the monsters came down to the town, chased by subjugation.
I see.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: When we arrived at the site, the area was closed and no access was allowed, though my son and daughter-in-law was inside.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: We met with managers, but they blocked completely heavily armed foreigners like us.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I understand that. An armed force of a foreign country was crossing the border and I was not sure what the armed force would do. They have no choice but stop them.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: So, we tried to get into the closed zone and contact many people while time passed.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: At the end, we had to provide lots of money as bribe before we can dispatch mercenaries into the resort, but my son and daughter-in-law had been already killed.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Actually, they were alive just before they were found. But, the access was delayed and they had to die in pains.
I am sorry to hear that.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I didn't tell the children about the attack, but I had to confess the death of their parents.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: So losing beloved ones, my children and I came to live together.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text:
I grew the children to live up to the name of Roegenburg.
But actually what they need was education, but warm heart.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I didn't know that and I was only strict on them.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The children couldn't stand any more and one day they left as a token of resistance.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: The children are unwilling to talk about those days. But I am sure that what they heard and saw in those days affected them.
How?

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Helmut trained himself. When he was grown up, he left to the border. Wolf suddenly declared that he would make money.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I tried to stop him saying that there should no merchant in my family, but he was so stubborn.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: After coming home, Myer was doing well for a while. But he left us with a note. Only Agnes has been growing well without a problem.
Well. I see each of them has their own stories! The rumor is spread with something concealed.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Yes, Myer said he would handle the rumor and so the rumor will disappear. Can I ask you to do me a favor?
Please go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I am worried that ^0000cdHelmut left without a word^000000, as there are many eyes watching him. He is the heir of our family.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I hoped that he would stay for the time being, but I am sad that he left all of sudden.
Then, my job is to bring him.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Yes. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: And when you come back, use this. You can return to Prontera instantly.
Yes. I'll come back soon.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I think I was closer to brothers than now, to Helmut and Myer.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Agnes was our favored child in the family. She was the only little sister.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: But sometimes I wonder why we have become this estranged.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Well, I think it is because we have came to become different and we also have different ideas on what is right. I understand to some extent.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: It was quite a shock when Myer left home. He just left without a word, though he was very close to me.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Since then, I think, I started to find what I can. I cannot stand the thought that I am the only one who are not developing.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: When a human feels an empty space, he/she tends to fill it.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: I think I am going to continue to go around to find it.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, thanks to you, I feel that my brothers and I have become closer.
My brothers and I didn't know how to be bent and were about to be broken.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
I think these experiences make us more friendly and developing.
We were apart a long time and all have forgotten it.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text:
From now, I am going to lead my family, helping my grandfather.
If you visit us from time to time, I will be happy.

scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Please come back to us, if you need a help.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text:
It feels good that I come home for a long time.
It is a little suffocating though.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Anyway, this house goes well without me. I don't worry about the family, but I am only worried about my grandfather, as he is quite old.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Now I am home and it seems that Helmut, Wolf, and Agnes have been all good.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text:
I think it is great, though a little disappointing.
It is stupid to think like this, as I left home.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Is this a quest?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Fun story?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I have one.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: I will take the request. What's your question?

I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Let me tell it!

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.

I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I like anything pretty!

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Verification of credentials! That's all!
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text:
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
Do I have to do what you want too...?

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
OK, OK, how many do you want?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
Do you want me to steal it?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I will be waiting for you!
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Thank you. At last I can read it.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
No, I don't know. Never heard before.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: ^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
You know pretty in details?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text:
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: The blood on the battle field calls me!

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Except him.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: I hate wars too.
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: If you have a question again, come to me anytime!

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Thank you for the book!

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Men do not see anyone out.
Hello, kids?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Why?
I want to know who circulated the rumor.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Why? Are you going to catch the person?
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Can't they meet each other though they are family?
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: That is really strange.
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: This time, you need stronger credentials...

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Did you come here to see me?
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Myer?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Myer?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: You saw these kids before, didn't you?
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Ears cannot be closed.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: I want to hear it if it is important.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: My ears are closed.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Ah. have a talk then.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: La la la la la -
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
You are doing a great job.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?

scripts.speaker: He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.
Myer
scripts.text: That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
Yes, I will.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Do you want business with us? But we don't meet with anybody.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text:
We are not easy people anybody can speak to.
Go back.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Today, the wind is cold and smells rotten. I feel that something has happened.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Ah, sorry, I couldn't clean myself for a few days.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: He has come with empty hands.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Anyone without credentials cannot hear good stories. Go back.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: How can you say that! You must have forgotten what you should bring.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: This is a ritual that calls blood! A ritual of destruction and darkness!!!!

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: He started again.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Please go. We'll handle him.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: The threat of war has disappeared. Hero in the time of turbulence is not born. Darkness calls me!

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: He started again.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Please go. We'll handle him.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text:
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: My parents are happy as their business prospers when palace purchases lots of goods in large volumes. I will tell them to buy me a book tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: End of today's diary.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text:
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text:
They will be all destroyed when a bloody day comes.
Why are we recording those vain things?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text:
Because records remains forever.
If you record today, someone in the future will read them and remember us.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text: Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: My dream is to become a historian. I would like travel around Midgards and discover old hidden stories.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Jonathan is great! I will become a man like Jonathan in the future.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: How beautiful and shining the dresses of princesses would be! I wish I could wear as many pretty dresses as possible.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text:
Hello, singing birds and pretty flowers.
Are you having a beautiful day today too?

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text:
He started again.
Why don't I have normal person around me?

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text:
Are you talking to me?
If so, you are successful. I heard it very clearly.

scripts.speaker: Allen
scripts.text:
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.

scripts.speaker: Jin
scripts.text: Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text:
Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
My mother makes pretty clothes!

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text:
Now I guess that she is in the palace to repair the dresses of princesses.
Ah, I wish that she was here!

scripts.speaker: Harriet
scripts.text: Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Dear adventurer? What are you doing here? It is dangerous. The monster came down here just before. Please leave now.
I'm OK. I'm accustomed to everyday life of being attacked by monsters.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
I forgot you are a great warrior. Please forgive my rudeness.
By the way what has brought you here?
I came here to bring Lord Helmut. Your grandfather is very worried about you. He said you are away from home in an important time.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: I don't go back. ^0000cdI belong here, the front^000000. Please tell my grandfather so.
But everybody is worried about you.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: I cannot go back. As a matter of fact, I resent the people who left my parents die since I became mature.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: And I thought that it is the right way to develop the power that makes people to have no choice but to follow.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: So, my goal was to unify the continent and make my power reached at every corner of the continent. So I trained and trained myself.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: However, when I listened to Myer and Agnes, I realized that the way I pursue could cause sadness and misfortune to someone.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: So I decided to ^0000cdgive up the unification war ^000000that pushes people into a vortex of war.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: This is where I should stay. Here I can ^0000cdprotect more people safely^000000.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Considering the position of our family, I will cooperate in what is needed for the Royal Assembly.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: But I hope that Wolf will lead everything. When the Royal Assembly is closed, please tell Wolf that I will ^0000cdtransfer the position of heir to him^000000.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Wolf will need lots of power. I will stay here to protect our people.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
...I see. I will tell you message to your grandfather.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Yes. thank you. Please take care.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
This is where I should stay.
Please tell him '^0000cdI give up wars and transfer my position of heir to Wolf^000000'.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Then, good bye.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text:
I can feel the earth is shaking.
An attack is expected soon. I have to make preparation.

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Give shout of concentration!!!

scripts.speaker: Helmut
scripts.text: Louder!!!!

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text:
I am very happy that I came back here.
Now I've got something to do.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text:
And I think it is great that Lord Helmut has given up the unification war.
I knew nothing about unification, but I wished that no war would break out.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text: Here, I would like to help Lord Helmut to protect people's safe and peaceful days.

scripts.speaker: Kalbern
scripts.text:
Now it is the time that Lord Helmut begins to feel thirsty.
I think I should prepare something to drink.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Thank you for coming here to deliver the message. Without you, I would not have listened to anything like the one I heard today.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: Fight, fight, and fight.... I don't want that either.

scripts.speaker: Myer
scripts.text: They are my family who are closer to me than anyone.

scripts.speaker: Ordinary Man
scripts.text:
Shh! You'd better not speak to me.
There are may eyes around.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: It is a fast way to get stronger to take a good rest after a hard battle.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The Richard family runs various ways of training. Taking a rest is one of the most important training.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The former heads of the Richard family have also taken enough rest after training. Well, it's too common to mention, I guess.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Everyone may know how one feels itching for more action after training. However, that is the time to take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The next training would be just as tough. You'd better take a rest now.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: I feel that you must be raring to get some action. I guess it is the time to proceed with the next training.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: How do you do? I have been waiting for you after being informed by the Chamberlain.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: This it the room of the Richard family which has been controlling the military power of the kingdom.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: I have heard your name for that {0}, you are the hero in the subjugation of Morocc

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry to take too much of your time. Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Let me escort you inside.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: This it the room of the Richard family.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Po, the next head of the family, is taking a rest. Please come back later.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Have you met the next head of the family?

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: If the next head of the family meets you {0}, please...

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry about my bad manners. It is nothing. Please never mind...

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: For now, the training would be too overwhelming for you. You'd better learn the basics before proceeding with the training.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The training of the Richard family is differentiated from other training programs.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: You must have been getting yourself trained by hunting the monsters individually.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: From now on, you can be trained with hunting certain types of monsters such as human, animal, insect, fish, plant, demon, angel, nothing and dragon monsters.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: It is supposed to be more effective to swing a sword than to say 100 words.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Good. Are you ready now?

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Hum, there seems to be an issue which cannot be resolved. Well, try again and if the same issue occurs, take a screenshot and send it to the admin team.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Please select a training program to try.

Try.
Do not try.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Hum... You don't like the contents of the training? Well, it's OK. Why don't you choose another training?

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: You shouldn't let your guard down even when you feel that the training is too easy for your level. Good luck...

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Congratulations on completing the training.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: If you keep training, you'll achieve the goal you want.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: This is what I have prepared for the reward for completing training.

scripts.text: We thank you for training with us since it benefits the Richard family. Don't feel pressured.

No.
About the way of training
About the goal of training
Give up the training.

scripts.text: You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.

scripts.text: The Richard family has always been concerned about the ways to produce more excellent warriors.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: One of the former heads of the family felt that the way to train with a certain monster had a limit.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The former and former head of the family... Oh! Just to clear things out, he is retired, but he is not dead.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Hum... Let's come back down to the business... He has come up with the method to train with the monster depending on the level of the trainee or the type of the monster.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Well... The training began like that...

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The goal of the training... It is an easy and difficult question.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The most obvious goal must be getting stronger. I would have answered if I was younger.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: However, I would like to answer that it is to protect the people around me.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: The goal may be different for each warrior.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: I won't stop you from giving up. However, you should know that the progress of your training so far won't be reflected in the next training.
Do not give up.
Give up.

scripts.speaker: Butler
scripts.text: Good decision. You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.

scripts.speaker: Butler

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: An adventurer? I guess you need to try harder now.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I'd like to take a rest now.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: You must be an adventurer invited to the palace. I am taking a rest now. Talk to the butler in front of the door to make an appointment.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: That is the way to do it in the palace.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: You must be the adventurer who has made a great contribution in the subjugation of the dark lord. Your work is known in the palace as well.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Especially, us, the Richard family, are interested in your work.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Do you want to know why?

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Well, even if you don't want to know, I am going to say what I want to say anyway.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: In fact, it was not your will to come here. I am pretty sure that you must have come here since the his nibs called you. I understand that.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Although the adventurers may care less about the palace affairs, the Richard family is in charge of the military force of Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: We produce many excellent warriors as well. Hum! I am curious all of a sudden. Have you heard of the warrior from the Richard family?
Yes, I have.
No, I haven't.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Hahaha, I guess the name of Richard must be known to the adventurers as well.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Oh, my. I must have been a braggart. The Richard family should try harder.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Well, since it is not important, I guess we should let it pass. It's been a long time since I say this much. I am thirsty.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Shall we take a rest before proceeding?

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Well, let's talk about the reason that the Richard family has been interested in you then.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: As known, the Richard family is producing outstanding warriors. We run a systematic training system to support that.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I am not fond of such training, but I believe that it is an effective training program based on the know-how of the family.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Please listen up since I am about to get to the point.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I guess the adventurers were not that interested; however, there were many members of the royal family participating in the subjugation of the dark lord. I have been reported of your work from them.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: When I was reported of the contributions you made, a question came to my mind. What if a free roaming adventure take part in the strict training system? What would happen? I got curious.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I would like to make a handsome payment if a renowned adventurer like you helps us.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I feel that it is an attractive offer. Would you challenge the warrior training system of the Richard family?
I'll try.
I decline.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I guess the offer hasn't been attractive to you. I am sorry, but come back later when you change your mind.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Indeed! I like the quick decision. I value the spirit of challenge.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Let me tell the butler about it. You can proceed with the training through him.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Don't underestimate the butler who would guide you through the training.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: He is a member of the Richard family himself. He is an outstanding warrior.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I wonder if you are happy with the rewards of the training.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: It would be difficult to offer you a payment higher than that for now. Please do it as if you are having a part-time job.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: You may find it obvious. However, the more you get yourself trained, the more benefits that Richard family gets. We are willing to pay for it.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Oh! You must be participating in the training. Well, how do you find the training?

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I have participated in the training myself when I was younger. It brings back the good old memories.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: There are a variety of training programs. Please choose what you'd like to participate. Well, the adventurers tend to do what they usually do.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Accidents happen when you let your guard down. Always make sure to watch out.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: I believe the most important thing to a warrior is the spirit of challenge. The challenge to move on to the next level... It is the most important thing.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: A song of a warrior was very popular in the pub in Prontera. I am sad that I cannot hear it these days.

scripts.speaker: Po Richard
scripts.text: Do you like gambling by any chance? Doesn't the tension make you feel like a warrior in battle?

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text:
There! Stop there!
Please go through the inspection for a security check.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: Please place your identification and personal belongings on this table and stand facing the wall...

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
Martin! What are you doing?
Don't be rude to the guest to the room! I told you.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: It is for the safety of the queen.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: Now the Imperial Ordinance would just be...

scripts.speaker: Queen
scripts.text: It is noisy out here.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
Huh! Your majesty!
I am sorry.
We have a guest here.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: Extend the queen every courtesy.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: I have something to you. Please talk to Jerad here.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: I don't know why but Scarlet and Lidion have been on bad terms for a long time.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text:
They are similar in age so that it would have been nice if they are friends...
However, they both have such strong personalities.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text:
Of course, Scarlet looks several times younger.
It is supposed to be the characteristic of the Jahas.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text:
Ernst told me that he would go to the Banquet Hall.
I wonder if he is still there.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: Ha...

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: Do you have any business left here?

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: Extend the queen every courtesy.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: Please excuse me for all the trouble.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text:
I am sorry.
There was nothing suspicious found of your belongings.
Let me return your bag.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: Have you been going through it?

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text:
It doesn't hurt to be careful when there are a lot of passengers around here.
I don't want to experience such thing again.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
Ha...
I am sorry.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: If you don't mind, how about talking to the members of the Geoborg family in the Banquet Hall?

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
She has been taking care of the state affairs alone. Not to mention the Royal Assembly...
She hasn't been able to sleep for days.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text:
Oh!
The queen's sister 'Scarlet Jaha' headed to the Banquet Hall a little while ago. You may be able to meet her there.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: She is not one of the members of the family, but she knows everything about the queen.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: Scarlet is much older than the queen, but she doesn't look that old at all.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: Of course, the queen is well along in years now as well...

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: I hope the queen and Ernst can take some rest now.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: After the Royal Assembly is over, the queen may turn over the throne to the new king, and go to the castle of Scarlet.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Jerad
scripts.text: I am a little worried for that I have been serving under the queen my entire life.

scripts.speaker: Bodyguard Martin
scripts.text: Do you have any business left here?

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
Welcome.
I am Queen Catherine D. Geoborg.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
I am sorry if my knights have caused you trouble.
They are a little sensitive these days. Please understand.
Ask about the Geoborg family.
Leave the room.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
I see.
Come back anytime if you have any other questions.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: Since the banquet for you heroes is being held in the Banquet Hall, please enjoy your time here.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: We, the Geoborg family, are the descendants of Tristan I who founded this world. Our family has produced numerous kings and knights for generations.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: In the first Royal Assembly which was held, the forth prince Ernst was elected as a candidate. However, he has given up his position in the Royal Assembly this time due to several incidents.
What do you mean by several incidents?

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
Oh... It slipped my tongue.
It is a little difficult to tell you about those incidents.
I'd rather you pretend I didn't say it.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
You mean Prince Ernst?
Well?

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: He comes here to say good morning and either helps me the work or does other things.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: Ever since the banquet started, he has been carrying his work to somewhere else.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: He could be somewhere in the Banquet Hall.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
Haven't you met Prince Ernst yet?
He just stopped by and went out again...

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: I am worried about the representative of our family wandering around like this.
Tell her about what you have heard.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
Oh...
Dear hero, please don't mind such stories much.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text: It is a problem that we, the Geoborg family, should get over ourselves.

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
The ink pad of the highest quality to be used in the royal debate room?
It is the clerk who writes down everything. Why are they buying luxury item that no one will ever use...

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
I have enough dresses to last my lifetime. Why do they keep making them...
A cutback!

scripts.speaker: Queen Catherine D. Geoborg
scripts.text:
Hum.. Trade request from Marol Kingdom...
I should dispatch an envoy to take care of it soon...

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
Ask about the Geoborg family.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Heh!
Is there no one around here who is curious about me?
Everyone who ever talks to me talk about that!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh!
Don't be startled.
It is a joke.
Hahaha.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: As you know, the Geoborg family is the descendant of...

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text:
Tristan I who have founded the kingdom!
Is there anyone who doesn't know the story in this kingdom?
Dear Lady Jaha.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Phew, that old jerk!
He is younger than me and always tries to preach!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh!
Well... For that reason, the Geoborg family will retire to a quiet life for a while as soon as the Royal Assembly is over.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
I really hope that Catherine doesn't suffer from sorrow anymore.
That's why I fully support such decision!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.

- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh!
Haven't you found him yet?
Should I ask Catherine?

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
That expression on your face... You must have heard what people say.
There must have been no good stories in particular...
Please don't mind such stories much.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: Ernst must have been hiding from such whispers as well.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Well, I guess he needs some rest.
You hero, cheer up and enjoy the banquet!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: What a waste to let the banquet end like this!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh, hero!
Are you having a good time?

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
If you have some time to spare, please tell me some fun stories from your adventure.
I am sick of listening to Lidion's nitpicking.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: We, the Geoborg family, is one of the seven royal families, but we are the creme de la creme for producing the highest number of kings in the history.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: In fact, we are settled in Prontera, the center of the Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: Despite the series of unfortunate events regarding the princes after the death of King Tristan III,

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: Prince Ernst Geoborg was elected as the most regnant candidate in the last Royal Assembly. It shows just influential the Geoborg family is.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text: He has given up from the position.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: What?

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
I said!
Prince Ernst gave up his position as the candidate to the throne.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: What a nonsense!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Oh!
You didn't know!
You must have been separated from the outside world for too long!

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text:
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: Arghhhh!

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text:
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!

scripts.speaker: Scarlet Jaha
scripts.text:
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text: Arghhhh!

scripts.speaker: Lidion Geoborg
scripts.text:
Tut...
Letting anybody in like this... The dignity of the palace has fallen down to the ground.

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
Did you hear the story?
The skeleton of King Tristan III has been found.

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
Oh my!
Gosh!

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: It is a secret. Don't tell anyone.

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: ...So the princes must have been poisoned...

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
What on earth!
Well, in the last Royal Assembly...

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
Ha!
He has given up the royal authority like that!

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: Doesn't he even care for the people of his family?

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: Your voice is too loud!

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
No...
I didn't say anything wrong.
Did I?

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: How can he decide such a major issue as he wants?

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: I knew it. He has been hanging out with that punk from the third-rate family too long...

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: So is the queen who is handling all the matters of the palace now?

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: She hasn't showed her presence to the public so far...

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: How foolish it is to give up the regal power like that!

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: I won't ever let go of such power!

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
Hey, you!
Not anyone can have such power.

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
Why not?
I am free to dream!

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text: Is the Geoborg family cursed?

scripts.speaker: Mumbling Sound
scripts.text:
Shh!
You shouldn't say such a thing so easily!

scripts.speaker: Bachelor
scripts.text:
The women in the line here are so scary.
They curse, push and fight...
Why don't you just go back then?

scripts.speaker: Bachelor
scripts.text:
Are you telling me to go back when Jurgen is right inside of the door?
I won't!

scripts.speaker: Bachelor
scripts.text:
I won't go before seeing the elegant and luminous presence of him!
I have come here from Payon to meet Jurgen!

scripts.speaker: Miss
scripts.text:
Jurgen treats us all the same. We should have a sense of fair play.
Who ever it was, turn yourself in!

scripts.speaker: Miss
scripts.text: Who was it? Who pretended to be close to Katrin and went along with her? Come out here! We have made a pact not to stand out!

scripts.speaker: Womenfolk
scripts.text: Jurgen belongs to all of us! No one should have him to oneself! I won't let anyone to do that!

scripts.speaker: Womenfolk
scripts.text: I won't let anyone monopolize Jurgen! The heaven may forgive, but I won't!

scripts.speaker: Gyusoo
scripts.text: It is no use getting a ticket number... It is just too difficult to wait for my turn.

scripts.speaker: Gyusoo
scripts.text:
When will Jurgen come out?
When will be my turn to see him?

scripts.speaker: Bachelorette
scripts.text: There! If you are a newbie, don't be so naive and try to fit in here!

scripts.speaker: Bachelorette
scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
Hey, don't you push me there! Stand in the line. Isn't it your first time here to see Jurgen?

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
Hey, you lady! Don't push!
Stay in the line!

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
There was this lady who was carried out with a broken ankle from pushing!
It is all for your own good!

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
Ha, I am already feeling tired as always.
I didn't know that women were so strong before.

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
I started yesterday and realized why the people who had worked here before quit.
Despite being with so many ladies here, I am not happy at all.

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
As you see, there are no guards guarding the doord to other family's residences.
However, there are too many infiltrators to the Wigner residence who get in there to see Jurgen. Now the door is guarded at all times.

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
Oh, be quiet there!
It is too noisy that Jurgen cannot take his beauty rest!

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
It is not for my sake, but for Jurgen.
It would make you sad if Jurgen is unable to sleep, right? So be quiet!

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
Oh, wait there! Stop there!
Aren't you the one who has infiltrated the room before? You don't have to run hiding your face! Come back here!

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
She went off again. She sure is fast.
I am glad that my own sister doesn't come to a place like this.

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
When I applied to become a guard, I wanted to keep the palace safe with my own hands...
Never did I know that I would end up here...

scripts.speaker: Strong Guards
scripts.text:
Hey, you! There! Stand in the line! Stop there! You shouldn't block the way!
If you keep doing that, I'll stop you from coming here!

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, although I respect your hard work going through all the obstacles and hardships, it is still a little too early for you to be here.
I hope I will see you later.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Who are you?
Only the people with permission can enter this place. Please leave.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, welcome to the Wigner family. My name is ^0000cdLevuiere Wigner^000000.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: I am honored by your visit while you are attending the banquet held for you, dear adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: This banquet carries more meaning than celebration since the Royal Assembly is conducted at the same time. Did you hear that?

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: There is a candidate from our family who participates in the Royal Assembly as well. Would you like to meet him?

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: She is the lady of the Wigner house, ^0000cdCatherine Wigner^000000.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: How do you do? Please make yourself at home while you are staying with us, the Wigner family. Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: We, Wigners, will support as much as possible for your convenience, dear adventurer.
