scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Please visit our manor too if you have the time, dear adventurer. You are always welcome.
Where is ^0000cdJurgen^000000 now?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Are you looking for me?

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: There you are! Dear adventurer, this is the ^0000cdheir of the Wigner family^000000, and the ^0000cdcandidate for the throne^000000 participating in the Royal Assembly this time.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Hello. My name is ^0000cdJurgen Wigner^000000. It is very nice to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, please make yourself home here. If you need anything or find anything inconvenient, please let us know anytime.
Thank you for your hospitality.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Then, please excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Tut, I am worried that he lacks sociability. He would have to meet a lot of people as the heir of the house, you know. Dear adventurer, please excuse my son's discourtesy.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: If time allows, would you like to meet our children? They have been excited to meet the hero who defeated Morocc in the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Then please make yourself at home and take a look around, dear adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, please make yourself home and take your time looking around here.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: If time allows, would you please tell our children the stories of your adventures? It would be an invaluable experience for them.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Then, have a restful time.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you meet the children? I would love to have some tea with you and listen to your stories if you are available.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
We like to hear the stories of adventurers very much.
Those adventures are valuable experiences that money cannot buy.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: I wonder if our children have observed their manners though. We must have spoiled them for that they sometimes act so imprudently.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: I am trying to warn them a little these days, Please excuse their behaviors if they have done anything rude to you.

Not at all. Jurgen seemed to have grown since my last visit.
Katrin and Isaac impressed me as well.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
We have been too easy on them.
We are ashamed that we were not prepared properly for the Royal Assembly last time.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
It is not important whether he becomes the king or not.
If he is a king material, he will be. If not, he doesn't have to be the king. I don't want to stress him out for that.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Don't you have any ambitions? What a glory would it be if we turn out a king from our family of our generation!
Since our ancestors founded this kingdom, we deserve to produce a king.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
The king is a hollow position. It only comes with responsibilities?
Haven't I told you before? Did you forget?

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
If our family turns out a king, much of our fortune will be spent. Once, our family has really suffered from it.
Near the king, there are always a swarm of pesky flies.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
You know, it could be the exact opposite.
It may reinforce our family.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Now there are Katrin and Isaac who can back up Jurgen.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Hum... Isaac.
Thinking of him makes me confident.
You must trust Isaac quite a lot.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Oh, we must have left you out of the conversation, dear adventurer.
I am sorry.
Not at all. I have been enjoying the conversation.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Now that you mention it, how do you find our third child, Isaac?
He is the most Wigner-like one among the children.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
While Jurgen is interested in the looks, he doesn't really care for money or the throne...
If Katrin was a son, I would have gladly leave everything to her.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Fortunately, the third child who used to be a mischievous boy has grown up to be suitable for the name of Wigner.
Not that the other two are inadequate.
I know what you mean.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Nevertheless, don't talk like that in front of the children. It is not good to favor a child.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
As a member of the Wigner family, one must be able to cope with criticism.
They should be able to determine what's right upon listening to the words of other people. Also, they need to be able to deal with the hard truths.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Please don't talk like that in front of the children.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: I never talk to them like this you know.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Anyways, Isaac seems busy doing something these days. Do you know what he is doing?

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: I heard that he is doing something with the third son of the Roegenburg family. You don't need to worry about Isaac. He knows how to take care of himself.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Arghhhhhhhhh!

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: ^0000cdKatrin?^000000 Has something happened to my baby? I should get going...
You two stay here. It might be dangerous. Let me go take a look first.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Has something happened to our child, I mean, Katrin?
Shouldn't I go down there myself?

It could be dangerous. Please wait here for a minute.
I'll go.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Are they hiding something bad from me...?
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Then please tell me what it is about.

If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, you seem busy.
Is it about what our children have asked you?

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
We have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, I have heard the story from the children.
They didn't go into all the details, but I heard that they owed you a huge favor.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
The children are getting along so much better these days.
Not that they were on bad terms, but now they seen to care for one another more. I am so glad.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
You seem to be the messenger of luck to our family.
It is our family tradition to keep a person like you close and treat well.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
We would be honored to have you as a guest to our home.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Hello, dear adventurer. Welcome!
We are honored by your visit to the Wigner family.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
As the lady of the house I would make your stay as pleasant as possible.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: You may talk to the head of the family standing next to me. His name is Levuiere Wigner.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Have you met our children? Having a conversation with you would be an invaluable experience for our children, dear adventurer.
They haven't been through any trouble growing up so we feel that they lack in various life experiences.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Since I am married to a man from the family which has founded this country, I want to raise my children worthy of the name. However, my husband is not interested in fame and power.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: I feel very sorry about it.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: However, I tend to let our children to whatever they want to do, which makes me wonder if I have spoiled them...

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
I'd like to hear your stories for that.
It is always a great joy to listen to the stories of the people who have gone through a lot of experiences.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
What if anything has happened to my baby, Katrin?
I'd better I go down there myself.

It could be dangerous, please wait here for a minute.
Let me go down there and see what has happened.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: I hope everything is OK.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Are they hiding something bad from me...?
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Then please tell me what it is about.

If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
I wonder if our children haven't bothered you much. Although we are very curious, we have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text:
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
For some reason, our children have become very close to one another.
I think it is all thanks to you.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text:
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
Please give us the opportunity to treat you, dear adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: How about cutting down some?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Are you a fan of mine? Did you make an appointment? If you are a guest of mine, why don't you go see my father over there?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I am glad that you are still here. Sorry about my bad manners earlier. I wanted to have more conversation with you. However, if I make any mistakes while I talk in front of my mother, I get scolded.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Not that she would be harsh on my, but it still kind of bothers me so I had to leave. I am sorry.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, since you are already here, may I introduce my family to you? This elegant lady here is my sister, ^0000cdKatrin Wigner^000000.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You shouldn't call me your sister, but the first daughter of the Wigner family in this occasion.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I am honored to meet you. I hope you have a restful stay with the Wigners.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: This is my brother, ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: He is the youngest child of the Wigner family. Unlike my sister and I who are not interested in the family business, he is a prodigy who will shine the name of the Wigner family.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Hello? I am Isaac Wigner. What a trouble you are going through to visit a boring family like this. I hope you have fun here if you can...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Isaac, I have warned you about such manner of speaking before.
You are also being disrespectful to Jurgen who has just introduced you. Are you going to put us all to shame?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
It is a joke, just a joke! Sister, you are so inflexible.
In a dreary atmosphere like this, this adventurer deserves to laugh a little, right?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You are not being funny but disrespectful to the guest. Dear adventurer, please excuse the bad manners. I am sorry.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
By the way, I want to go home as soon as possible. This place is too narrow and gloomy.
I would like to be in the Banquet Hall at least.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: There must be a lot of people who want to see me. I am obliged to show my face.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: My presence will light up the dark palace, you know. I should entertain the bored people there.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You are insulting the Royal Assembly. You need to do your best. Royal Assembly is more sacred that you think.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You shouldn't forget that you are one of the candidates for the throne who will lead the kingdom with the seven royal families.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: It means that you shouldn't act like a child. I have told you not to take the weight of your responsibility and duty so lightly.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Of course, I know that well. That's why I have tidied up my looks and fixed my hair perfectly.
I tried not to loosen up, you know.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
You need to be able to groom yourself up well to take care of greater matters.
Of course, I am well-prepared.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Would you like to see my new cape?
It goes with the color of my eyes. It would definitely brighten up the palace.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Oh, not again. Dear adventurer, you should be used to this to have a conversation with my brother at our home.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Oh, there he goes again. I should get going now. Dear adventurer, I would like to see you later.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I guess that is it for today. If you are not busy, ^0000cdwhy don't you go have a cup of tea with our parents^000000?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: My parents love to hear the stories of adventurers.

It is a good idea. Please excuse me then.
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
It seems that my sister has lost something. I couldn't understand her words since she was in such a hurry.
Would you please ask her what it is about?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Whatever she has lost, it must be very valuable to her. I feel that she'd better get someone to help her to find it.
Well, then she would be scolded by our father though...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
I wonder if you can look into it as fast and quietly as possible.
My sister's fate depends on your hands.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It seems that she may drop dead if she doesn't find whatever she has lost.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you are here. How did it go?
No. Everyone has seen it there, but no one has seen it taken.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: How about the one who has taken it? Oh, right, the one who has taken it wouldn't say so.
By the way, people seem to have a strange prejudice about Katrin. I know the words they say are not true, but you'd better to something about it.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What do you meant?
Well, please don't take it wrong. Some people have said that Katrin may have done it to draw attention or they cannot trust Katrin.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What a nonsense! Phew... This is exactly why I have told her to open her heart to others and talk more...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Why should I do that? I don't care about the people who don't know me well anyway.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Sister, when did you come back?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I came here just a minute ago. However, I heard what you said. So, do you think it's my fault to hear such things?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You are to blame to a certain level. Look at me. I always to treat others with all my hearts. They all love me for that.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Do you think people like you for your attitude?
Don't you remember the trouble that all the family members have been through because of your attitude issue during the Royal Assembly?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: If it is not my attitude, then for what?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: What do you think?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Do you mean that it is for my looks?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Can you deny it? Since you were young, when you are doing nothing, no, even when you are rude, people have been nice to you.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: They all smiled at you to please the pretty-looking heir of the Wigner family, the candidate to the throne.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You say that is for my looks?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Looks have played an important role. You cannot deny it. Looks are part of your talent, right?
Especially, in our family. You should know it by now.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Even if it's all for my looks, have I ever wanted it to be that way?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Even when I am not doing anything wrong, I am always compared to my handsome brother, and bad rumors follow me. Do you think I have ever wanted it to be that way?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: That's why you need to open up to others and act nice...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: The best way not to cause misunderstanding is to be silent. When I don't talk, I don't make a mistake.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: That doesn't always work. About what happened today, you know. Even when you were silent...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I am already doing my best! You know what? The darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light! It is just like me next to you! I have been trying!

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: However, people don't see who I really am! What else should I do now?
Both of you should calm down.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Yes. Whatever it is, you'd better calm down. I could hear you yelling at each other from the other end of the hallway.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Our family is supposed to have a reputation to keep, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: What you have ruined last time is about to be recovered now, brother.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: By the way, ^0000cdisn't it your box^000000, sister? It was on the table while there are a bunch of people hanging out. I kept it not to get it lost.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: This... ^0000cdWas it you who had taken it^000000?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You should have let me know when you were taking it. Do you know how much trouble I have been through for this?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Wait, this is unfair! No? I have taken it with me for your sake, sister.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: You know how our father gets furious if anything goes missing in our house!

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: He would go on and on about how we don't need a person who cannot manage even a small thing in the Wigner family and how management skill is the greatest virtue of our family... Just think about it scares me.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What is in there? Why did you fuss about it so much?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: There is nothing which is considered valuable by others in it. However, it is the most precious thing to me. Look.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: A note?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: A diary?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: It is better to avoid a futile conversation. If you don't talk, you don't make mistakes. However, there are moments that you want to be honest with yourself.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: This diary has been capturing the moments that I want be true to myself.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Nevertheless, I still am mistaken by others even I stay quiet. I guess silence has not been the best policy after all. Since I have my diary back, I should get going.
Dear adventurer, please excuse me for all the trouble.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Sister, I...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: That's all right now. I'll forget it all. You don't have to care about it either.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: She walks so fast. What was it all about?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It's all because you have taken the box without a word... Phew... Well, long story short, our sister is upset.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Argh! Why is she upset?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It is complicated. I guess there are some bad rumors about her out there.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Oh, I have heard about it before. However, I thought you would take care of it since it is mainly your fault.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You knew about that? Why didn't you tell me about it?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Even if I did, you wouldn't have taken it seriously. It is true that you were born with that blessed looks.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: That's why the people around you have looked up to you. Not that our parents have been hard on us. No wonder you have grown up to be so carefree.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Are you picking up a fight with me?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: No, listen to me. I am telling the truth here. No hard feelings.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Due to your superlative looks, we have been quite disadvantaged, growing up.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Do you remember what our sister has said? How the darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light? It is true.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I don't get it. Beauty is a good thing. Everyone likes it.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
The people who see it may appreciate it. However, the people right next to it are being compared to it.
Among the three of us, it must have been the hardest for our sister.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Imagine a plain person standing next to an angelic beauty. Despite looking completely normal, she or he would look unattractive and somber. We have been compared to you like that, all our lives.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Our sister must have suffered from the stress even more. She has managed to endure it with her extraordinary patience and generosity. In fact, I think she could be an angel.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I didn't know that... At all..

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What should I do now?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
I don't think it is entirely your fault. It was our parents who have created you like that.
Oh, well, you are to blame for your carefreeness though.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Anyway, who we need to worry about is our sister. Has she ever been mad at us? What should we do when she is upset?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Well, she has been mad at me once when I was young.
I guess it was somewhat similar to what has just happened. She said something about comparison then...

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
I was too young to remember it. However, I do remember how our sister became very quiet after arguing with you.
You have been the main culprit of it after all.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It is not the time to waste time to distinguish between right and wrong. What should we do, dear adventurer.
I don't know. Have you ever tried to countervail someone's anger?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: No. No one's ever been mad at me, except our sister.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, please help us out here.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Leave me out of it. I wasn't the one who got her mad.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You were the cause of the problem.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I was trying to keep it safe... Please, dear adventurer, help us!
What can you do? You'd better wait until your sister lets off steam... Or, you could try giving her something she likes...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What doesn't she like? Do you know?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I know as much as you do.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Which means you know nothing, great!
She seems to value experiences and memories. Don't you have any good memories with her? Trace back your memory back a little.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Hum... Hum... There's no such... Wait! Yes, I remember one!

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: What? Is there any?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Do you remember how we walked around the Comodo beach together during the summer vacation? We picked up some pretty stones on the shore and in the cave.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Our sister really liked...This clear stone containing some sea water and a piece of coral inside.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: The Sea Stone?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Yes, that's it! She lined up those stones near the window and enjoyed looking at them glittering in the sun.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Oh, I remember now. I remember seeing them glittering in her room.
The ^0000cdSea Stone^000000? What is it?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It is a pretty stone which can only be found in Comodo. It is called the Sea Stone because it looks as if there is the sea captured inside of it, with the sea water and corals.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Some romantics call it, the gift from a mermaid.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You may find them upon digging the ground on the Comodo beach once in a while. Our sister, Isaac and I used to dig them out whenever we are on summer vacation.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I have heard that it is not found on the beach these days. Instead, you can get it by killing the ^0000cdMedusa inside the cave in the west of Comodo^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What? Did the Medusa take them all?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Who knows? It is supposed to be the gift from a mermaid. Some say, the Mermen have given them to the Medusa. Well, this also sounds like a fairytale.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: How do you know it so well?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I have once tried to distribute them all over the continent. You used to be able to get them by just digging the ground. Tourists used to pick them up as souvenirs or gamblers used to use them as talismans for their prayers to the sea-god.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Since it became hard to get them, I have given up the plan. The game is not worth the candle, having to kill the Medusa on the way.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I didn't know that. Anyway, I remember there was something else next to the stone.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: There were some flowers, a bunch of them. What flower was that? I lasted so long that it never seemed to wither at all.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, do you have any idea what flower that would have been?
If it didn't whither for so long, it could have been a Witherless Rose.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Is there such a thing? Why do you need a Witherless Rose when you can just buy another flower before the older one withers?
You want what you like to last long. If you replace it with another flower, it is not the same flower you liked anymore.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Hum... Well, I guess I can imagine myself being replaced with another person. I understand it now.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: So, when are you going to get them for us?
What?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: You didn't think that we would go there to get them ourselves, did you?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I am busy with my business, and Jurgen attracts too many people around him.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: We need someone else we can trust, who happens to be right in front of us.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I was worried about it as well. Please, dear adventurer, help us. The loving relationship among us depends on you.
If you say so... How many of them do you need? Where can I get the Sea Stone?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Hum... I guess we need ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000 and ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000 since we want to decorate the window with them.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: We are depending on you.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you came! Did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
I wasn't able to bring them all.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Why? Did you forget what to bring by any chance? Let me tell you once more.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000. You can get them while hunting Medusa in Comodo. They are valuable because it is difficult to kill Medusa.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: And ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I know that's a lot of things to bring, but I believe we need them all to make our sister feel better.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Yes, please tell us that you did. We tried our best to balance out her anger. However, she's been giving the cold shoulder to us.
I brought them. You'd better not to press an angry person so impatiently like that, you know.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Whoa, they are all here! You saved our lives. We should call our sister now. What if she is still mad at us...

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I have already called her.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Why do you keep calling me? Please leave me alone for that I am not mad at you any more.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Sister, forgive us. Please stop being mad at us.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: ...Do you know what you have done wrong?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I don't think I am to blame, but I am sorry that I have taken your stuff without telling you.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Well, I am sorry about it all. I haven't been considerate of your feelings. However, it wouldn't have hurt you to open up to me a little, since we are family.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: If we don't be honest to each other, we will just grow away. We will get our wires crossed again.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You are right. I have given it a thought as well. I think some part of it is my fault. I should have been honest with you, at least.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: When we were young, we used to talk a lot, and have some good times. Look at these. We used to run around looking for things like these. Do you remember this stone? You liked to watch them glitter in the sun.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: They are.. When did you get them...?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
The adventurer helped us. I guess those were the times when we were the closest to one another. Look at this.
This stone is so clear that you can see the seawater and coral reef inside right through it.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I think people are just the same. We don't need to show everything, but we do need to show some to let others know how pretty we are inside.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Yes, you are right. I think you have got the point. I'll try. I'll do it to avoid any more misunderstanding.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: By the way, when did you learn to talk like that? I think I am finally able to talk with you guys now.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You mean, you haven't been able to talk with us?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
Well, thanks to my effort, we brothers and sister have become close to one another again.
Thank you for your work, dear adventurer. This is not much, but I hope you take it. Sorry about all the trouble you have been through for us.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
Material reward has never seems to small before.
I guess what you have done for us is just that priceless.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I am sorry to cause such an embarrassing scene in front of you. If you have time, please come by again. We will make sure to receive you properly next time.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I have learned new lessons and earned many things, thanks to you. If you need our help, we will try to help you as much as we can. I wish you luck!
Jurgen, Hello?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Oh, dear adventurer, welcome.
Are you enjoying the banquet? Do you need any help by any chance?

No. I just wanted to talk to you for a second.
I wonder how your sister is doing these days as well.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Thanks to your help, we have never been better than this.
I've been talking to my sister much more, and..

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: I am sorry. I thought no one was here. I just wanted to clean the room, I am really sorry. I'll come back later.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Not at all. Please come in. It is a nonsense that you cannot clean the room because of the people inside.
Hello, long time no see. Sorry about the trouble you went through last time. Fortunately, the box thing has been resolved well.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh... Yes... I see...
Hello...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Is this the person from the last time? Whom you asked about the box...?
Yes, she is.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I am sorry about that. We were desperate and in a hurry. I apologize if you were upset by it.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Thank you for telling me that. Since I am a maid, there are people who suspect me or treat me like a thief.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: However, you seem different, dear prince. I am a little surprised. I thought people who belong to the high society didn't know how to apologize.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, it was very presumptuous of me.
I am sorry.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: No, that's OK.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Then, I should get going.
I am supposed to clean the room when there is no one inside anyway. Please excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You shouldn't have to... Well, she's gone...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Well, dear adventurer?
What?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Well, I think ^0000cdI have fallen in love^000000 .
Oh, you have.
What?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I have never met anyone who looks directly into my eyes like that.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I fell in love with her. I love her dignified and calm voice. Unaffected behaviors That tone of voice reflecting strong will...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: All the women I have seen so far are like flowers in the greenhouse. However, she resembles a wild flower in the field.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: She is totally different from the ladies I have met before.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer! How can I tell someone I have fallen in love at first sight how I feel? Should I go take her hands and say I love her?
What? You don't know anything about it?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: She is my ^0000cdfirst love^000000. My life will never be the same since I have met her.
Hum... Try to remember what all the people outside the door have done to you.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Well... Nothing that I can recall... Hum... There have been some impressive people though. There was this person who penetrated defense and hid behind the curtain in my room...
Hum... That's impressive. However, it is a crime. You should forget it.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: There was this person who sent me a life-size golden statue. I sent it back since I didn't need it and it didn't look as good as real me.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: How about sending her a gold statue looking exactly like me?
She will be repelled if you try too hard like that from the very beginning. How about sending her a ^0000cdletter^000000 with a small gift?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It is a good idea! Please wait a moment!
What? Wait for what?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Did you forget? If I take a step out of that door, I'll draw attention.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It would cause her trouble, wouldn't it. By the way, I didn't even get the chance to ask her what her name was.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please send this letter to her with this box containing jewelry.
OK.
It will be difficult.
It will be difficult. I have other things to do.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Sorry about the difficult request. I guess I should go there myself. You may be able to see the news that the heir of the Wigner family has been crushed to death by his followers on Daily Rune-Midgarts tomorrow morning.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Or, the poor maid could be hospitalized by tomorrow. Anyway, I understand.
OK. I should get going then.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you. How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
No, I haven't been able to meet her yet. Let me go see her again.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you.
How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
No, actually... She ^0000cdturned it down^000000. She returned what you had sent her as well.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
She turned me down?
Why? Did she say that she didn't like my looks? Or wasn't what I had sent her enough for her?
No, not that... She has said she is currently not in the situation to go out with someone. She seems to have a reason.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Does she already have a boyfriend? I am not surprised. She is so attractive after all. No wonder I have fallen for her.
No, not that either... She just has said she is currently not in the situation to date someone.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Whoa... ^0000cdIt is my first time to want something so badly in this life^000000. Never did I know that it would be so difficult to get.
Is living such a difficult thing?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: However, my father has told me that I should always try at least three times.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: First try to begin, second try to confirm and the third try to give up since it is not meant to be.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: So, dear adventurer. Please do this one more time for me.
Well, I think you should write the letter again...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I need something special. Something pretty and shiny which reflects my feelings...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: The Sea Stone! And flower!
What?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I want to send her ^0000cdthe heart that is as wide and beautiful as the sea^000000 and ^0000cdthe amaranthine heart for her^000000.
Should I go get them all myself as well?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please, dear adventurer, be the messenger of love for me. Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
If you say so, I'll do it.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please send her my letter with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: As I told you before, you can get the Sea Stone from killing Medusa.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I will never forget this and make it up to you. We, Wigners, never forget any debt.
Not that I am doing it expecting something in return, but I will deliver them to her since you look so desperate.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Thank you! Oh, do you happen to get her name by any chance?
Mary, her name is Mary.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: ^0000cdMary^000000. It is a common but pretty name. What is common means that it is well loved by many people. I'll get all my things embroidered with this name from now on.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you may set off now. Please deliver my feelings to her safely.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right? Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer! You are back!
I couldn't stop thinking about her even while you were gone.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Even when I eat, drink a tea, look into the mirror and talking to other people! I though about her all day. It was painful but I was in a flutter.
That's what falling in love is like.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Oh, then I must have been doing bad things to numerous people. There is nothing I can do for them.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: By the way, since your hands are empty, I guess she has accepted my heart at last!

Well, hum... She didn't react negatively, but you'd better be careful since you don't know each other yet.
Why don't you spare her some time?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: She must have not accepted my heart completely then. I am all right though! She hasn't turned me down yet!

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I didn't know how painful it was to love someone. I did know how I would be fidgety about a word or gesture of her.
It is true. Winning someone's heart is the hardest thing.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I guess I should be nicer to the people who like me.
I don't think that is a good idea...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, thank you again. Would you come by again tomorrow?
What?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It seems like a good sign. Paddle as the wave approaches. That's one of the many mottos of our family.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I want to let her know of my blazing heart every day.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I have a feeling that everything will turn out great if you send it for me.
How about allowing her some time?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: What if she forgets about me? Then, please send her my message once a day. You wouldn't say no, right?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot. It is not much, but please accept this as my token of gratitude for the messenger of my love.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I'll see you tomorrow then!

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I'd like to call you who has delivered my message of love to her, the ^0000cdMessenger of Love^000000.
Please don't...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: ^0000cdCupid of Love^000000...
Please stop it.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: On the day Mary accepts my feelings, I would like to give you a huge pure gold statue.
You really don't have to do that.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: However, this is the only thing I can offer you for now. Please visit our manor later. There are some real valuable things.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Then dear adventurer, I'll see you again tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, what brought you here around this time? May I help you?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Are you here to deliver my message of love to Mary?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Oh, well, it was you who had said that she would be repelled by my impatience.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I am trying hard not to send her my love letter every minute and second. Please comeback when the time comes.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you came! It seems that something good may happen today.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please deliver her the message of my love with deliver my message of love with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Do you remember? You can get the Sea Stone by killing Medusa.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please send them to her and tell me how Mary is doing today. I am sad that she doesn't come here to clean the room anymore.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: I want to go see her myself. However, I guess she will feel uncomfortable.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I am depending on you!

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, we are honored to have you with us. Have you met our father who is the head of the Wigner family?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: How about meeting Jurgen, the hair of the Wigner family who is participating in the Royal Assembly?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Then, have a comfortable time in the Wigner family.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I am over!
What is going on?

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Sister, please calm down. Where did you put it? Are you sure you have left it here?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Here, I have left it right here! After talking to the adventurer, I put it here and... It was gone... Where did it go?
What did you lose?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: My jewelry box... Well, it is technically not a jewelry box since it doesn't hold any jewelry in it, but anyways, ^0000cda small box containing something very important is missing.^000000

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I took it out of my bag and out it here. Then it was gone. What should I do? I don't know what I should do without it... I cannot afford to let anyone see it...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: It could be the ^0000cdmaid^000000 who came here earlier to clean the room. She may have taken it.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You haven't seen her taking it. You shouldn't doubt other people without proof.
Not that I am suspicious of her, but it may help to ask her. If she saw it or when was the last time she saw it...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Please don't. She would be upset if she feels that she is being suspected.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: But you are being so nervous. Isn't it an important thing to you?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: It is, but...

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: You really need to get it back, right?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: You are right, but...
I'll make sure to ask her about it as politely as possible. Please relax and wait here.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I don't know if is the best idea. I don't want her to feel that we are suspecting her.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Just wait until the adventurer comes back. The adventurer is really experienced in this kind of stuff.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Should I...
Then, please help me, dear adventurer. I'll go search other pleases then.

scripts.speaker: Jurgen
scripts.text: Please, help her. I have heard that ^0000cdthe maids are in the kitchen^000000.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Oh, what should I do?
I should have taken better care of it...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Please make sure not to hurt other people's feelings.
I would like to go find it myself, but I am not in the situation to do that...

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
I don't even want to imagine anyone else sees it though...
I would be embarrassed to death.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Please leave me alone now!
Ah, it was you, dear adventurer. Please excuse me.
Your feeling must have been hurt by your brothers.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
It is not that.
I am... I am just angry at myself.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Something like this never would have happened if was more careful...
Moreover, I shouldn't have said such things to my brothers either.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
However, I couldn't take it anymore when I heard the rumors and Jurgen's attitude...
I thought I was used to those things... I guess I am not.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
I should have given it up by now...
Oh, I am sorry. I believe you haven't come here to listen to a story like this.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
I am sorry, but I want to be alone for now.
Please.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
Thanks to you, we have become closer to one another now.
Now I can open up to my brothers more.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text:
I have tried to hide my feelings and save my words. However, I have realized that It is not the best policy.
From now own, I am going to tell them how I feel to avoid any misunderstanding.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: I believe I haven't met you before. Are you here to see my father?

scripts.speaker: Katrin
scripts.text: My father is over there.

scripts.speaker: Isaac Wigner
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, do you know the old saying that the emptier it is, the more you can fill it?
It is one of the many aphorisms passing down in our family.
Hello, Isaac Wigner.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Oh, welcome, dear adventurer, my brother is over there...
No. I am here to see you, Isaac.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Is it about Wolf?
Yes. How did you know it...?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Wolf is not here even after the time he has promised. He is the man of his word. Something must have happened to him.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I never expected you would come here instead though. So is he cancelling the appointment today then?
Yes, he is. And he asked me to get ^0000cda certain thing^000000 from you, Isaac.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: That thing...? Wolf must trust you, dear adventurer. Or it could be...
Some kind of a test.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Don't take it the wrong way. I am just be careful. In order to do what I do, I need to know who I can trust first.
I understand.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: You can bring it to Wolf. Please be careful with it.
OK.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: May I ask you for one more thing? I have heard that there is ^0000cda strange rumor^000000 circulating in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: It is supposed to be about ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000. Would you investigate about the rumor and let me know the truth?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Since I have a reputation to keep. I cannot afford to have a scandal. Please help me.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Please excuse me then.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Have you deliver the thing to Wolf safely? You should be careful with it since it can be dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: And, don't forget to ask about the rumor as well.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Please excuse me then.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
Here is the document about that. Here... It was. Wait, I must have forget to bring it with me. I am sorry. I'll be back with it soon.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Such things happen. Take your time. I'll be waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
Here is the ^0000cddocument^000000 about it. It is written by Wolf Roegenburg himself.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Let's see... Hum... So the new business will be delayed indefinitely. The direction of the business will be changed.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I'll see you again after taking care of the matters. - W. R.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: It means that he would stop the deal about the war, right? The rumor must have been quite threatening.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I feel sorry. It would have been a great chance for me to impress my family.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Well, I believe Wolf would find a better direction to the business. Please tell Wolf that I support his decision. And that I am excited about his new business.
Yes, I will.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Please excuse me then.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
It is a shame.
It was a great opportunity for me and Wolf.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
However, since my partner wants to quit, I shouldn't force him to carry on with it.
I believe that Wolf must already have the plan about the next business item in his mind.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: That's why I accepted his suggestion to be partners in business.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Please excuse me then.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, since you are here to the Wigner family, why don't you go meet some other members of the family?
Like my parents, my brother who is the candidate to the throne or my sister who is the eldest child.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I believe that you would have more productive time with them.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you bring what I had asked you?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I'd like to go get them myself or ask other people to do it. But, I feel a little uncomfortable since it is a family matter.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I know how it is troubling you, but please help us. You have not forgotten what to bring, have you?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: You need to bring ^0000cd10 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Our fate depends on you! We may be able to get along again or we may become distant.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Please bring them to us as soon as possible!

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
Thanks to you, my brother and sister have become close to each other again.
What would they do without me?

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I'll see you around then.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
Is it your first time to visit the Wigner family?
Then, ^0000cdyou should meet our parents^000000 over there first.

scripts.speaker: Womenfolk
scripts.text: Jurgen, you are mine!

scripts.speaker: Bachelor
scripts.text: I couldn't shake hands with Jurgen! Oh, it's too hot!

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, you shouldn't bring too much stuff in here.
As you see there are a lot of fragile things.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: You need to leave some out. It would be a big problem if the bundle touches the dishes and breaks them.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
I am cleaning the kitchen now, which is the hardest place to clean. It is really difficult to get rid of all the dirt in here.
My arms are way too weak to handle it.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: I happen to see someone with a strong set of arms... Those arms... What brought you here?
Hello, I am the adventurer invited to the royal banquet. Are you the maid who have cleaned the Wigner residence this afternoon?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Yes, I am. What can I do for you?
Did you happen to see ^0000cda small box^000000 in the Wigner residence? It was supposed to be on the table next to the bed. The box belongs to Princess Katrin. Have you seen it?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Yes, I have. It was the box which looked simple but classy. I held it up for a second to clean the table and put it down. I remember it.
Did you see it there when you leave the room? Wasn't there anyone else in the room?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Wait a moment. I know where you are getting with this. We, maids, often get into a situation like this.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Isn't the box missing and are you ^0000cdsuspecting the maid who has cleaned the room^000000? Am I right?
I am not suspecting you. I am just ^0000cdasking you about the situation^000000 to track the box.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: With an element of suspicion in your mind, right?
No, I am not suspecting you. Please don't get me wrong. I am just asking you when you have seen it and if there haven't been anyone else there.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Ha, you are not being honest with me. If I say that there was no one around, I would be suspected, right?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: I can tell you this one though. I didn't take it. If you ask me if there was anyone in the room, well...
There was someone in the room, right?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Was there? This kitchen is too messy that I cannot think straight. ^0000cdI may be able to recall if it is cleaned up^000000.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Oh, the kitchen is messy and so are the thoughts inside my head. Oh, how dirty and messy!
May I help you clean up?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Oh, would you do that for me? I would be so grateful. Here is a ^0000cdPoring Scrub Sponge^000000, please scrub every inch of this place clean.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Since it is a specially-maid Scrub Sponge, it serves multiple purposes. It coaches you on how to clean so make good use of it.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
You may be surprised by it, but it is a safe Scrub Sponge which doesn't hurt others. Don't worry.
It is a Scrub Sponge developed by a legendary figure.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Oh, wait! You know, there is a certain protocol when it comes to cleaning. You first need to wipe off the mold on the wall. Then you have to clean up the grease. The last thing for you to do is cleaning the floor.
I... I see.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Have you finished it already?
It doesn't seem so. The thoughts in my head haven't cleared up yet.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: I think I would be able to recall when you come back after cleaning the kitchen with the Scrub Sponge I have given you.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Wow... The kitchen has become so clean! You really need to clean the grease with a strong set of arms!
Argh... My arms... Was there anyone else in the room?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: You must know what kind of family that is. It is the wealthiest family in Rune-Midgarts. Despite being a temporary residence, the room was decorated with so much care.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: All the gorgeous pieces of furniture and carpets... I have never seen tiger skin as white and huge as that one in there.
Why are you talking about the furniture all of a sudden?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, my, how are you going to deal with the members of the royal families with such slow wit?
Think. Why would I ^0000cdtalk about the furniture^000000 ?
...You ^0000cdcan ask the person who was delivering the furniture^000000 .

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
I cannot point it out, but I think I have given you enough clues.
By the way, is the box really missing in the first place?
What do you mean?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
It is not my opinion, but there are these words people say. You know, the rumors.
Since the prince of the Wigner family looks so handsome...

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: He has been the center of the attention since he was young. People say that the lady is stressed about it and does things to draw attention.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: This could be one of her tricks, they say.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: The words haven not been spread yet, but I am sure that everyone will be talking about it even before the teatime is over.
I don't think that is true. She is not that kind of person.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: That's what people say. You don't have to reason with me. Anyways, I should get back to my cleaning duty. If you are not going to help me, please leave me alone now.
Do you know where the man who have delivered the furniture is?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: He must be somewhere in Prontera. Why don't you try visiting the area ^0000cdnear the district office^000000. Most stores are located there.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Oh, by the way, you didn't hear it from me. Not that I said anything to you.
Of course. Thank you for your cooperation.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Dear adventurer, didn't you say that you were going to visit the delivery man?
He must be somewhere ^0000cdnear the district office^000000.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Since I need to clean up. please leave now.
You are getting in the way.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, why can't I get it off easily? I guess I won't be able to go home early.
Why should I do this?
Hello. Do you have a moment?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Yes... Well... Hum.. You are...
Aren't you the adventurer who was at the Wigner residence?

Yes. And I have come here before, and I have helped you with cleaning.
^0000cdDon't you remember...?^000000

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, I am really sorry. ^0000cdI am not good at remembering faces.^000000
What brought you here?
Jurgen of the Wigner family has asked me to give it to you.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: What is it? Why did he give it to me? Is it an invoice? Have I done anything wrong?
No, it is not. Please just read it first.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Hum... I have fallen in love with you at first sight.
Well... Hum... Please accept my love for... Eh... Umm...
He has used some really direct languages here. How very Wigner of him for that he values efficiency... Hahaha...

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Hum... It is... It is... Well, is it what I think it is?
Yes, it is a love letter.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Phew... I am sorry, but you should take it back.
Well... I appreciate his feelings for me... I really do... But please just take it back.
Really? He has just tried to express his feelings... You may as well just keep it...
Oh, are you in a relationship or engaged? Or are you married?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
No, no, I am not. Just take it back with you.
I feel rather overwhelmed... And there is the social class issue as well...

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Most of all, I am not in the situation to date anyone. ^0000cdIt is for a personal reason.^000000
If you say so, I cannot force it. I'll deliver your words to him.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Yes. I am really sorry.
May I get your name at least?

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Mad... No, ^0000cdMary^000000. My name is Mary.
I see. Then let me deliver your words to Jurgen.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Well, have you told the prince about it? Please make sure not to hurt his feelings much.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Please.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?

Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!

Oh, hello.
Is it a bad time? Should I just go?

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
Oh, no.
By the way, you are back. Is it about the prince of the Wigner family again?

Yes. Jurgen seems to be really serious about it.
He wants you to have these.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
I turned it down.
Oh, this really is... So pretty. There is water inside this glass-like thing...
Yes. Jurgen wants me to let you know about his heart as wide and beautiful as the sea.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: Oh, I really cannot go out with him. Well, there really is a reason that I cannot accept this feelings. I wonder if I should tell you this.
Please tell me. If you have a good enough reason which Jurgen can understand, he would not bother you again, Mary.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I don't think it would be a good idea. You shouldn't tell this to anyone. Please keep the secret.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: In fact, I am ^0000cdthe younger sibling of the maid who used to work here^000000. The maid you have met before.
Oh, no wonder you couldn't remember my face. I found it a little strange. By the way, you two sisters must have worked here together.
However, what would it matter since it is you whom he has fallen for?

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: It matters. ^0000cdBecause, I am her brother^000000.
Oh, you are...
Wha... What? A brother?

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I am ashamed to work in this outfit since I am a man. However, there is a reason for me to stay here like this.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: My sister was very disheartened by what had happened to her and ran off with her lover saying that she couldn't work here anymore.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: When I told the person who is in charge of managing the maids at the palace, he said, he didn't care about my sister running off against the contract ^0000cdas long as I would bring someone to fill her position^000000.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: He added how ^0000cdan enormous indemnity would be imposed on us^000000 if we fail to do so.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: When I told him that I would fill her spot, he said there were enough male chamberlains and ^0000cdhe needed a maid^000000 who would work in the kitchen and run cleaning duties.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I tried to find a replacement for her, but I couldn't. Everyone was already busy working at the palace or supplying the things for the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: After consulting my mother, I decided to work here pretending as if I was my sister. Since everyone was so busy, no one paid attention to me who was working quietly in this corner.
You have managed not to be busted so far.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: Since ^0000cdI look just like my sister^000000, no one seems to notice.
What should we do then? Jurgen really wants you to accept his love.
He is in sorrow saying how difficult it is to get the first thing he has ever wanted in this entire life.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I feel sorry for that ^0000cdthe first thing he has ever wanted to get happens to be fake^000000.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I assumed that the people who have all the money in the world and have seen all the good things in the world must have a keen eye. I stand corrected.
You get blinded when you are in love.
And, you really are doing so remarkably at what you are doing now.
I guess I should go back and tell him the truth.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
Oh! No, you shouldn't. I told you. You are the only one who knows about it.
^0000cdIf I get busted, I would be in trouble^000000. We don't have the money to pay the compensation.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I am keep sending the message to my sister to comeback, but it seems difficult to reach her. Would you please keep it secret until the banquet is over?
Jurgen would keep sending me to earn your love, and this means that we are deceiving him.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I am sorry for him, but my life depends on this.
Hum, I don't feel comfortable doing this...

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: It is not my fault to be here in this clothing... Please feel for me.
Oh, OK. Calm down. I'll tell Jurgen that you have held off the answer.
Please take good care of the stuff. If you return them, he will send me down here again.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: Really? Then let me return them at once on the last day of the banquet. Please explain him well so that it doesn't hurt his feelings.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: Oh, I guess I should change my cleaning area so that I don't bump into him.

Yes, I guess it would work.
Then, let me go tell him that.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
Did you tell the prince about it?
I am worried about the consequences if anything goes wrong.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: I may have to run off like my sister.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text: Did you tell the prince about it? I hope he gives up from tomorrow without sending you down here again.

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?

scripts.speaker: Mary
scripts.text:
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?

Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Adventurer? What brought you here?
Jurgen sent me here to deliver his love to you again.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Again... I really hoped he would have given up by today... I guess it must have been a vain hope.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Please tell him I appreciate it.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: I really want the banquet to be over soon. Or my sister could just come back.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Anyway, I am sorry to put you in the difficult situation again today.
Well then, since I have delivered you what I have to deliver you, I should get going.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text: Yes, please go back safely. I hope he gives up by tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Maid
scripts.text:
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Dear human, are you the one who have waken me up?
After a long sleep, I am waken up before such a mess.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
I am the god of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
You shall pay for your sin of interrupting my rest with cleaning.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Let's see. This must be ^0000cda cluster of mold^000000!
You cannot get this mold without borrowing strength from its own race and the god.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Bring ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Human, what are you doing now?
I told you! You need ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000 to clean up the mold!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
How can you clean up without them?
Go get them first.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Since you have the Mold Powder and alcohol with you, try getting rid of the mold now.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: This is not the proper way of wiping off the mold, but this is the only way to get rid of such severe mold.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Wipe the Mold Power over the mold which resembles demon's skin and sprinkle it with Holy Water.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: And wipe it as I tell you. I am not going to tell you again so pay attention.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Tap it once gently and tap it three times more. You really need to soak the wall with the Holy Water and Mold Powder to wipe it off. This is very important.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Then, you need to scrub hard about ten times and wipe it off in circles about five times. Why don't you try now?

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
That's not it! You really need to be determined to get rid of the flower of devil.
Compose yourself and listen again carefully.

Well done. You have cleaned it so well.
As a Scrub Sponge, I am very contented.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Since I have fulfilled my duty, I shall go now!
Thank you, human... Thank you for being with me for this life...

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
That's not it! Relax your arms a little!
Cleaning is not just about physical strength. You are still too far behind to reach the enlightenment. Ease your mind and body to try again.

scripts.speaker: Wall Which Used to Be Moldy
scripts.text: The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge which has been through the cleaning duty with me.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Is it you...? Are you the one who has guided me to ^0000cdthe ingrained grease^000000?
Nice to meet you. I have been a sleep in this waiting for someone who would clean up something with me.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
I am the fairy of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
I wake up when I am near somewhere dirty.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Thank you for choosing me to clean the grease.
I always wanted to clean grease in style.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Hum... For the ingrained grease, ^0000cdthe mixture of orange and alcohol^000000 works the best.
Would you bring ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000? Let's clean up with them!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Oh, wait a moment!
You need ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000 to clean up the ingrained grease.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
I would like to prepare it myself but I am just a Scrub Sponge.
Please bring them with you.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Since we have the orange and alcohol, let's clean up together now!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Peel the orange and put the orange peels in the alcohol. Then wait a moment. You may eat the flesh of orange if you want. Yum!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Well, the essence of the orange peels must have been infused in the alcohol by now. Spray it over the grease and wipe with me.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: It takes some skills to wipe it off.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
First you need to scrub gently, gently once more and hard! Then scrub with medium strength and scrub harder.
You should then spray the mixture once more and keep wiping with medium strength.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: I think you are scrubbing too gently. You should allow sometime for the grease to dissolve in the mixture.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: First, you need to penetrate the grease with the mixture. Then you need to wipe off the grease. Well, let's try again.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Whoa, good job! The grease is gone now!
Even better, the fresh scent remains after cleaning, making the passengers happy.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
However, I will disappear soon.
It is the fate of dirty Scrub Sponge.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
However, I was happy to spend the short life of a Scrub Sponge with you.
I want to be born as a human in my next life to be a close... Friend of yours...

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
You shouldn't just wipe it too hard. You need to let the mixture melt into the grease to get it off.
Scrub gently and wipe it off at once. Well, listen up again.

scripts.speaker: Scrapped-off Wall
scripts.text: The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge has been really kind to me.

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Is it you? Are you the one in charge of the cleaning mission today?
Nice to meet you! I am the cleaning instructor sealed in the Scrub Sponge!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
If you follow my lead, you can get through the most difficult cleaning mission in this world!
Do you understand?

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Let's check today's target! It is ^0000cdthe black dirt of devil^000000 stuck in the gaps in the floor!
We have a Thor 3 situation here!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
In other words, we can resolve it as long as we have all the materials ready!
You need ^0000cd1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon^000000 to get rid of the target!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Go get them now!
Go!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
What are you doing now?
You cannot get rid of the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles without the lemon and powdery find sand!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Prepare 1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon now!
Go!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Good! It has all been prepared!
Let's start cleaning now!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Squeeze the lemon and sprinkle the juice over the floor. Then sprinkle the powdery fine sand over it!
This will whiten and polish the floor! Not to mention the fresh scent of lemon adding something extra!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Then you scrub briskly with me!
The method of scrubbing is as follows! It is not difficult if you follow me! Listen up!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Three times to the left! Once to the right! Once to the left again! Twice to the front!
Then twice to the left to wrap up! Start now!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Wrong!
Try to keep it together! Repeat once again!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
Well done!
You have completed the cleaning mission beautifully!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
I believe that you can handle cleaning perfectly even without me!
Old soldiers never die! They just fade away! So save the tears!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text:
You may think of me whenever you see and clean the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles!
Now disperse! Go!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
