scripts.text: When did I teach you like that? Don't you dare say that you have learned it from me!

scripts.speaker: Scrub Sponge
scripts.text: Try to keep it together! Listen up once more!

scripts.speaker: Shining Floor
scripts.text:
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
Let's go back to the maid and report that the cleaning is completed.

scripts.speaker: Shining Floor
scripts.text: The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Oh, my arms, legs, back and my entire body hurts. Well, I am just glad that today's work is done. I can take some rest now. I should go have some hot soup. Is it supposed to be the meat soup for today?
May I ask you something?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: What is it? Is it about furniture delivery? I am off my duty today. Unless it is really urgent, would you please come back tomorrow?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: I am exhausted from today's work. I almost cannot stand with my back straight now.
No, it is not about that. You are the one who has delivered the furniture to the Wigner family, right?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Yes, I have... Is there any problem with the furniture? What should I do? I would never be able to afford the furniture!

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: What if there is a dent? Should I call James to fix it? Damage? Wrong delivery? What should I do? What is it about?
No, nothing like that. Please relax.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: What is it? Additional delivery? I really want to take some rest now... However, I guess I have no choice since it is the Wigners that I am dealing with. Oh, I really hate it... It is just too difficult to make ends meet.
No, I just have a question for you. Have you seen a small box on the table in the room?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: What box? I was busy delivering the furniture... Wait, I remember it.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: You mean the ^0000cdsmall box^000000 on the table next to the bed, right? The locked box with no particular decoration.
I believe so.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text:
Yes, I remember it. It was a simple box without any decoration, but it looked very classy.
The wood was of the finest quality and the locking device was exquisite. I could tell that it must have been made by a master artisan at a glance.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Since I work with furniture, a piece like that really catches my eyes. It really was a work of art.
Was the box still there after you delivered the furniture?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Yes, it was. The box cannot move itself, can it?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Oh, wait? Are you telling me that it is missing? Are you implying that it has been carried out in my carriage?
No. Please calm down. I am not suspecting you. I just want to listen to your story. I am just tracking the whereabouts of the box based on the words of the people who have seen the box.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text:
If anything goes missing, it is always us, the ordinary people, who are suspected. Do you know that it is just a prejudice?
The people who have less must be hungry for money. And they are unvirtuous...
It is just a misunderstanding. Trust me, I am not suspecting you.... You know, you look for any witnesses when a person goes missing.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: I don't want to hear it! Why are you scaring an innocent furniture delivery man for some missing box?
I am sorry to make you uncomfortable. I am just asking everyone who has been in that room. I am not suspecting you.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Heh, not that it makes me feel any better. I think I may be feeling even worse since I am hungry. Oh, my stomach is growling... I don't feel well...
Do you need something to eat?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: It doesn't change anything even if you say that...Well, I may be able to let it go if I have some Ox Head Slices... I cannot forget the taste from 10 years ago...
Would it make you feel better?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Well, not that it will... OK, good! I'll let it go for ^0000cd3 Ox Head Slices^000000! Fair is fair after all.
Would it be enough? OK, please wait for me then.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset as I get parched with thirst.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text:
Your hands seem empty.
Did you forget? I said I would let it go with ^0000cd3 {0}^000000.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: I wouldn't let it go without them! I won't! I'll tell people that there is an adventurer who frames an innocent person! He!

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset due to my raging stomach.
Well, it was very difficult to get them. Here you are.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Let's see! Oh, this is it! Have you had good wine with some Ox Head Slices? You will never get over this heavenly combination!

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: This tastes the same as it did 10 years ago! Now I feel fully recovered from the fatigue! I don't feel tired any more! All the stress is gone!
Oh, it sure looks delicious. I should try some later. Anyways, do you know anything else about the box?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Are we still talking about it? Let's not talk about such thing while I am enjoying some wine and meat. My carriage is heavy when I get in, but it is as light as a feather when I get out.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: If you feel suspicious, ask the Gate Guard. He inspected my carriage.
Hum...

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Oh, well. By the way...
By the way?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Have you seen the princess of the family? You must have. Doesn't she appear suspicious to you? I can tell people's character by their faces. She seems to be hiding something. She may stab you in the back.
Isn't it called a prejudice to judge some based on the appearance?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text:
You are right. I feel sorry, However, there are people talking about it. There's no smoke without fire.
No? Well. Perhaps, there could be smoke without fire.
Katrin was not that kind of person as far as I observed.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Well, if not, that's fine. Anyways, the box was there in its place when I left the room. You may go if you don't have any business left here.
Excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, why are you here again? Didn't you say you were heading back to the palace?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: Do you have more things to as me? Or are you going to drink with me?

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: I wouldn't mind.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text: I should earn enough money to open a store of my own. The owner only lets me deliver the furniture and never teaches me how to make one.

scripts.speaker: Furniture Deliveryman
scripts.text:
All the cutting and delivery work will break my back.
Oh, my back hurts.

scripts.speaker: Ryosun
scripts.text:
I finally have the strawberry cake no one has ever touched.
The things I have been through to keep the cake in the expedition camp... I am about to burst into tears... Aww...

scripts.speaker: Ryosun
scripts.text: Strawberry! Strawberry! This strawberry cake belongs to Ryosun! I won't give it to anyone.

scripts.speaker: Chamberlain
scripts.text:
Are you having a good time?
We have put a lot of efforts since it's a big event in the palace in a long while.
I hope you like it.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: It is always my pleasure to attend a banquet. Traveling and learning about different cultures are always interesting. It just makes it better to have good music and delicious food.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: It is always tiring to attend a banquet. I am still tired from the trip, it is just too painful to mingle with people... Phew...

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: The Palace of Rune Midgarts is so big and glamourous. It somewhat feels exotic too. It's been a long way, but I am glad to be here.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: Oh, aren't you the adventurer who has saved the world? Please visit Portmalaya someday. Everyone will welcome you there! Your story is known even to a far away place from here!

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: The music played by the music makes me so emotional. It is worthwhile to come here for this music alone.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: Wait, I have been looking at the flowers here. Are they blinking? How wonderful!

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: I visited the Palace of Rune Midgarts long time ago. It has changed a lot ever since. It has become much more glamourous and magnificent that I really enjoy being guided around this place.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: There are a long of people here. I almost feel dizzy. However, still, I like the lively atmosphere.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: I have come to Prontera to attend the banquet from Amatsu. It sure feels totally different from Amatsu. Hahaha.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: Grandfather, don't overtax your strength.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: All the nobility who are in charge of the market in Rune Midgarts are here. We, the Cat Hand Services, shouldn't miss this chance.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text: I'll score contracts as tall as my height.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text:
I am an old fan of Orint of the band.
I have spent a lot of money and time not to miss any of his performance.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text:
It was very difficult to get my hands on the invitation to this banquet.
It was so exclusive that I almost joined the expedition!

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Guest
scripts.text:
The twin sisters of the band are of completely different characters. However, they are good at imitate each other.
When they pretend to be one person, they really looks like Doppelgangers.

scripts.speaker: Ekinasia
scripts.text:
You have been invited to the banquet as well.
Well, no wonder... If you think about it.

scripts.speaker: Lin
scripts.text:
Oh, you are still alive!
I am glad to see you here. Life must be treating you well!

scripts.speaker: Ekinasia
scripts.text:
Come to think of it, Kid is here too.
He met the people from the guild and went to see them...

scripts.speaker: Lin
scripts.text:
Hum... Then he was taken by a strange guy among the bunch to the dining hall.
You may go say hi.

scripts.speaker: Ekinasia
scripts.text: It is a banquet in a long time. We may as well enjoy it.

scripts.speaker: Lin
scripts.text:
Well, this is how the aristocrats spend their time!
Haha, let's see which lady is wearing the most beautiful dress.

scripts.speaker: Mayssel
scripts.text: Who are you...?

scripts.speaker: Mayssel
scripts.text:
...Oh... You have visited us to change your class, I remember.
We have recommended you as a representative of the guild.

scripts.speaker: Mayssel
scripts.text:
I am glad to see you all grown up.
Never forget the weight of the blood to be covered on your hands at all times.

scripts.speaker: Mayssel
scripts.text:
You must have been invited to the banquet.
So are we.

scripts.speaker: Mayssel
scripts.text: It is rare to see the palace open to public like this. Enjoy as much as you can.

scripts.speaker: Verkhasel
scripts.text: ...I don't like a crowded place like this, but I cannot help it when I am on a mission.

scripts.speaker: Verkhasel
scripts.text:
You are here too.
Well, I guess you are supposed to be here.

scripts.speaker: Verkhasel
scripts.text: ...What a trouble.

scripts.speaker: Vicente
scripts.text:
Oh, is it the first time since our last encounter for your class change?
Thanks to your contribution, the position of the guild has been strengthened.

scripts.speaker: Vicente
scripts.text:
I guess you will be the hero of the palace.
I am glad to see you well.

scripts.speaker: Vicente
scripts.text: Hum... Did we meet at Criatura?

scripts.speaker: Vicente
scripts.text:
I have dealt with too many people...
Your face seemed familiar...

scripts.speaker: Vicente
scripts.text:
Well whatever.
Are you enjoying the banquet?

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Aristocrat
scripts.text:
I really like banquets.
The drowsy music, the whispering people and the chamberlains carrying the refreshments. I think I am nobly born to see it.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Aristocrat
scripts.text: I know this banquet is held for someone else. However, it still is a great opportunity for me to meet someone I can spend my life with.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Aristocrat
scripts.text: Everyone else seems to love the banquet, but I don't. I am forced by my parents to come here. I really want to go home and take a rest now.

scripts.speaker: Banquet Hall Aristocrat
scripts.text:
This band is pretty good.
I'd like to invite them to the royal villa for my party.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Ellie
scripts.text: Dwit! Look at the nobility over there. Aren't they beautiful?

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Dwit
scripts.text:
Hum, yes they are. I think you would fit in there perfectly though.
One day, I'll play the guitar next to you dancing and singing in a blue dress.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Occi
scripts.text: Haha, that woman in the blue dress, it could be me!

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Dwit
scripts.text: You are mistaken if you think I cannot distinguish you twin sisters, Occi. I can tell your differences from the steps you take and the sound of your breath.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Dwit
scripts.text: When I first met Orint, I thought he was stoic and unconcerned. However, he turned out to be a man of extraordinary concentration and possessiveness.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Dwit
scripts.text: He always tries to be the best. That's why he can play the tune like that.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Dwit
scripts.text: However, he doesn't know when to concentrate. His behavior is often misread.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Dwit
scripts.text:
Anyways, we are invited to an honorable place like this thanks to Orint.
If you want to hear any song, ask him to play it for you.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Occi
scripts.text: It has been our dream to ensemble in a place like this. Am I right, Orint?

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text: Chatting is forbidden while working.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Occi
scripts.text: Yes, I see. You are so boring. But it is part of your charm, haha.
- That lazy-looking cat is sitting near the feet of the musician. It shows no interest in you. -

scripts.speaker: Hiba Ajif
scripts.text: Since Ashbacuum has been taken care of, I want to go home and take a nap. However, they are holding me here.

scripts.speaker: Avidal the Advisor
scripts.text: It is the event to praise our contributions. Try to smile a little.

scripts.speaker: Instructor Igrid
scripts.text: Brother, these shoes hurt my feet. May I go back to the guest room and sleep?

scripts.speaker: Hiba Ajif
scripts.text:
]If you can't avoid it, enjoy it...
I shall get drunk fast.

scripts.speaker: Avidal the Advisor
scripts.text: I have spent too much time in the tension between the two races. It just feels like I am dreaming to be in a happy and relaxing place like this. This must be what they call peace, right?

scripts.speaker: Instructor Igrid
scripts.text:
If they really want to do something for us, they really let us take a rest.
Only the ones who don't work in the field like an event like this. It is true.

scripts.speaker: Bruno
scripts.text:
Argh... I have never been to a place like this...
I am so nervous... I shouldn't have come...

scripts.speaker: Bruno
scripts.text: Everyone dresses so fancy...

scripts.speaker: Bruno
scripts.text: By the way, where has the master gone leaving me alone?

scripts.speaker: Karian
scripts.text:
Banquets are fun!
Good food! Beautiful music! People talking to one another!

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: I have heard that my grandson is under indebtedness to your son these days.

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Not at all. My son is supposed to be learning from your smart grandson. Haha.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Please take care of our son, Isaac.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: Many things have changed since the last time we were here in the palace. I want to come here more often, but we cannot find the excuse to come...

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: You can come here with an invitation. It is not difficult visiting here.

scripts.speaker: Catherine
scripts.text: You know that is not what I mean...

scripts.speaker: Levuiere
scripts.text: Dear Roegenburg, how are your children doing? I often hear about your third grandson from Isaac/

scripts.speaker: Maximilian
scripts.text: Oh, they are doing fine. Please visit our home when you get the time.

scripts.speaker: Bagette Teeblack
scripts.text: I have a lot of study to do... I feel terrible to be dragged to a banquet like this.

scripts.speaker: Bagette Teeblack
scripts.text: I wonder if Theodor is handling the work well by himself.

scripts.speaker: Isabella
scripts.text: I really like banquets. Especially the ones hosted by the palace! Everything is so glamourous and sparkly!

scripts.speaker: Beatrice
scripts.text: In a banquet like this, we, women, study other women. About who is wearing which dress and what kind of jewelry she is wearing...

scripts.speaker: Beatrice
scripts.text: Those judging eyes are as sharp as those of ferocious beasts. If we find a lady who looks fabulous, we admire her looks with pure admiration.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text:
Hahahahaha!
I should have seen the face! Please invite me to one of those events next time.

scripts.speaker: Isabella
scripts.text: Oh, you are always so busy, Isaac. A banquet like this one is the only occasion I can see your face.

scripts.speaker: Beitrice
scripts.text: Yes! You must be ranked in top 3 of the busiest people in Prontera these days, Isaac.

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text: He also comes home late after discussing business with Isaac everyday. I really don't like it.

scripts.speaker: Bryan
scripts.text: Don't you say such a thing!

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry to keep Bryan with me. Please excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: However, please understand. It is the most important time for our business. I'll tell him to devote his time to you after this time is over, dear Sophia.

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text: Oh, you should keep those words!

scripts.speaker: Isaac
scripts.text: I'll make sure of it. I swear in the name of Isaac Wigner.

scripts.speaker: Isabella
scripts.text: Haha, since you have promised me in the name of your family, I guess I can trust you, Isaac.

scripts.speaker: Bryan
scripts.text: Don't leave me alone today. I feel nervous if you are not next to me.

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text: Oh dear, I want to catch up with the people whom I haven't been able to see for a long time. You may go talk to other people.

scripts.speaker: Bryan
scripts.text: They only talk about business. I don't enjoy it at all. I don't want to feel like being at work when I am here.

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text: Then, you should follow me.

scripts.speaker: Bryan
scripts.text: Well.. I don't feel comfortable... With too many ladies around...

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text:
Oh, darling, I love to be here in the palace after a long time. There are so many friendly faces around here.
However...

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text: Everyone else looks so nice, and I feel rather underdressed.

scripts.speaker: Bryan
scripts.text: It is not true! You are the most beautiful person in this place. You are the only one I see here.

scripts.speaker: Sophia
scripts.text: Oh, I am so embarrassed...

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: If you are going to borrow a book, you'd better reduce your luggage. It seems that there is no space for a book.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Have you read the book? Did you come to return the book. Well, seeing your hands empty, it seems that you didn't finished the book yet.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
Hey, I'm looking for a book. Would you please advice me where it is?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: What kind of book are you looking for?
A book about history of Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
Hm... history of Rune-Midgarts.
Are you going to borrow the book?
Yes.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: May I see your library card, please?
Library card? I don't have such a thing.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Then, I cannot borrow a book to you.
How can I have a library card?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: If you present your identification card, we will make you one instantly.
Huh... I don't have it. I left all my things to attend the banquet.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Banquet? You mean the banquet held in the palace? Are you the adventurer invited to it?
Yes, I am...

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Then you are a person guaranteed by the kingdom and I can borrow a book to you through a simple process.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: The kingdom circulated your details and ordered to provide maximum convenience to you.
It's nice, but I feel that privacy is not protected.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: What is you name, sir?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
Let me see...
Yes, here it is. Sir {0}...

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
But this book consists of 12 volumes. Only the first volume is here and the others are already borrowed.
Is it OK with you?
Yes, it is.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Hmm. Anyway, can I ask you some questions? I know nothing as I stay in the library all day long.
Yes, I tell you as long as I know.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: ^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?
Birth of prince.
Birthday of king.
In memory of defeating Morocc.

I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: ^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Ah, I see.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
8 royal families attended it.
7 royal families attended it.
6 royal families attended it.

I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: The palace must be crowded. It is very rare that all royal families gather like this, but...

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
Wigner and Heine.
Roegenburg and Richard.
Geoborg and Walther.

I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Well, it is understandable that the Geoborg and the Walther do not attend the assembly.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
You mean the Nerius?
You mean the Geoborg?
You mean the Richard?

I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
Yes, you are right. it is ^0000cdthe Geoborg^000000. The queen must be lonely.
Thank you very much for advising me though you are busy.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
I have been alone these days as no one has visited the library due to the banquet.
History of Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: You can borrow it for one week. There is a fee for overdue books, but I was instructed to make you exempt from it

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Well, if you make much of honor, you will not be overdue.

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text: Then, enjoy the book!

scripts.speaker: Uptight Librarian
scripts.text:
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
There are so many guests attending the banquet.
However, since we are in the library, would you keep it down?

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
Are you attending the banquet and exchanging greeting with each family?
Then you should go see Spica Nerius, not me.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text: Although Shedhar, the current head of the family, is not here, Spica has all the actual power.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text: I am just participating in the Royal Assembly to fill in the place as a Nerius.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
I am not interested in the throne at all.
So you should go see Spica.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text: Enjoy the banquet too.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
Did you meet Spica?
She is such a cheerful girl, isn't she?

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text: She will be the head of the Nerius family.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text: I am treated like a prince since I was adopted against my will. However, Shedhar, the head of the family, has been nice to me.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
She told me to do whatever I wanted.
...She even let me decide whether I should attend the ritual or not,

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
I think I will be forgiven whatever I do.
I seem to have gained freedom and negligence at the same time.

scripts.speaker: Erich
scripts.text:
I like the way it is now though.
I can do whatever I want to do.

scripts.speaker: Oliver
scripts.text:
Oh! This! That! This!
And there it is!

scripts.speaker: Oliver
scripts.text: Oh, I don't have this book in my collection!

scripts.speaker: Oliver
scripts.text: How great to be in the palace! There is everything!

scripts.speaker: Alf
scripts.text: Oh! This book must be the one from the legend...

scripts.speaker: Alf
scripts.text:
I wasn't interested in attending the royal banquet...
However, I am glad to be here!

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: It is not here either....

scripts.speaker: Taunting Man
scripts.text: Why do you need that book? Just go without it.

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: The first impression is the most important. The first greeting has a big impact! By the way, what should I speak as a greeting?

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: 'Good morning, sir. I, an unworthy person, live in Prontera....' No. No. I cannot speak like to a person who is younger than me.

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: Hi? Your brother told me to attend the banquet. No. No. this is not either. My patner is a princess!

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: Why is there no book such as ¡®Royal Etiquette - Meet Princess First Time' It's a royal library.

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: He sent me on the excuse of being busy. Jonathan, I'll get you.

scripts.speaker: Nervous Man
scripts.text: It is not here, either. How can I find it. There are so many books here.

scripts.speaker: Royal Guardian Knight
scripts.text: Would you enter the Banquet Hall?
Enter.
Do not enter.

scripts.speaker: Royal Guardian Knight
scripts.text: The Banquet Hall will be open at all times. Please honor the banquet with your presence.

scripts.speaker: Royal Guardian Knight
scripts.text: Let me escort you inside.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text: Chatting is forbidden while working.
Please play a song
Wrap up the conversation

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text:
This is not a song in the program...
How about listening to a song I recommend?

scripts.text: I'll play <Theme of Alberta>.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text: I'll play <Splendide Dreams>.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text: I'll play <Jittering Nightmare>.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text: I'll play <Yuna Song>.

scripts.speaker: Court Musician Orint
scripts.text:
I'll play <Good Morning> which has a sad story behind it.

I'll play <Good Morning> which has a sad story behind it.
- Unlike her gaze glaring at the table while being cautious about the surroundings, the speed of her eating the food on the table is so remarkable that it is almost artistic. -
- There is a girl with a expressionless face looking at the table. Her outfit seems rather unusual in Prontera. She could be a guest attending the banquet. -

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text:
......
...I am hungry.

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text: You... At Cheshrumnir...

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: Hum hum!

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text: ...I am sorry Niren...

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: Shh! Shh! Do not call me by the name, please. We are not officially invited to be here! Don't forget!
How did you come here?

How did you come here?
Is it something dangerous? Is it about the international affairs or the international situation...

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text:
.....
In secret.

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text: ...The banquet... Something tasty.

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: <Miss Lang>
What?

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: In the <Miss Lang Guide> which is written by Miss Lang who is the most prominent gourmet in Midgards, there is Prontera Palace.

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: Good food and drink are the most enjoyable things in life. It is worth pursuing them. Isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text:
....
...It tastes good.

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: Anyways, we have managed to find this dining room where aren't many people. But we need to go back soon.

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: I have been telling people that we are in costumes. I guess our outfits are not very appropriate for this kind of occasion in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Woman with Glasses
scripts.text: Well, I guess you have looked around enough. Let's go back before anyone comes.

scripts.speaker: Glamorous Girl
scripts.text: Yes...
- However the cookie plate is held tightly by the right hand of the Pope. -

scripts.speaker: Dumk
scripts.text:
Oh, who is this.
You are{0}the one who would lead to the highest peaks of dark art, right?

scripts.speaker: Dumk
scripts.text:
You've been invited to this banquet too?
Hum, are you the hero of the century recommended by the guild?

scripts.speaker: Dumk
scripts.text:
Ha, what a nonsense to disregard me, Dumk!
I can never agree to that.

scripts.speaker: Dumk
scripts.text: By the way, where is Vicente?

scripts.speaker: Dumk
scripts.text: Hey, you assassin, do you know Vicente?

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: ...Cut it out there, Dumk...

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: It's been a long time. Did you catch up with Lin and Ekinasia?

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: They seemed very excited in the fancy place...
...It is a pain to stand in a place where you don't belong...

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
You are a visitor to the Prontera Palace.
Do you need a guide?
Valkyrie Realm
Royal Villa
Banquet Hall

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
You may move to the northern corridor from here.
There is the entrance to Valkyrie Realm in the middle of the northern corridor.

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text:
The door on the left is the entrance to the royal villa.
There are the residences for the Heine, Nerius and Walther families and a room reserved for a special guest.

scripts.speaker: Guardian Knight
scripts.text: You can enter the Banquet Hall through the big gate which appears when you go to the center by following the corridor on the right from here.

scripts.speaker: Noblesse Operator
scripts.text:
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffNoblesse^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text: You can exchange the Honor Marks given by the noble people of Rune-Midgarts as the token of trust with some valuable items of Prontera.
Consumables
Armors
View item description

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text: Would you view the item description?

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text: The ^3131FF{0}s^000000 you can exchange with the Honor Marks are as follows.

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text:
^3131FF{0}^000000... You've been looking at this.
It is a useful-looking {1}.
It can be exchanged for ^FF0000{2} Honor Marks^000000.
Exchange
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text: For the glory of Prontera!

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text: You don't have enough Honor Marks.

scripts.speaker: Commissary Arner
scripts.text: It is the symbol of honor in Prontera. Please take good care of it.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text:
Are you the adventurer invited to the banquet every one is talking about?
Do you have any <Honor Marks>? Would you give them to me?
Why do you need them?
Give 30 Honor Marks.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text:
Even if I work so hard here my entire life, I would always live in the shade.
If you are a man, you should dream big. I always say that to Arner, but he is just too priggery.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text: I don't dream of becoming rich overnight, but I do want to have some honor since I am a man.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text: The aristocrats would never let me handle some great opportunity though. However, you may have acquired some <Honor Marks>, right?

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text:
If you give me ^FF0000 30 <Honor Marks>^000000, I'll give you something really useful.
For people like us, the <Honor Marks> mean rapid promotion.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text: What I have is a wrapped box which is one of the items that Arner has.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text: It is authentic for that it has been made to be distributed to the nobility. However, I don't know what's in there. It depends on your luck.

scripts.speaker: Sin the Logistics Manager
scripts.text:
After collecting all the Honor Marks, I'll take that build a castle on the shore and spend the rest of my life there with that stubborn Arner.
That stupid Arner. If it was not for me, he would stay in the palace exchanging things until he dies.

^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...

Right.

We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.

scripts.speaker: Corrupt Warder
scripts.text: What is it? Did Dylan send you here? If you are going to deal with me, don't waste any more time. There are a lot of people watching us.
What's the deal?
Let's deal.

scripts.speaker: Corrupt Warder
scripts.text: Isn't Dylan making some strange powder whenever he breaks a thing?

scripts.speaker: Corrupt Warder
scripts.text: It is ^0000ffRune Magic Powder^000000 which the magicians use for their experiments. I don't think Dylan knows this.

scripts.speaker: Corrupt Warder
scripts.text: I'll ^0000ffexchange 30 Rune Magic Powders for 1 Mysterious Blue Box^000000. How do you like that? It is such a sweet deal, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Corrupt Warder
scripts.text: 30 Rune Magic Powders for 1 Mysterious Blue Box. I remind you.

scripts.speaker: Corrupt Warder
scripts.text: Good, it is a great deal.
There are too many kinds of items in possession. Reduce the type of the items and try again.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Are you a customer? I am not going to get more customers today because I am tired.
Are you running a business in the prison?

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Although I may look like this now, I used to be called the man with the hand of minus out there. It is quite dangerous stuff. You'd better stay away.
^0000ffUnlike his words, he really seems eager to give an explanation.^000000
I don't want to waste time here.
What kind of business you are running here.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Don't be a chicken...

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Honor Mark, which is issued by the kingdom and not to be traded between individuals. I receive it and enhance people's equipment.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: As you can tell, it is against the law. That's why I used to only work for through personal contacts. However, one guy whose equipment was broken while resetting the enhancement informed on me.
It really is a crime.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I don't need to hear of some personal impression by you. Although I am caught, I am roaming the prison freely thanks to the warder over there.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Of course, I cannot get out to avoid causing the real problem. That's why I stay in the prison like this. Are you interested in the deal?
The kingdom has poor public security.
What is the deal?

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: What a nerd. I told you to back off if you didn't want to get involved.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: You are a great fellow to deal with. I want to save enough money to bail myself out. Any customers are welcome here.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I enhance the three items, Flattery Robe, Invective Robe and Prontera Badge for Honor Mark.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I guess I don't need to explain about it anymore. Just bring the equipment you want to enhance to me.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Are you here to deal with me? Tell me what you need now.
Tell me about the deal.
Enhance Robe
Enhance Badge
Reset Enhanced Robe Stats
Reset Enhanced Badge Stats

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Listen carefully. I won't say twice.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I'll enhance one of the Flattery Robe or Invective Robe slot for 20 Honor Marks. I can enhance up to 2 slots. And I take 10 Honor Marks for the reset. Do you follow me so far?

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Next, for the Prontera Badge. I'll take 5 Honor Marks to enhance 1 slot. I can enhance up to 2 slots. And I take 10 Honor Marks for the reset.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I don't perform the reset anytime. I'll do it when the 2 slots are enhanced for that you cannot enhance the item anymore. And... Then...

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Oh, there is one problem though. There is a change that the badge can be destroyed while resetting it. The chance is about 20%. Since it is such a tiny thing, there is some side effect of removing the enhancement.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I hope the deal goes well, buddy.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: You need 20 Honor Marks for each slot of Flattery Robe or Invective Robe. Do you want to enhance it?

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: You need 5 Honor Marks to enhance one slot of the Prontera Badge you are wearing in the left slot of your body. Would you enhance it?

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: You need 10 Honor Marks to reset Invective Robe or Flattery Robe. The equipment won't be destroyed. The bound cards and the refinement level would remain the same as well.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: You need 10 Honor Marks to reset the Prontera Badge you are wearing in the left slot of your body.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: As I told you, it is difficult to reset the badge, ^ff0000The chance of success is 80%.^000000 If it fails, everything will be gone. Would you reset it?
I quit.
Let's do it now.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: I am busy so please don't waste my time by talking to me for no reason.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: You are taking it off.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the equipment.

scripts.speaker: Dylan
scripts.text: It cannot be enhanced anymore. Do you have anything else to enhance?

scripts.speaker: Dylan
