scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text:
~Laughs~ You're an adventurer.
Unauthorized access to this area is restricted. Thank you for your cooperation.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Hello.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I am sorry to say this but unauthorized access to the area you see in the front is restricted. Sorry for the inconvenience and your cooperation will be appreciated.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Come to think of it...Not everyone is allowed to enter this place. Whoa!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I heard the adventurer who made the significant contribution to defeating Devil King Morocc has been invited to the royal banquet.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Since you're here....You must be...!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Have you been invited, adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text:
Whoa, this is unbelievable!
I heard so much about you. I'm a huge fan!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Holy moly! I felt so bad having to guard here in the night of the banquet and I never expected to see you here, Adventurer. Amazing!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text:
Let me introduce myself then.
I am Ellond Lawrence from the Royal Crusaders. I have so much respect for you.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot! Can I get your autograph?
Give him your autograph.
(Decline it.)

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Thank you so much! Now I have something to brag about to my fellows. What an honor to my family.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that, but I understand you have reasons.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, right! I see, right!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Some discussed the idea during the meeting to ask the famous adventurer to handle the problem at the restricted area. No approval was given to it, but I'll see what I can do with my authority.
Problem at the Restricted Area?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, I knew this would pique your interest, Adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: No one will question your reputation and abilities. So I would love to cut to the chase and spill the beans, but...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I think I'll have to take a deep breath and drink a cup of water to calm myself down before I do.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Now that my thirst has been quenched, let me tell you the story.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: This problem has long been a pain in the neck.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: There was zero monster in the beginning for sure, but, out of the total blue, they started to appear in the underground dungeons.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: It doesn't mean we're goofing off around here!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: We crusaders are doing our best to eliminate the monsters in the underground dungeon as much as we can.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Unfortunately, the numbers kept growing to a degree that we can't handle them all by ourselves.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I hate to admit, but we haven't even identified where these monsters come from.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: In the underground dungeon, they are...No. I don't think I should say it right here. You'll see once you get inside.
So, what can I do for you?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I think I have said too much.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: There is no need to submit any investigation report. We've got ours, too.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: What I would like to ask you to do for us is to mop out the monsters in the underground dungeon as much as you can.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: While you're at it, I would much appreciate it if you can let me in on what goes on inside the underground dungeon.
I've been to the Sector A.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Whoa, what did you just say? You've been to Sector A?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I haven't met that bloke in that sector yet, but one of my fellows appointed to that area did say he can be pretty ferocious.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Anyway, it is a relief to hear he hasn't caused any trouble there.
I've been to the Sector B.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, have you?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: ~Laughs~ He had been my junior to me.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: He can be pretty annoying, I know. He would ask to make a lifelike doll, and even try to hit on his female fellows.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: So if he hasn't changed much, that means he's not going to make a problem. I'm relieved to hear that.
I've been to the Sector C.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: ~Laughs~ Have you been to Sector C, eh?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, my days! Did he really say you'll be rewarded for those chores? What an improvement!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: It's not uncommon for the Crusaders to lose something they are not supposed to...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I can see they have improved for some reason. They probably like you a lot.
I've been to the Sector D.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: ~Gasps~ D...Se...Sector...D...?! ~Gulps~

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Don't ever let his looks deceive you! He can be the most dangerous one in the prison.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: If he doesn't try to do anything to you, it must be the best that could ever happen.
I've been to the Sector E.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I know a few things about the Sector E, actually.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Unlike what he looks like, he has such a delicate and warm heart. Still, he can certainly go berserk if things go haywire.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Just make sure he doesn't see red. Otherwise, you're going to do fine, I guess.
I've been to the Sector F.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Sector F, eh? ~Laughs~ The real troublemaker is locked in there.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: He would not even lift a finger, bossing everyone around. He thinks the world revolves around him.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: He can be a complainer but he's harmless. I think you'll be fine with him.
I've been to the Sector G.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, Sector G you say? Hmm, that zone must be...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: That prisoner is often called as the sleeping beauty in the prison. I remember he's been sleeping for quite a while.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I don't have much to say about him because all I saw about him was sleeping. Well, I think you can make good friends with him.
I've been to the Sector H.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Ah, Sector H! ~Bursts into laughter~ Is he still a whiner?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I was responsible for him when I first came here and his requests were endless!

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Anyway, he means well.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: In case you forgot, you took a full tour around the underground dungeon.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Phenomenal! You are indeed worthy to be invited to the royal banquet on behalf of other numerous adventurers.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: One more thing. I reported what I requested to you to the superiors.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: They provided the special reward money for your credibility.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Now that you received the special reward money, please keep up the good work.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I appreciate what you do for us, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I must say it's quite rare to see such a diligent adventurer like you.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Are you ready to enter the underground dungeon? Do you have anything you'd like to ask?
To the Underground Dungeon...
About the Underground Dungeon
About Them
I think I saw a bunch like them...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I wish you godspeed.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Is there something you'd like to know about the underground dungeon?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Nothing particular. What you can imagine about the dungeon of the kingdom is all there is.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I was told it was made to lock up the menaces to peace and safety of Rune-Midgarts.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Basically, it's strongly made, but...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: The facility there is very old so it must need some mending works here and there.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: But, as you can see, we can't even find the time to fix anything.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: The situation here is getting worse, so please take good care of yourself so that you won't get hurt in the dungeon.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: What you saw in the dungeon are monsters, for sure. What else could they be?

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: This facility is so old and there is no document written about it. We just pass down what people say about it.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: What's certain is that they were the culprit of the chaos created in Rune-Midgarts in the past.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Anyway, there is no document left about them ? for what they were charged or sentences confirmed against them.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Although there is a document saying that some crusader lost the document containing the charge and the sentence made...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Well, I guess those in the underground dungeon don't seem to care too much about him, so it'd be alright.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Some of them must still be inside the prison even when they've done the time.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Oh, I heard about that story, too.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: The Crusaders are consisting of various bunches so some of them are adventurers like yourself.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: A friend of mine said he saw the monsters from the underground dungeon are going about the world outside of it.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: The Crusaders say he is bluffing a lot probably because he was an adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: No offense, adventurer. This is not about you. He's just full of baloney...

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I guarantee you that the monsters in the outer world and those in the dungeon must be different beings from each other.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: They must be remotely related or something.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: I am sorry, but unauthorized access to this place is restricted.

scripts.speaker: Ellond Lawrence
scripts.text: Sorry for the inconvenience and your cooperation will be appreciated.

scripts.speaker: Terketh
scripts.text:
You are out from the Past Memories of the Royal Family?
Since you know the way here, you must have got the permission to move.

scripts.speaker: Terketh
scripts.text:
Let me send you out.
If you move straight up the stairs, you'll find the Crusader's Office.
You must to where to go after that, right?

scripts.speaker: Terketh
scripts.text: What do you want?
To the Past Memories of the Royal Family
To the outside
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Who is it? Who's calling me?
The prisoner is howling. Is something happening?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: You must be adventurer, are you? Hmm...You seem like a beginner. I don't see much charm in you.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Pleasure. It's been a while I saw a human around here.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: You don't seem like that crusader who put me in here. From what I see, I guess you're an adventurer...Is that so?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: It's been a while I saw an adventurer. What brought you here?
- I explained why I came here. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I thought the Crusaders released them all, no? I must've thought wrong, then.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I just thought the Crusaders released them to disrupt the prisoners' peaceful break.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Anyway, I am sorry that I can't be of any help to you.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Human adventurer, I couldn't be of help, but do you mind if I ask you to do me a favor?
Let's hear what it is, shall we?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Thank you. I was once a seaman, voyaging around the sea.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I met a whole lot of fellow seamen as much as I had been on a voyage. Pleasing fellow, bluffing fellow, chicken-hearted fellow...
- The prisoner seems reminiscent of his past, pounding his left chest with his fist. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Yes, I've had a lot of fellow seamen from all walks of life. But we had to part with each other after we got here...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I've been here for as long as I can remember but that sound...It's pretty recent around here.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: It's indistinct but...I can hear the sound from the very far into the darkness, calling me...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Can you find an old fellow of mine who must be locked somewhere in the prison for me?
Consider it done.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Thank you. I hope it is the cry from that fellow.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Please. I hope it's one of my fellow men. You have no idea how long it's been.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: You came, at last! So what was that sound? Did you meet my man?
- I explained what happened to his fellow. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: So what I heard from darkness was indeed the voice from my fellow man. I hoped he'd be alright.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: So he is no longer alive...I know it's been quite a while since that happened, but it's still a shame.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Thank you so much for finding that out for me. I'm much obliged.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: By the way, I haven't even asked your name. What is your name?
Tell him your name.
- The prisoner grabs a fist and pounds his left chest. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I'll inscribe your name right here. I hope you would continue to be the messenger for my fellow men.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text:
Hello. {0} Howdy.
Can you locate an old fellow of mine, again, and deliver his story to me?
You can count on me.
I've got my hands full today.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Is that so? That's a shame. Be sure to come back again if you have the time...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I sure am counting on you.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I can't wait to hear it.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I owe you big time. You have no idea.
- The prisoner grabs a fist and pounds his left chest. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: I'll inscribe your name right here. I hope you would continue to be the messenger for my fellow men.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Now that the fellow has become freer from death, I wonder what he's up to. I wonder what kind of memory he would write in his next letter.
The prisoner started singing as if he was reminiscing about something.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243AD265
scripts.text: Is it already that time to hear the news from the old fellow of mine?
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
The Dark Shape is floating in the dark space. As soon as I showed an interest, it was gone nowhere.
The Dark Shape starts to sway when it saw me. Did it mean it's delighted to see me?
Anything else to give me?
The Dark Shape handed you the letter and was gone.
The Dark Shape seems to be in a good mood, humming along.
The Dark Shape is floating in the dark space. What should I do about it?
Ask if he's the fellow of 243AD265.
You have no idea what it's talking about, but get the impression, from its response to what you say, that it must be the one of the Prisoner 243AD265's fellows.
What should you do?
Just leave.
Wait a little more.
The Dark Shape handed you the letter and left. Did it mean to ask you to deliver it?
You are becoming increasingly agitated as you can't communicate with it effectively. So you decided to leave.
The Dark Shape must've noticed it. It's gone nowhere, too.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
The prisoner here is sitting with the extremely bored look. If you talk to him at this point, you may have to sit down to hang out with him.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Yes, I'm bored as you must've imagined, but I can't hang out with you. Why? You don't have the eyes that I want.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Hey! Yes, you outside of the steel bars. You have such pretty eyes. My cup of tea.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Please be nice and give me either of your eyes. I'll cherish them.
Whoa, you're being too forward.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text:
Am I? Because those eyes look so gorgeous.
Even if you give me one of those, you still have one left. How hard can it be?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: You're one greedy fella.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Well, if you say so, can you just find the time to talk with me, then?
I can do it.
No.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: You're pretty straightforward. If you say so...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Alright, then! What should we talk about first?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: How about this? Do you know what charge people put against me? It's the marriage scam!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Marriage scam? Ridiculous! Do I look like someone who would dupe anyone into marrying me?
Well, uh...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh? You thought so, too?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Pretty eyes don't do any good, I guess! You should open your mind to match those pretty little eyes!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: I was merely attracted to the woman with pretty eyes. It was pure love. People don't get me.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh, I remember. Yes, there is a bunch who's walking around the underground dungeon as freely as they desire.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: I thought that was weird and recently found the cheeky ones with the bat wings when they're not even bats.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: They were cheeky indeed, but I thought they have pretty blue eyes.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: So I told them I would gracefully let them pass with their wings and, in return, they should give me that blue gems.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: But they wouldn't listen.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: But they might listen to you because you have pretty eyes.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Can you just go ask them to give their pretty gems? I'm not allowed to leave here.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: If they wouldn't listen, why don't you just take them? How about 20? I'm giving you the special grant.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: It started off with a little chat, but ended up as a request. Haha!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: I believe someone with pretty eyes like you should forgive me. So...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Go and get those pretty gems from the cheeky bunch with the bat wings.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: You should get me at least 20, alright?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: No way! What I saw were blue eyes but these are red! That's odd!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: I'll have to take a close look. Will you hand them to me?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Now that I have a job to do for today and you've done a good job. Maybe I should give you a present.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Humans who had been here before gave me this. I don't like this kind of design, so I'll give it to you.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: This time, again, I took a close look at it.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: But I couldn't find what turned the blue eyes into the red ones.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: So I'm asking you ? will you take the blue gems from them again?
Give a hand.
Refuse to help.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: I thought you'd be different. So disappointing.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: You should get me at least 20, alright?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh~~ I wish I would get the pretty blue eyes this time~~

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh, you indeed brought them! I'll take a close look. Let me.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh, I almost forgot. This is the thing I talked to you the last time. I don't like this kind of design, so I'll give it to you.
He's really taking the time looking closely at the red eyes you brought.
He must not be responding to whatever you say to him now.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh, I have nothing else to do. I'm so bored. I should do something.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 267BD184
scripts.text: Oh! Human with pretty eyes! You've come at the right time.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
The prisoner here is gazing around the corners like a hunting lion. You want to get away before you get caught.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text:
Whoa, this is human!
I'm sorry to say this but I have to work now. Let me play with you later.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text:
Whoa, this is human!
How did you get in here? You've got some skills!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Hehe-
~Stroking~

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Let me give you a compliment stamp. Here it is!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Hehe- I think it's all good since I don't have to see the menacing ones. Right?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: What I learned is that the humans would do anything for a reward. Am I right or what?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Let me give you quite a good one. Just follow one of my 'orders.'
Just listen anyway.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text:
Oh, good! How nice!
You're such a good human. See? You'll know what I mean if you have eyes.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: This underground dungeon used to be clean and neat. Once the humans came along a while ago, it got dirty probably because they haven't done the proper cleaning.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Watch this, human. Trust my detective instinct. Do you see them wandering around here?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: I have no idea how they got in, but I'm absolutely sure they're the cause of dirtiness in the prison.
Do you want me to attack them?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: What are you talking about, human? They're nice. I didn't know you'd be this violent. I'm disappointed.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Stop harassing the innocent kids. Just go around the prison and clean up the mess.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Human! Don't try to cut corners ? wipe it all up here and there. Make it clean. Do it right.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: You've done your cleaning? Yay! Here's your compliment stamp!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Now that the prison becomes clean, you must be feeling good, too, aren't you, human? We should do the cleaning more often.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text:
Oh, right! I told you I'd give you a reward, didn't I?
This is what the human who worked here before gave me. You've been such a sport so let me give you this.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: If you come back again tomorrow and give me a hand, there will be more of this. Come back often!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Now that the prison has gotten messy as I intended. So it's finally the time for cleaning.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Cleaning will make the day rewarding!
Let's go!
No way! I will never do it. Over my dead body.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Oh, you...! I knew you'd be better but I didn't know you were this lazy. Big letdown!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Let the cleaning begin!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Human! Don't try to cut corners ? wipe it all up here and there. Make it clean. Do it right.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: What a good human! You've earned another compliment stamp! Here it is!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: Now that you finished cleaning for today, let me give you this. Come back tomorrow!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: You don't seem to know the fun of messing things up. Messing is as fun as cleaning!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: That's about enough now. You can do the rest tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 265CM154
scripts.text: You've come at the right time. The prison has gotten properly messy, so it's time for cleaning.
Some stuff left around the floor are lumped together.
Clean them.
Just leave them.
You're sad but there still are much to clean. Go find something to clean up.
You finished cleaning. Report the result.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: What is it, human? Anything you want to say to me?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: What are you talking about? I don't have time for this. Beat it.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: What?! Do you have anything to say to me? Spit it out, then!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: {0} ? Is that it?
I was ridiculed for no reason and it really feels bad.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: What?! Do you have a problem with me? Be gone now.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: ~Giggles~ I suddenly feel better now. Alright, what the heck. I'll send you to the sector you want for 1 Jellopy.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: What? You don't even have Jellopy with you? How useless are you?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: What? Sector D is right here! Well, I've got my Jellopy so I don't care. Let me send you there.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: Thank you for Jellopy! {0} it is, then. Off you go!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 243DV17
scripts.text: Just leave me alone! Go away!
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
Zzzzzzzzz...~Snores~
The prisoner is breathing calmly so he must be sleeping.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: What a worthless human!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: ~Sniffs~ This smell...Yes...It is human...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: ~Giggles~ It's been such a while since any human came along in this dark underground. Get over here, human. It's been a while so I will show mercy and let you live.
Approach closer.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text:
~Evil laughter~ You've got the courage, human!
I can't wait to let the dumb humans taste of my fist of terror!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Now I can't let myself out of this dark and damp place because of the chicken-hearted human. Once I get out of here, I will never forgive the humans.
Well...there is particularly no need to...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text:
~Evil laughter~
Talking back to me? How dare you! But I like your audacity, too. You can be my underling, then.
By the way, didn't you just cringe?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text:
Wa-hahaha! I think I've got myself a cocky underling.
Remember. A dark and humid place like this one is a match for a doppelganger who is blatantly wicked and doesn't even have its own face.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text:
~Evil laughter~
Let me give a chance to this amusing underling to prove your sense of loyalty. I'll have to brighten up this place first.
Haven't we just...met?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Underling. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison. This place is too dark. I'll have to turn this place bright like my own hometown.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Underling. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison. I'll have to turn this place bright like my own hometown.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text:
~Evil laughter~
What a loyal subordinate! Now I can lead a bright life, at least for a while, thanks to your contribution.
I mean, I am not your under...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: I would like to give you a reward, but I'm afraid I don't have much. I would've given you a world of treasures if it were my golden days.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Underling, this is a shame, but I'll give you something I took from the human who would come in here.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: I promise you a lot more rewards the day when I stand tall in the world again.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: It's time to demonstrate your sense of loyalty. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison.
Not so fast.
Okay...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text:
Is there anything you should do now? I'm perplexed to hear it but I will do my best to understand you.
Still, don't make me wait too long.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: ~Laughter~ Go! Go and get the torch burning most brightly in the prison.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Go and get the torch burning most brightly in the prison, again.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: What an exemplary subordinate! Now I can lead a bright life, at least for a while, thanks to your contribution.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Keep this in mind. I promise you a lot more rewards the day when I stand tall in the world again.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Things haven't changed much but it still feels good to see this place has gotten brighter.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 95EB72
scripts.text: Just so you know, the torchlight you brought is waning. It's time to show me your sense of worth to me again.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
This is a large torch burning quite brightly.
Collect the light.
You carefully collected the light and obtained the bright light.
You carefully collected the light but it scattered.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Hey, are you that new servant?
The prisoner inside seems to be looking for a servant. I think he saw me but I'll just have to act like I didn't hear him.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Tsk, tsk. Even a servant is supposed to know manners.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Are you that new servant? I guess the prisoner keeper has sent another human servant, then.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: I didn't like the human servant last time. He was too weak. I don't know about you.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: I'm worried but there is nothing else I can do.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Human servant. What is your name? What should I call you?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: {0} What a weird and difficult name to pronounce! I wanted to call you by your name, but, I don't think I can.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Oh, right, you're Noyel! I like the sound of the name. Your name is Noyel from now on.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Noyel, I have a question! Are the other human prisoners living in this dire environment?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: I know I'm a prisoner here, but I don't understand why they have to lock me in this place that is so dirty and humid.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Noyel, go ahead and bring that prisoner keeper. I have a bone to pick with him.
I don't think that's going to happen.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: I didn't know a servant has no right to meet with the prisoner keepers. My apology.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: But I can't go there myself. That means it's impossible to meet him then. We should come up with an alternative.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Now I remember. The servant who used to serve me gave me that. I'm not sure it's still here.
What item is it?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: For what I remember, it was something that you humans use. It is called a dehumidifier removing humidity around you. Do you know what that is?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Maybe I should use it because I don't have any other option. Bring me about 20 of them.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Still no dehumidifiers for me, Noyel? I don't need many. 20 dehumidifiers will do.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: I start to feel the damp and soggy place is getting freshened up, Noyel.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Good job. Go have a rest until I call you back up.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: It's nothing. I don't need it so you take and use it.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Noyel, the humidifier you brought for me doesn't seem to work. Will you bring another new one?
Will do right away.
Ah...I've got other business to go about now.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Noyel! Where do you think you're going? Noel.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Thank you, Noyel. I will wait for you to bring me 20 dehumidifiers.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Noyel, when can I get those 20 dehumidifiers? The air feels so soggy and it's starting to feel unpleasant.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: You're late, Noyel. Did you have a hard time getting the dehumidifier?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: I was actually starting to feel displeased by the dampening air.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: You did a good job getting the humidifier, Noyel.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Noyel, the air I breathe couldn't be more fresh now!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text: Even the prisoners deserve the pleasant environment to live. Keep that in mind, Noyel. Just in case.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 117FM188
scripts.text:
Welcome, Noyel.
The dehumidifier you brought doesn't seem to function well. It's time to replace it with a new one.
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Keeps giggling~
The prisoner here is smiling out of his pain. I don't think he's in normal condition. Should I pass him?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Evil laughter continues~

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Giggles~ How long have I waited for a guest?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Even if your fear of me binds me here in the land of darkness, you can never bind my will. Mark my word.
What are you talking about?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Hahaha!! Now I remember.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Ever since the cowards stopped coming to this land of darkness, I took my last sleep out of boredom.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: B.U.T.!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: That was my mistake. Darkness inside of me became greater during my sleep and the followers awaken by darkness changed a lot of things in this land.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text:
~Evil laughter~
I hate to admit this but darkness is stomping around. I need something to bring it under control.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text:
~Grunts~ Human...
It doesn't happen every day for a lard to ask you to do something. ~Grunts~ Bring me...some flowers...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Flowers representing the world are what not only soothes down darkness but also brings the peace of mind.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ It must be effective in calming down the growing darkness.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Aaarrgghh--!!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Hurry. ~Grunts~ Darkness inside of me is trying to stomp around. If you don't want to see the world brought to ashes by this darkness, bring me...flowers...Now.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ I'll wait here for you. Any flowers would do. Bring me flowers.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text:
You brought the flowers, human!
~Evil laughter~ Human! You saved the world against darkness. Be glad!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: I can feel darkness inside is getting under control.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ How pathetic I have become, getting help from a human...
You don't need to thank me. But, why the flowers?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Human! Don't be so nosy.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Wait. Maybe it's alright after all since you're my savior.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Alright, whatever. I'll let you in on it just this once.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: It was around the time when I was holding sway in the world. I was conquering one of the human towns with my followers.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: I met a girl in that village who was different from other humans.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Humans who got scared silly were busy running away from me and my followers but that girl was different. She reached out to me.
So, what happened?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: You, human! Don't people often say you can be a wet blanket?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: This story doesn't deserve repetition.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: It's true that you've been of help so let me give you one of the things that the followers left for me.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ If you don't want to see my darkness drags down the whole world to ashes, you'd better come often and bring me flowers.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Aarghh!! Darkness is about to stomp around!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Darkness should be taken under control. Give me that flower...quick! Aargh!!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Please get me one flower to calm down darkness, human...
Okay.
I'm sorry, but now...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: I'll hang in there. Just don't be too late...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Please...~Grunts~ Human...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Oh, no. It's getting out of my hand. Before this darkness goes berserk, bring me...flowers...~Grunts~

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Flower...? ~Grunts~ Darkness should be stable...

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Aaarrgghhh--!!
- The flower you just gave has withered. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: This flower isn't enough to calm down darkness. Bring in more...!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ...It's working. Thank you, human. You've been a lot of help, too, this time.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Let me give you one of the things that the followers left for me.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: I'll contact you again when the darkness inside of me starts to stomp around.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ Pray, human. Pray if you don't want my darkness flail around. You don't want to see the end of the world.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Aarghh!! Darkness is about to stomp around!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 103GD214
scripts.text: Darkness should be taken under control. Give me that flower...quick! Aargh!!
- You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Manager! Isn't there a manager?
I wonder the prisoner here may think this prison as some kind of a hotel. He's looking for a manager. I'll just let this one pass.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: I would like to talk to the manager, not some normal clerk!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: You look like a manager to me. I have to tell you, the service here is downright poor. Don't you agree, manager? Huh?!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: You've come at a good time, I guess. I haven't had the time to take care of my horn and it's still hanging in there.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: My horn used to be praised by the horned bunch and...I hate to even imagine what they would say to me if they get to see this ugly horn now.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Before my horn gets really damaged, I need to get it taken care of. But I don't see proper materials around here.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Hey, manager. I think you're in luck. I think I've found something just right.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: I see Taffy, the inferior species, walking around. I think their skin should make a good alternative to the Sandpaper to trim down this thingies at the end of my horn.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Look at this. This protruded area at the end of my horn. If it gets trimmed down, I would definitely get a peace of mind.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: What are you doing? I told you to skin that Taffy and bring me 20!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: What are you doing? Still haven't left?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: You see Taffy walking around there? I think their skin should make a good alternative to the Sandpaper. Bring 20 of them.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: What in the world are they taking so long? They're slow with poor service...I know my manners as knight so I can't just pick a fight. Alright. Just take this tip.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: ~Sighs~ Given the condition of my horn, I don't think a couple of these won't do any good at all.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: You've come at the right time, manager.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: I was putting on a cool pair of shoes but something happened and I broke my toenails.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: That thing you brought me last time was pretty good. I'm impressed by your skinning ability. How about changing your job to skin master?

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: In that spirit, why don't you bring me those 20 Sandpapers again?
I'll be on my way.
I'm tied up.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: I knew it. Talk about poor service!

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: I can't wait to see what you'll bring this time.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Rudolph the hero of reindeers said time is gold. I think it applies to humans, too.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: You can't turn back time once it passes. Hurry up. You have no time to lose.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: This time, the service is acceptable.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Here's your tip for your satisfactory work. Come back again.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: Oh, this alternative is better than I thought.

scripts.speaker: Prisoner 55HK115
scripts.text: You've come at the right time, manager.
